33.e: Our soul hath waited for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.

33.s: כִּי־בוֹ יִשְׂמַח לִבֵּנוּ כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ בָטָחְנוּ׃
33.e: For in Him doth our heart rejoice, Because we have trusted in His holy name.

33.s: יְהִי־חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה עָלֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִחַלְנוּ לָךְ׃
33.e: Let Thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, According as we have waited for Thee.

34.s: לְדָוִד בְּשַׁנּוֹתוֹ אֶת־טַעְמוֹ לִפְנֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיְגָרֲשֵׁהוּ וַיֵּלַךְ׃
34.e: [A Psalm] of David; when he changed his demeanour before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.

34.s: אֲבָרֲכָה אֶת־יְהוָה בְּכָל־עֵת תָּמִיד תְּהִלָּתוֹ בְּפִי׃
34.e: I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.

34.s: בַּיהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּל נַפְשִׁי יִשְׁמְעוּ עֲנָוִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ׃
34.e: My soul shall glory in the LORD; The humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

34.s: גַּדְּלוּ לַיהוָה אִתִּי וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו׃
34.e: O magnify the LORD with me, And let us exalt His name together.

34.s: דָּרַשְׁתִּי אֶת־יְהוָה וְעָנָנִי וּמִכָּל־מְגוּרוֹתַי הִצִּילָנִי׃
34.e: I sought the LORD, and He answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.

34.s: הִבִּיטוּ אֵלָיו וְנָהָרוּ וּפְנֵיהֶם אַל־יֶחְפָּרוּ׃
34.e: They looked unto Him, and were radiant; And their faces shall never be abashed.

34.s: זֶה עָנִי קָרָא וַיהוָה שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל־צָרוֹתָיו הוֹשִׁיעוֹ׃
34.e: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard, And saved him out of all his troubles.

34.s: חֹנֶה מַלְאַךְ־יְהוָה סָבִיב לִירֵאָיו וַיְחַלְּצֵם׃
34.e: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear Him, And delivereth them.

34.s: טַעֲמוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר יֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ׃
34.e: O consider and see that the LORD is good; Happy is the man that taketh refuge in Him.

34.s: יְראוּ אֶת־יְהוָה קְדֹשָׁיו כִּי־אֵין מַחְסוֹר לִירֵאָיו׃
34.e: O fear the LORD, ye His holy ones;  For there is no want to them that fear Him.

34.s: כְּפִירִים רָשׁוּ וְרָעֵבוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁי יְהוָה לֹא־יַחְסְרוּ כָל־טוֹב׃
34.e: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek the LORD want not any good thing.

34.s: לְכוּ־בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִי יִרְאַת יְהוָה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶם׃
34.e: Come, ye children, hearken unto me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

34.s: מִי־הָאִישׁ הֶחָפֵץ חַיִּים אֹהֵב יָמִים לִרְאוֹת טוֹב׃
34.e: Who is the man that desireth life, and loveth days, That he may see good therein?

34.s: נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנְךָ מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה׃
34.e: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.

34.s: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵהוּ׃
34.e: Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.

34.s: עֵינֵי יְהוָה אֶל־צַדִּיקִים וְאָזְנָיו אֶל־שַׁוְעָתָם׃
34.e: The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous, And His ears are open unto their cry.

34.s: פְּנֵי יְהוָה בְּעֹשֵׂי רָע לְהַכְרִית מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָם׃
34.e: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

34.s: צָעֲקוּ וַיהוָה שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל־צָרוֹתָם הִצִּילָם׃
34.e: They cried, and the LORD heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.

34.s: קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵב וְאֶת־דַּכְּאֵי־רוּחַ יוֹשִׁיעַ׃
34.e: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.

34.s: רַבּוֹת רָעוֹת צַדִּיק וּמִכֻּלָּם יַצִּילֶנּוּ יְהוָה׃
34.e: Many are the ills of the righteous, But the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

34.s: שֹׁמֵר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָיו אַחַת מֵהֵנָּה לֹא נִשְׁבָּרָה׃
34.e: He keepeth all his bones; Not one of them is broken.

34.s: תְּמוֹתֵת רָשָׁע רָעָה וְשֹׂנְאֵי צַדִּיק יֶאְשָׁמוּ׃
34.e: Evil shall kill the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be held guilty.

34.s: פּוֹדֶה יְהוָה נֶפֶשׁ עֲבָדָיו וְלֹא יֶאְשְׁמוּ כָּל־הַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃
34.e: The LORD redeemeth the soul of His servants; And none of them that take refuge in Him shall be desolate.

35.s: לְדָוִד רִיבָה יְהוָה אֶת־יְרִיבַי לְחַם אֶת־לֹחֲמָי׃
35.e: [A Psalm] of David. Strive, O LORD, with them that strive with me; Fight against them that fight against me.

35.s: הַחֲזֵק מָגֵן וְצִנָּה וְקוּמָה בְּעֶזְרָתִי׃
35.e: Take hold of shield and buckler, And rise up to my help.

35.s: וְהָרֵק חֲנִית וּסְגֹר לִקְרַאת רֹדְפָי אֱמֹר לְנַפְשִׁי יְשֻׁעָתֵךְ אָנִי׃
35.e: Draw out also the spear, and the battle-axe, against them that pursue me; Say unto my soul: 'I am Thy salvation.'

35.s: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיַחְפְּרוּ חֹשְׁבֵי רָעָתִי׃
35.e: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion that seek after my soul; Let them be turned back and be abashed that devise my hurt.

35.s: יִהְיוּ כְּמֹץ לִפְנֵי־רוּחַ וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה דּוֹחֶה׃
35.e: Let them be as chaff before the wind, The angel of the LORD thrusting them.

35.s: יְהִי־דַרְכָּם חֹשֶׁךְ וַחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה רֹדְפָם׃
35.e: Let their way be dark and slippery, The angel of the LORD pursuing them.

35.s: כִּי־חִנָּם טָמְנוּ־לִי שַׁחַת רִשְׁתָּם חִנָּם חָפְרוּ לְנַפְשִׁי׃
35.e: For without cause have they hid for me the pit, even their net, Without cause have they digged for my soul. .

35.s: תְּבוֹאֵהוּ שׁוֹאָה לֹא־יֵדָע וְרִשְׁתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־טָמַן תִּלְכְּדוֹ בְּשׁוֹאָה יִפָּל־בָּהּ׃
35.e: Let destruction come upon him unawares; And let his net that he hath hid catch himself; With destruction let him fall therein.

35.s: וְנַפְשִׁי תָּגִיל בַּיהוָה תָּשִׂישׂ בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ׃
35.e: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD; It shall rejoice in His salvation.

35.s: כָּל עַצְמוֹתַי תֹּאמַרְנָה יְהוָה מִי כָמוֹךָ מַצִּיל עָנִי מֵחָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ וְעָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן מִגֹּזְלוֹ׃
35.e: All my bones shall say: 'LORD, who is like unto Thee, Who deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, Yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?'

35.s: יְקוּמוּן עֵדֵי חָמָס אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי יִשְׁאָלוּנִי׃
35.e: Unrighteous witnesses rise up; They ask me of things that I know not.

35.s: יְשַׁלְּמוּנִי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה שְׁכוֹל לְנַפְשִׁי׃
35.e: They repay me evil for good; Bereavement is come to my soul.

35.s: וַאֲנִי בַּחֲלוֹתָם לְבוּשִׁי שָׂק עִנֵּיתִי בַצּוֹם נַפְשִׁי וּתְפִלָּתִי עַל־חֵיקִי תָשׁוּב׃
35.e: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth, I afflicted my soul with fasting; And my prayer, may it return into mine own bosom.

35.s: כְּרֵעַ־כְּאָח לִי הִתְהַלָּכְתִּי כַּאֲבֶל־אֵם קֹדֵר שַׁחוֹתִי׃
35.e: I went about as though it had been my friend or my brother; I bowed down mournful, as one that mourneth for his mother.

35.s: וּבְצַלְעִי שָׂמְחוּ וְנֶאֱסָפוּ נֶאֶסְפוּ עָלַי נֵכִים וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי קָרְעוּ וְלֹא־דָמּוּ׃
35.e: But when I halt they rejoice, and gather themselves together; The abjects gather themselves together against me, and those whom I know not; They tear me, and cease not;

35.s: בְּחַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵי מָעוֹג חָרֹק עָלַי שִׁנֵּימוֹ׃
35.e: With the profanest mockeries of backbiting They gnash at me with their teeth.

35.s: אֲדֹנָי כַּמָּה תִּרְאֶה הָשִׁיבָה נַפְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶם מִכְּפִירִים יְחִידָתִי׃
35.e: Lord, how long wilt Thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, Mine only one from the lions.

35.s: אוֹדְךָ בְּקָהָל רָב בְּעַם עָצוּם אֲהַלְלֶךָּ׃
35.e: I will give Thee thanks in the great congregation; I will praise Thee among a numerous people.

35.s: אַל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִי אֹיְבַי שֶׁקֶר שֹׂנְאַי חִנָּם יִקְרְצוּ־עָיִן׃
35.e: Let not them that are wrongfully mine enemies rejoice over me; Neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

35.s: כִּי לֹא שָׁלוֹם יְדַבֵּרוּ וְעַל רִגְעֵי־אֶרֶץ דִּבְרֵי מִרְמוֹת יַחֲשֹׁבוּן׃
35.e: For they speak not peace; But they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

35.s: וַיַּרְחִיבוּ עָלַי פִּיהֶם אָמְרוּ הֶאָח הֶאָח רָאֲתָה עֵינֵינוּ׃
35.e: Yea, they open their mouth wide against me; They say: 'Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.'

35.s: רָאִיתָה יְהוָה אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ אֲדֹנָי אֲל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי׃
35.e: Thou hast seen, O LORD; keep not silence; O Lord, be not far from me.

35.s: הָעִירָה וְהָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִי אֱלֹהַי וַאדֹנָי לְרִיבִי׃
35.e: Rouse Thee, and awake to my judgment, Even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

35.s: שָׁפְטֵנִי כְצִדְקְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי וְאַל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִי׃
35.e: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to Thy righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.

35.s: אַל־יֹאמְרוּ בְלִבָּם הֶאָח נַפְשֵׁנוּ אַל־יֹאמְרוּ בִּלַּעֲנוּהוּ׃
35.e: Let them not say in their heart: 'Aha, we have our desire'; Let them not say: 'We have swallowed him up.'

35.s: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ יַחְדָּו שְׂמֵחֵי רָעָתִי יִלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹשֶׁת וּכְלִמָּה הַמַּגְדִּילִים עָלָי׃
35.e: Let them be ashamed and abashed together that rejoice at my hurt; Let them be clothed with shame and confusion that magnify themselves against me. .

35.s: יָרֹנּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ חֲפֵצֵי צִדְקִי וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהוָה הֶחָפֵץ שְׁלוֹם עַבְדּוֹ׃
35.e: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that delight in my righteousness; Yea, let them say continually: 'Magnified be the LORD, Who delighteth in the peace of His servant.'

35.s: וּלְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּה צִדְקֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃
35.e: And my tongue shall speak of Thy righteousness, And of Thy praise all the day.

36.e: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David the servant of the LORD.

36.s: נְאֻם־פֶּשַׁע לָרָשָׁע בְּקֶרֶב לִבִּי אֵין־פַּחַד אֱלֹהִים לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו׃
36.e: Transgression speaketh to the wicked, methinks— There is no fear of God before his eyes.

36.s: כִּי־הֶחֱלִיק אֵלָיו בְּעֵינָיו לִמְצֹא עֲוֺנוֹ לִשְׂנֹא׃
36.e: For it flattereth him in his eyes, Until his iniquity be found, and he be hated.

36.s: דִּבְרֵי־פִיו אָוֶן וּמִרְמָה חָדַל לְהַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵיטִיב׃
36.e: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit; He hath left off to be wise, to do good.

36.s: אָוֶן יַחְשֹׁב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ יִתְיַצֵּב עַל־דֶּרֶךְ לֹא־טוֹב רָע לֹא יִמְאָס׃
36.e: He deviseth iniquity upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil.
Thy lovingkindness, O LORD, is in the heavens; Thy faithfulness reacheth unto the skies.

36.s: צִדְקָתְךָ כְּהַרְרֵי־אֵל מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּהוֹם רַבָּה אָדָם־וּבְהֵמָה תוֹשִׁיעַ יְהוָה׃
36.e: Thy righteousness is like the mighty mountains; Thy judgments are like the great deep; Man and beast Thou preservest, O LORD.

36.s: מַה־יָּקָר חַסְדְּךָ אֱלֹהִים וּבְנֵי אָדָם בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ יֶחֱסָיוּן׃
36.e: How precious is Thy lovingkindness, O God! And the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Thy wings.

36.s: יִרְוְיֻן מִדֶּשֶׁן בֵּיתֶךָ וְנַחַל עֲדָנֶיךָ תַשְׁקֵם׃
36.e: They are abundantly satisfied with the fatness of Thy house; And Thou makest them drink of the river of Thy pleasures.
For with Thee is the fountain of life; In Thy light do we see light.
O continue Thy lovingkindness unto them that know Thee; And Thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
Let not the foot of pride overtake me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.

36.s: שָׁם נָפְלוּ פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן דֹּחוּ וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ קוּם׃
36.e: There are the workers of iniquity fallen; They are thrust down, and are not able to rise.

37.s: לְדָוִד אַל־תִּתְחַר בַּמְּרֵעִים אַל־תְּקַנֵּא בְּעֹשֵׂי עַוְלָה׃
37.e: [A Psalm] of David. Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, neither be thou envious against them that work unrighteousness.

37.s: כִּי כֶחָצִיר מְהֵרָה יִמָּלוּ וּכְיֶרֶק דֶּשֶׁא יִבּוֹלוּן׃
37.e: For they shall soon wither like the grass, and fade as the green herb.

37.s: בְּטַח בַּיהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב שְׁכָן־אֶרֶץ וּרְעֵה אֱמוּנָה׃
37.e: Trust in the LORD, and do good; dwell in the land, and cherish faithfulness.

37.s: וְהִתְעַנַּג עַל־יְהוָה וְיִתֶּן־לְךָ מִשְׁאֲלֹת לִבֶּךָ׃
37.e: So shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and He shall give thee the petitions of thy heart.

37.s: גּוֹל עַל־יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ וּבְטַח עָלָיו וְהוּא יַעֲשֶׂה׃
37.e: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in Him, and He will bring it to pass.

37.s: וְהוֹצִיא כָאוֹר צִדְקֶךָ וּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ כַּצָּהֳרָיִם׃
37.e: And He will make thy righteousness to go forth as the light, and thy right as the noonday.

37.s: דּוֹם לַיהוָה וְהִתְחוֹלֵל לוֹ אַל־תִּתְחַר בְּמַצְלִיחַ דַּרְכּוֹ בְּאִישׁ עֹשֶׂה מְזִמּוֹת׃
37.e: Resign thyself unto the LORD, and wait patiently for Him; fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

37.s: הֶרֶף מֵאַף וַעֲזֹב חֵמָה אַל־תִּתְחַר אַךְ־לְהָרֵעַ׃
37.e: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; fret not thyself, it tendeth only to evil-doing.

37.s: כִּי־מְרֵעִים יִכָּרֵתוּן וְקֹוֵי יְהוָה הֵמָּה יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ׃
37.e: For evil-doers shall be cut off; but those that wait for the LORD, they shall inherit the land.

37.s: וְעוֹד מְעַט וְאֵין רָשָׁע וְהִתְבּוֹנַנְתָּ עַל־מְקוֹמוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ׃
37.e: And yet a little while, and the wicked is no more; yea, thou shalt look well at his place, and he is not.

37.s: וַעֲנָוִים יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ וְהִתְעַנְּגוּ עַל־רֹב שָׁלוֹם׃
37.e: But the humble shall inherit the land, and delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

37.s: זֹמֵם רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וְחֹרֵק עָלָיו שִׁנָּיו׃
37.e: The wicked plotteth against the righteous, and gnasheth at him with his teeth.

37.s: אֲדֹנָי יִשְׂחַק־לוֹ כִּי־רָאָה כִּי־יָבֹא יוֹמוֹ׃
37.e: The Lord doth laugh at him; for He seeth that his day is coming.

37.s: חֶרֶב פָּתְחוּ רְשָׁעִים וְדָרְכוּ קַשְׁתָּם לְהַפִּיל עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן לִטְבוֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי־דָרֶךְ׃
37.e: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow; to cast down the poor and needy, to slay such as are upright in the way;

37.s: חַרְבָּם תָּבוֹא בְלִבָּם וְקַשְּׁתוֹתָם תִּשָּׁבַרְנָה׃
37.e: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

37.s: טוֹב־מְעַט לַצַּדִּיק מֵהֲמוֹן רְשָׁעִים רַבִּים׃
37.e: Better is a little that the righteous hath than the abundance of many wicked.

37.s: כִּי זְרוֹעוֹת רְשָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַרְנָה וְסוֹמֵךְ צַדִּיקִים יְהוָה׃
37.e: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

37.s: יוֹדֵעַ יְהוָה יְמֵי תְמִימִם וְנַחֲלָתָם לְעוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה׃
37.e: The LORD knoweth the days of them that are wholehearted; and their inheritance shall be for ever.

37.s: לֹא־יֵבֹשׁוּ בְּעֵת רָעָה וּבִימֵי רְעָבוֹן יִשְׂבָּעוּ׃
37.e: They shall not be ashamed in the time of evil; and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

37.s: כִּי רְשָׁעִים יֹאבֵדוּ וְאֹיְבֵי יְהוָה כִּיקַר כָּרִים כָּלוּ בֶעָשָׁן כָּלוּ׃
37.e: For the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs— They shall pass away in smoke, they shall pass away.

37.s: לֹוֶה רָשָׁע וְלֹא יְשַׁלֵּם וְצַדִּיק חוֹנֵן וְנוֹתֵן׃
37.e: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not; but the righteous dealeth graciously, and giveth.

37.s: כִּי מְבֹרָכָיו יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וּמְקֻלָּלָיו יִכָּרֵתוּ׃
37.e: For such as are blessed of Him shall inherit the land; and they that are cursed of Him shall be cut off.

37.s: מֵיְהוָה מִצְעֲדֵי־גֶבֶר כּוֹנָנוּ וְדַרְכּוֹ יֶחְפָּץ׃
37.e: It is of the LORD that a man's goings are established; and He delighted in his way.

37.s: כִּי־יִפֹּל לֹא־יוּטָל כִּי־יְהוָה סוֹמֵךְ יָדוֹ׃
37.e: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; for the LORD upholdeth his hand.

37.s: נַעַר הָיִיתִי גַּם־זָקַנְתִּי וְלֹא־רָאִיתִי צַדִּיק נֶעֱזָב וְזַרְעוֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־לָחֶם׃
37.e: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

37.s: כָּל־הַיּוֹם חוֹנֵן וּמַלְוֶה וְזַרְעוֹ לִבְרָכָה׃
37.e: All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

37.s: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב וּשְׁכֹן לְעוֹלָם׃
37.e: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

37.s: כִּי יְהוָה אֹהֵב מִשְׁפָּט וְלֹא־יַעֲזֹב אֶת־חֲסִידָיו לְעוֹלָם נִשְׁמָרוּ וְזֶרַע רְשָׁעִים נִכְרָת׃
37.e: For the LORD loveth justice, And forsaketh not His saints; they are preserved for ever; but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

37.s: צַדִּיקִים יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנוּ לָעַד עָלֶיהָ׃
37.e: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

37.s: פִּי־צַדִּיק יֶהְגֶּה חָכְמָה וּלְשׁוֹנוֹ תְּדַבֵּר מִשְׁפָּט׃
37.e: The mouth of the righteous uttereth wisdom, and his tongue speaketh justice.

37.s: תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהָיו בְּלִבּוֹ לֹא תִמְעַד אֲשֻׁרָיו׃
37.e: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps slide.

37.s: צוֹפֶה רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וּמְבַקֵּשׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃
37.e: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

37.s: יְהוָה לֹא־יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדוֹ וְלֹא יַרְשִׁיעֶנּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ׃
37.e: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor suffer him to be condemned when he is judged.

37.s: קַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה וּשְׁמֹר דַּרְכּוֹ וִירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶשֶׁת אָרֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה׃
37.e: Wait for the LORD, and keep His way, and He will exalt thee to inherit the land; when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

37.s: רָאִיתִי רָשָׁע עָרִיץ וּמִתְעָרֶה כְּאֶזְרָח רַעֲנָן׃
37.e: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a leafy tree in its native soil.

37.s: וַיַּעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ וָאֲבַקְשֵׁהוּ וְלֹא נִמְצָא׃
37.e: But one passed by, and, lo, he was not; yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

37.s: שְׁמָר־תָּם וּרְאֵה יָשָׁר כִּי־אַחֲרִית לְאִישׁ שָׁלוֹם׃
37.e: Mark the man of integrity, and behold the upright; for there is a future for the man of peace.

37.s: וּפֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְדוּ יַחְדָּו אַחֲרִית רְשָׁעִים נִכְרָתָה׃
37.e: But transgressors shall be destroyed together; the future of the wicked shall be cut off.

37.s: וּתְשׁוּעַת צַדִּיקִים מֵיְהוָה מָעוּזָּם בְּעֵת צָרָה׃
37.e: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD; He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

37.s: וַיַּעְזְרֵם יְהוָה וַיְפַלְּטֵם יְפַלְּטֵם מֵרְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם כִּי־חָסוּ בוֹ׃
37.e: And the LORD helpeth them, and delivereth them; He delivereth them from the wicked, and saveth them, because they have taken refuge in Him.

38.s: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד לְהַזְכִּיר׃
38.e: A Psalm of David, to make memorial.

38.s: יְהוָה אַל־בְּקֶצְפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנִי וּבַחֲמָתְךָ תְיַסְּרֵנִי׃
38.e: O LORD, rebuke me not in Thine anger; neither chasten me in Thy wrath.

38.s: כִּי־חִצֶּיךָ נִחֲתוּ בִי וַתִּנְחַת עָלַי יָדֶךָ׃
38.e: For Thine arrows are gone deep into me, and Thy hand is come down upon me.

38.s: אֵין־מְתֹם בִּבְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵי זַעְמֶךָ אֵין־שָׁלוֹם בַּעֲצָמַי מִפְּנֵי חַטָּאתִי׃
38.e: There is no soundness in my flesh because of Thine indignation; neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

38.s: כִּי עֲוֺנֹתַי עָבְרוּ רֹאשִׁי כְּמַשָּׂא כָבֵד יִכְבְּדוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
38.e: For mine iniquities are gone over my head; as a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

38.s: הִבְאִישׁוּ נָמַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָי מִפְּנֵי אִוַּלְתִּי׃
38.e: My wounds are noisome, they fester, because of my foolishness.

38.s: נַעֲוֵיתִי שַׁחֹתִי עַד־מְאֹד כָּל־הַיּוֹם קֹדֵר הִלָּכְתִּי׃
38.e: I am bent and bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day.

38.s: כִּי־כְסָלַי מָלְאוּ נִקְלֶה וְאֵין מְתֹם בִּבְשָׂרִי׃
38.e: For my loins are filled with burning; and there is no soundness in my flesh.

38.s: נְפוּגוֹתִי וְנִדְכֵּיתִי עַד־מְאֹד שָׁאַגְתִּי מִנַּהֲמַת לִבִּי׃
38.e: I am benumbed and sore crushed; I groan by reason of the moaning of my heart.

38.s: אֲ‍דֹנָי נֶגְדְּךָ כָל־תַּאֲוָתִי וְאַנְחָתִי מִמְּךָ לֹא־נִסְתָּרָה׃
38.e: Lord, all my desire is before Thee; and my sighing is not hid from Thee.

38.s: לִבִּי סְחַרְחַר עֲזָבַנִי כֹחִי וְאוֹר־עֵינַי גַּם־הֵם אֵין אִתִּי׃
38.e: My heart fluttereth, my strength faileth me; as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

38.s: אֹהֲבַי וְרֵעַי מִנֶּגֶד נִגְעִי יַעֲמֹדוּ וּקְרוֹבַי מֵרָחֹק עָמָדוּ׃
38.e: My friends and my companions stand aloof from my plague; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

38.s: וַיְנַקְשׁוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי וְדֹרְשֵׁי רָעָתִי דִּבְּרוּ הַוּוֹת וּמִרְמוֹת כָּל־הַיּוֹם יֶהְגּוּ׃
38.e: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me; and they that seek my hurt speak crafty devices, and utter deceits all the day.

38.s: וַאֲנִי כְחֵרֵשׁ לֹא אֶשְׁמָע וּכְאִלֵּם לֹא יִפְתַּח־פִּיו׃
38.e: But I am as a deaf man, I hear not; and I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

38.s: וָאֱהִי כְּאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שֹׁמֵעַ וְאֵין בְּפִיו תּוֹכָחוֹת׃
38.e: Yea, I am become as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no arguments.

38.s: כִּי־לְךָ יְהוָה הוֹחָלְתִּי אַתָּה תַעֲנֶה אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהָי׃
38.e: For in Thee, O LORD, do I hope; Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.

38.s: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי פֶּן־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִי בְּמוֹט רַגְלִי עָלַי הִגְדִּילוּ׃
38.e: For I said: 'Lest they rejoice over me; when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.'

38.s: כִּי־אֲנִי לְצֶלַע נָכוֹן וּמַכְאוֹבִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃
38.e: For I am ready to halt, and my pain is continually before me.

38.s: כִּי־עֲוֺנִי אַגִּיד אֶדְאַג מֵחַטָּאתִי׃
38.e: For I do declare mine iniquity; I am full of care because of my sin.

38.s: וְאֹיְבַי חַיִּים עָצֵמוּ וְרַבּוּ שֹׂנְאַי שָׁקֶר׃
38.e: But mine enemies are strong in health; and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

38.s: וּמְשַׁלְּמֵי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה יִשְׂטְנוּנִי תַּחַת רדופי־[רָדְפִי־] טוֹב׃
38.e: They also that repay evil for good are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.

38.s: אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי אַל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי׃
38.e: Forsake me not, O LORD; O my God, be not far from me.

38.s: חוּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִי אֲדֹנָי תְּשׁוּעָתִי׃
38.e: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.

39.e: For the Leader, for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.

39.s: אָמַרְתִּי אֶשְׁמְרָה דְרָכַי מֵחֲטוֹא בִלְשׁוֹנִי אֶשְׁמְרָה לְפִי מַחְסוֹם בְּעֹד רָשָׁע לְנֶגְדִּי׃
39.e: I said: 'I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue; I will keep a curb upon my mouth, while the wicked is before me.'

39.s: נֶאֱלַמְתִּי דוּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי מִטּוֹב וּכְאֵבִי נֶעְכָּר׃
39.e: I was dumb with silence; I held my peace, had no comfort; and my pain was held in check.

39.s: חַם־לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי בַּהֲגִיגִי תִבְעַר־אֵשׁ דִּבַּרְתִּי בִּלְשׁוֹנִי׃
39.e: My heart waxed hot within me; while I was musing, the fire kindled; Then spoke I with my tongue:

39.s: הוֹדִיעֵנִי יְהוָה קִצִּי וּמִדַּת יָמַי מַה־הִיא אֵדְעָה מֶה־חָדֵל אָנִי׃
39.e: 'LORD, make me to know mine end, And the measure of my days, what it is; Let me know how short-lived I am.

39.s: הִנֵּה טְפָחוֹת נָתַתָּה יָמַי וְחֶלְדִּי כְאַיִן נֶגְדֶּךָ אַךְ כָּל־הֶבֶל כָּל־אָדָם נִצָּב סֶלָה׃
39.e: Behold, Thou hast made my days as hand-breadths; and mine age is as nothing before Thee; surely every man at his best estate is altogether vanity. Selah

39.s: אַךְ־בְּצֶלֶם יִתְהַלֶּךְ־אִישׁ אַךְ־הֶבֶל יֶהֱמָיוּן יִצְבֹּר וְלֹא־יֵדַע מִי־אֹסְפָם׃
39.e: Surely man walketh as a mere semblance; surely for vanity they are in turmoil; He heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

39.s: וְעַתָּה מַה־קִּוִּיתִי אֲדֹנָי תּוֹחַלְתִּי לְךָ הִיא׃
39.e: And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope, it is in Thee.
Deliver me from all my transgressions; make me not the reproach of the base.

39.s: נֶאֱלַמְתִּי לֹא אֶפְתַּח־פִּי כִּי אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ׃
39.e: I am dumb, I open not my mouth; because Thou hast done it.

39.s: הָסֵר מֵעָלַי נִגְעֶךָ מִתִּגְרַת יָדְךָ אֲנִי כָלִיתִי׃
39.e: Remove Thy stroke from off me; I am consumed by the blow of Thy hand.

39.s: בְּתוֹכָחוֹת עַל־עָוֺן יִסַּרְתָּ אִישׁ וַתֶּמֶס כָּעָשׁ חֲמוּדוֹ אַךְ הֶבֶל כָּל־אָדָם סֶלָה׃
39.e: With rebukes dost Thou chasten man for iniquity, and like a moth Thou makest his beauty to consume away; surely every man is vanity. Selah

39.s: שִׁמְעָה־תְפִלָּתִי יְהוָה וְשַׁוְעָתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֶל־דִּמְעָתִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ כִּי גֵר אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ תּוֹשָׁב כְּכָל־אֲבוֹתָי׃
39.e: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; keep not silence at my tears; for I am a stranger with Thee, a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

39.s: הָשַׁע מִמֶּנִּי וְאַבְלִיגָה בְּטֶרֶם אֵלֵךְ וְאֵינֶנִּי׃
39.e: Look away from me, that I may take comfort, before I go hence, and be no more.'

40.e: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.

40.s: קַוֺּה קִוִּיתִי יְהוָה וַיֵּט אֵלַי וַיִּשְׁמַע שַׁוְעָתִי׃
40.e: I waited patiently for the LORD; and He inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

40.s: וַיַּעֲלֵנִי מִבּוֹר שָׁאוֹן מִטִּיט הַיָּוֵן וַיָּקֶם עַל־סֶלַע רַגְלַי כּוֹנֵן אֲשֻׁרָי׃
40.e: He brought me up also out of the tumultuous pit, out of the miry clay; and He set my feet upon a rock, He established my goings.

40.s: וַיִּתֵּן בְּפִי שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּה לֵאלֹהֵינוּ יִרְאוּ רַבִּים וְיִירָאוּ וְיִבְטְחוּ בַּיהוָה׃
40.e: And He hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God; many shall see, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

40.s: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם יְהֹוָה מִבְטַחוֹ וְלֹא־פָנָה אֶל־רְהָבִים וְשָׂטֵי כָזָב׃
40.e: Happy is the man that hath made the LORD his trust, and hath not turned unto the arrogant, nor unto such as fall away treacherously.

40.s: רַבּוֹת עָשִׂיתָ אַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ אֵלֵינוּ אֵין עֲרֹךְ אֵלֶיךָ אַגִּידָה וַאֲדַבֵּרָה עָצְמוּ מִסַּפֵּר׃
40.e: Many things hast Thou done, O LORD my God, even Thy wonderful works, and Thy thoughts toward us; there is none to be compared unto Thee! If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be told.

40.s: זֶבַח וּמִנְחָה לֹא־חָפַצְתָּ אָזְנַיִם כָּרִיתָ לִּי עוֹלָה וַחֲטָאָה לֹא שָׁאָלְתָּ׃
40.e: Sacrifice and meal-offering Thou hast no delight in; mine ears hast Thou opened; burnt-offering and sin-offering hast Thou not required.

40.s: אָז אָמַרְתִּי הִנֵּה־בָאתִי בִּמְגִלַּת־סֵפֶר כָּתוּב עָלָי׃
40.e: Then said I: 'Lo, I am come with the roll of a book which is prescribed for me;

40.s: לַעֲשׂוֹת־רְצוֹנְךָ אֱלֹהַי חָפָצְתִּי וְתוֹרָתְךָ בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָי׃
40.e: I delight to do Thy will, O my God; yea, Thy law is in my inmost parts.'

40.s: בִּשַּׂרְתִּי צֶדֶק בְּקָהָל רָב הִנֵּה שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֶכְלָא יְהוָה אַתָּה יָדָעְתָּ׃
40.e: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation, Lo, I did not refrain my lips; O LORD, Thou knowest.

40.s: צִדְקָתְךָ לֹא־כִסִּיתִי בְּתוֹךְ לִבִּי אֱמוּנָתְךָ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ אָמָרְתִּי לֹא־כִחַדְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ לְקָהָל רָב׃
40.e: I have not hid Thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared Thy faithfulness and Thy salvation; I have not concealed Thy mercy and Thy truth from the great congregation.

40.s: אַתָּה יְהוָה לֹא־תִכְלָא רַחֲמֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי חַסְדְּךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ תָּמִיד יִצְּרוּנִי׃
40.e: Thou, O LORD, wilt not withhold Thy compassions from me; let Thy mercy and Thy truth continually preserve me.

40.s: כִּי אָפְפוּ־עָלַי רָעוֹת עַד־אֵין מִסְפָּר הִשִּׂיגוּנִי עֲוֺנֹתַי וְלֹא־יָכֹלְתִּי לִרְאוֹת עָצְמוּ מִשַּׂעֲרוֹת רֹאשִׁי וְלִבִּי עֲזָבָנִי׃
40.e: For innumerable evils have compassed me about, mine iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart hath failed me.

40.s: רְצֵה יְהוָה לְהַצִּילֵנִי יְהוָה לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה׃
40.e: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; O LORD, make haste to help me.

40.s: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ יַחַד מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי לִסְפּוֹתָהּ יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיִכָּלְמוּ חֲפֵצֵי רָעָתִי׃
40.e: Let them be ashamed and abashed together that seek after my soul to sweep it away; let them be turned backward and brought to confusion that delight in my hurt.

40.s: יָשֹׁמּוּ עַל־עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם הָאֹמְרִים לִי הֶאָח הֶאָח׃
40.e: Let them be appalled by reason of their shame that say unto me: 'Aha, aha.'

40.s: יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּל־מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ יֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהוָה אֹהֲבֵי תְּשׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
40.e: Let all those that seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee; let such as love Thy salvation say continually: 'The LORD be magnified.'

40.s: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אֲדֹנָי יַחֲשָׁב לִי עֶזְרָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי אַתָּה אֱלֹהַי אַל־תְּאַחַר׃
40.e: But, as for me, that am poor and needy, the Lord will account it unto me; Thou art my help and my deliverer; O my God, tarry not.

41.e: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.

41.s: אַשְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּיל אֶל־דָּל בְּיוֹם רָעָה יְמַלְּטֵהוּ יְהוָה׃
41.e: Happy is he that considereth the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.

41.s: יְהוָה יִשְׁמְרֵהוּ וִיחַיֵּהוּ יאשר [וְאֻשַּׁר] בָּאָרֶץ וְאַל־תִּתְּנֵהוּ בְּנֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבָיו׃
41.e: The LORD preserve him, and keep him alive, let him be called happy in the land; and deliver not Thou him unto the greed of his enemies.

41.s: יְהוָה יִסְעָדֶנּוּ עַל־עֶרֶשׂ דְּוָי כָּל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ הָפַכְתָּ בְחָלְיוֹ׃
41.e: The LORD support him upon the bed of illness; mayest Thou turn all his lying down in his sickness.

41.s: אֲ‍נִי־אָמַרְתִּי יְהוָה חָנֵּנִי רְפָאָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי־חָטָאתִי לָךְ׃
41.e: As for me, I said: 'O LORD, be gracious unto me; heal my soul; for I have sinned against Thee.'

41.s: אוֹיְבַי יֹאמְרוּ רַע לִי מָתַי יָמוּת וְאָבַד שְׁמוֹ׃
41.e: Mine enemies speak evil of me: 'When shall he die, and his name perish?'

41.s: וְאִם־בָּא לִרְאוֹת שָׁוְא יְדַבֵּר לִבּוֹ יִקְבָּץ־אָוֶן לוֹ יֵצֵא לַחוּץ יְדַבֵּר׃
41.e: And if one come to see me, he speaketh falsehood; His heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he speaketh of it.

41.s: יַחַד עָלַי יִתְלַחֲשׁוּ כָּל־שֹׂנְאָי עָלַי יַחְשְׁבוּ רָעָה לִי׃
41.e: All that hate me whisper together against me, against me do they devise my hurt:

41.s: דְּבַר־בְּלִיַּעַל יָצוּק בּוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר שָׁכַב לֹא־יוֹסִיף לָקוּם׃
41.e: 'An evil thing cleaveth fast unto him; and now that he lieth, he shall rise up no more.'

41.s: גַּם־אִישׁ שְׁלוֹמִי אֲשֶׁר־בָּטַחְתִּי בוֹ אוֹכֵל לַחְמִי הִגְדִּיל עָלַי עָקֵב׃
41.e: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who did eat of my bread, Hath lifted up his heel against me.

41.s: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה חָנֵּנִי וַהֲקִימֵנִי וַאֲשַׁלְּמָה לָהֶם׃
41.e: But Thou, O LORD, be gracious unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

41.s: בְּזֹאת יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־חָפַצְתָּ בִּי כִּי לֹא־יָרִיעַ אֹיְבִי עָלָי׃
41.e: By this I know that Thou delightest in me, that mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

41.s: וַאֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי תָּמַכְתָּ בִּי וַתַּצִּיבֵנִי לְפָנֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם׃
41.e: And as for me, Thou upholdest me because of mine integrity, and settest me before Thy face for ever.

41.s: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵהָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃
41.e: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

42.e: For the Leader; Maschil of the sons of Korah.

42.s: כְּאַיָּל תַּעֲרֹג עַל־אֲפִיקֵי־מָיִם כֵּן נַפְשִׁי תַעֲרֹג אֵלֶיךָ אֱלֹהִים׃
42.e: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after Thee, O God.

42.s: צָמְאָה נַפְשִׁי לֵאלֹהִים לְאֵל חָי מָתַי אָבוֹא וְאֵרָאֶה פְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃
42.e: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: 'When shall I come and appear before God?'

42.s: הָיְתָה־לִּי דִמְעָתִי לֶחֶם יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה בֶּאֱמֹר אֵלַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃
42.e: My tears have been my food day and night, while they say unto me all the day: 'Where is Thy God?'

42.s: אֵלֶּה אֶזְכְּרָה וְאֶשְׁפְּכָה עָלַי נַפְשִׁי כִּי אֶעֱבֹר בַּסָּךְ אֶדַּדֵּם עַד־בֵּית אֱלֹהִים בְּקוֹל־רִנָּה וְתוֹדָה הָמוֹן חוֹגֵג׃
42.e: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I passed on with the throng, and led them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping holyday.

42.s: מַה־תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וַתֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים כִּי־עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעוֹת פָּנָיו׃
42.e: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why moanest thou within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise Him for the salvation of His countenance.

42.s: אֱ‍לֹהַי עָלַי נַפְשִׁי תִשְׁתּוֹחָח עַל־כֵּן אֶזְכָּרְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ יַרְדֵּן וְחֶרְמוֹנִים מֵהַר מִצְעָר׃
42.e: O my God, my soul is cast down within me; therefore do I remember Thee from the land of Jordan, and the Hermons, from the hill Mizar.

42.s: תְּהוֹם־אֶל־תְּהוֹם קוֹרֵא לְקוֹל צִנּוֹרֶיךָ כָּל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ וְגַלֶּיךָ עָלַי עָבָרוּ׃
42.e: Deep calleth unto deep at the voice of Thy cataracts; all Thy waves and Thy billows are gone over me.

42.s: יוֹמָם יְצַוֶּה יְהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וּבַלַּיְלָה שירה [שִׁירוֹ] עִמִּי תְּפִלָּה לְאֵל חַיָּי׃
42.e: By day the LORD will command His lovingkindness, and in the night His song shall be with me, even a prayer unto the God of my life.

42.s: אוֹמְרָה לְאֵל סַלְעִי לָמָה שְׁכַחְתָּנִי לָמָּה־קֹדֵר אֵלֵךְ בְּלַחַץ אוֹיֵב׃
42.e: I will say unto God my Rock: 'Why hast Thou forgotten me? Why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?'

42.s: בְּרֶצַח בְּעַצְמוֹתַי חֵרְפוּנִי צוֹרְרָי בְּאָמְרָם אֵלַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃
42.e: As with a crushing in my bones, mine adversaries taunt me; while they say unto me all the day: 'Where is Thy God?'

42.s: מַה־תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וּמַה־תֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים כִּי־עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעֹת פָּנַי וֵאלֹהָי׃
42.e: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why moanest thou within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise Him, the salvation of my countenance, and my God.

43.s: שָׁפְטֵנִי אֱלֹהִים וְרִיבָה רִיבִי מִגּוֹי לֹא־חָסִיד מֵאִישׁ־מִרְמָה וְעַוְלָה תְפַלְּטֵנִי׃
43.e: Be Thou my judge, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

43.s: כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי מָעוּזִּי לָמָה זְנַחְתָּנִי לָמָּה־קֹדֵר אֶתְהַלֵּךְ בְּלַחַץ אוֹיֵב׃
43.e: For Thou art the God of my strength; why hast Thou cast me off? Why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?

43.s: שְׁלַח־אוֹרְךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ הֵמָּה יַנְחוּנִי יְבִיאוּנִי אֶל־הַר־קָדְשְׁךָ וְאֶל־מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ׃
43.e: O send out Thy light and Thy truth; let them lead me; Let them bring me unto Thy holy mountain, and to Thy dwelling-places.

43.s: וְאָבוֹאָה אֶל־מִזְבַּח אֱלֹהִים אֶל־אֵל שִׂמְחַת גִּילִי וְאוֹדְךָ בְכִנּוֹר אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהָי׃
43.e: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God, my exceeding joy; And praise Thee upon the harp, O God, my God.

43.s: מַה־תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וּמַה־תֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים כִּי־עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעֹת פָּנַי וֵאלֹהָי׃
43.e: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why moanest thou within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise Him, The salvation of my countenance, and my God.

44.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מַשְׂכִּיל׃
44.e: For the Leader; [a Psalm] of the sons of Korah. Maschil.

44.s: אֱלֹהִים בְּאָזְנֵינוּ שָׁמַעְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ פֹּעַל פָּעַלְתָּ בִימֵיהֶם בִּימֵי קֶדֶם׃
44.e: O God, we have heard with our ears, our fathers have told us; a work Thou didst in their days, in the days of old.

44.s: אַתָּה יָדְךָ גּוֹיִם הוֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵם תָּרַע לְאֻמִּים וַתְּשַׁלְּחֵם׃
44.e: Thou with Thy hand didst drive out the nations, and didst plant them in; Thou didst break the peoples, and didst spread them abroad.

44.s: כִּי לֹא בְחַרְבָּם יָרְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם לֹא־הוֹשִׁיעָה לָּמוֹ כִּי־יְמִינְךָ וּזְרוֹעֲךָ וְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ כִּי רְצִיתָם׃
44.e: For not by their own sword did they get the land in possession, Neither did their own arm save them; but Thy right hand, and Thine arm, and the light of Thy countenance, because Thou wast favourable unto them.

44.s: אַתָּה־הוּא מַלְכִּי אֱלֹהִים צַוֵּה יְשׁוּעוֹת יַעֲקֹב׃
44.e: Thou art my King, O God; command the salvation of Jacob.

44.s: בְּךָ צָרֵינוּ נְנַגֵּחַ בְּשִׁמְךָ נָבוּס קָמֵינוּ׃
44.e: Through Thee do we push down our adversaries; through Thy name do we tread them under that rise up against us.

44.s: כִּי לֹא בְקַשְׁתִּי אֶבְטָח וְחַרְבִּי לֹא תוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
44.e: For I trust not in my bow, neither can my sword save me.

44.s: כִּי הוֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵינוּ הֱבִישׁוֹתָ׃
44.e: But Thou hast saved us from our adversaries, and hast put them to shame that hate us.

44.s: בֵּאלֹהִים הִלַּלְנוּ כָל־הַיּוֹם וְשִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם נוֹדֶה סֶלָה׃
44.e: In God have we gloried all the day, and we will give thanks unto Thy name for ever. Selah

44.s: אַף־זָנַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵנוּ וְלֹא־תֵצֵא בְּצִבְאוֹתֵינוּ׃
44.e: Yet Thou hast cast off, and brought us to confusion; and goest not forth with our hosts.

44.s: תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ אָחוֹר מִנִּי־צָר וּמְשַׂנְאֵינוּ שָׁסוּ לָמוֹ׃
44.e: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary; and they that hate us spoil at their will.

44.s: תִּתְּנֵנוּ כְּצֹאן מַאֲכָל וּבַגּוֹיִם זֵרִיתָנוּ׃
44.e: Thou hast given us like sheep to be eaten; and hast scattered us among the nations.

44.s: תִּמְכֹּר־עַמְּךָ בְלֹא־הוֹן וְלֹא־רִבִּיתָ בִּמְחִירֵיהֶם׃
44.e: Thou sellest Thy people for small gain, and hast not set their prices high.

44.s: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ לַעַג וָקֶלֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵינוּ׃
44.e: Thou makest us a taunt to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

44.s: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ מָשָׁל בַּגּוֹיִם מְנוֹד־רֹאשׁ בַּל־אֻמִּים׃
44.e: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

44.s: כָּל־הַיּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִי נֶגְדִּי וּבֹשֶׁת פָּנַי כִּסָּתְנִי׃
44.e: All the day is my confusion before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

44.s: מִקּוֹל מְחָרֵף וּמְגַדֵּף מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב וּמִתְנַקֵּם׃
44.e: For the voice of him that taunteth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and the revengeful.

44.s: כָּל־זֹאת בָּאַתְנוּ וְלֹא שְׁכַחֲנוּךָ וְלֹא־שִׁקַּרְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶךָ׃
44.e: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten Thee, neither have we been false to Thy covenant.

44.s: לֹא־נָסוֹג אָחוֹר לִבֵּנוּ וַתֵּט אֲשֻׁרֵינוּ מִנִּי אָרְחֶךָ׃
44.e: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from Thy path;

44.s: כִּי דִכִּיתָנוּ בִּמְקוֹם תַּנִּים וַתְּכַס עָלֵינוּ בְצַלְמָוֶת׃
44.e: Though Thou hast crushed us into a place of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

44.s: אִם־שָׁכַחְנוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפֵּינוּ לְאֵל זָר׃
44.e: If we had forgotten the name of our God, or spread forth our hands to a strange god; .

44.s: הֲלֹא אֱלֹהִים יַחֲקָר־זֹאת כִּי־הוּא יֹדֵעַ תַּעֲלֻמוֹת לֵב׃
44.e: Would not God search this out? For He knoweth the secrets of the heart.

44.s: כִּי־עָלֶיךָ הֹרַגְנוּ כָל־הַיּוֹם נֶחְשַׁבְנוּ כְּצֹאן טִבְחָה׃
44.e: Nay, but for Thy sake are we killed all the day; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

44.s: עוּרָה לָמָּה תִישַׁן אֲדֹנָי הָקִיצָה אַל־תִּזְנַח לָנֶצַח׃
44.e: Awake, why sleepest Thou, O Lord? Arouse Thyself, cast not off for ever.

44.s: לָמָּה־פָנֶיךָ תַסְתִּיר תִּשְׁכַּח עָנְיֵנוּ וְלַחֲצֵנוּ׃
44.e: Wherefore hidest Thou Thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

44.s: כִּי שָׁחָה לֶעָפָר נַפְשֵׁנוּ דָּבְקָה לָאָרֶץ בִּטְנֵנוּ׃
44.e: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

44.s: קוּמָה עֶזְרָתָה לָּנוּ וּפְדֵנוּ לְמַעַן חַסְדֶּךָ׃
44.e: Arise for our help, and redeem us for Thy mercy's sake.

45.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שֹׁשַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מַשְׂכִּיל שִׁיר יְדִידֹת׃
45.e: For the Leader; upon Shoshannim; [a Psalm] of the sons of Korah. Maschil. A Song of loves.

45.s: רָחַשׁ לִבִּי דָּבָר טוֹב אֹמֵר אָנִי מַעֲשַׂי לְמֶלֶךְ לְשׁוֹנִי עֵט סוֹפֵר מָהִיר׃
45.e: My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter; I say: 'My work is concerning a king'; My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

45.s: יָפְיָפִיתָ מִבְּנֵי אָדָם הוּצַק חֵן בְּשְׂפְתוֹתֶיךָ עַל־כֵּן בֵּרַכְךָ אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָם׃
45.e: Thou art fairer than the children of men; Grace is poured upon thy lips; Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one, Thy glory and thy majesty.

45.s: וַהֲדָרְךָ צְלַח רְכַב עַל־דְּבַר־אֱמֶת וְעַנְוָה־צֶדֶק וְתוֹרְךָ נוֹרָאוֹת יְמִינֶךָ׃
45.e: And in thy majesty prosper, ride on, In behalf of truth and meekness and righteousness; And let thy right hand teach thee tremendous things.

45.s: חִצֶּיךָ שְׁנוּנִים עַמִּים תַּחְתֶּיךָ יִפְּלוּ בְּלֵב אוֹיְבֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
45.e: Thine arrows are sharp— The peoples fall under thee— [They sink] into the heart of the king's enemies.

45.s: כִּסְאֲךָ אֱלֹהִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד שֵׁבֶט מִישֹׁר שֵׁבֶט מַלְכוּתֶךָ׃
45.e: Thy throne given of God is for ever and ever; A sceptre of equity is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

45.s: אָהַבְתָּ צֶּדֶק וַתִּשְׂנָא רֶשַׁע עַל־כֵּן מְשָׁחֲךָ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן שָׂשׂוֹן מֵחֲבֵרֶיךָ׃
45.e: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness; Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

45.s: מֹר־וַאֲהָלוֹת קְצִיעוֹת כָּל־בִּגְדֹתֶיךָ מִן־הֵיכְלֵי שֵׁן מִנִּי שִׂמְּחוּךָ׃
45.e: Myrrh, and aloes, and cassia are all thy garments; Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.

45.s: בְּנוֹת מְלָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶיךָ נִצְּבָה שֵׁגַל לִימִינְךָ בְּכֶתֶם אוֹפִיר׃
45.e: Kings' daughters are among thy favourites; At thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

45.s: שִׁמְעִי־בַת וּרְאִי וְהַטִּי אָזְנֵךְ וְשִׁכְחִי עַמֵּךְ וּבֵית אָבִיךְ׃
45.e: 'Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; Forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;

45.s: וְיִתְאָו הַמֶּלֶךְ יָפְיֵךְ כִּי־הוּא אֲדֹנַיִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִי־לוֹ׃
45.e: So shall the king desire thy beauty; For he is thy lord; and do homage unto him. .

45.s: וּבַת־צֹר בְּמִנְחָה פָּנַיִךְ יְחַלּוּ עֲשִׁירֵי עָם׃
45.e: And, O daughter of Tyre, the richest of the people Shall entreat thy favour with a gift.'

45.s: כָּל־כְּבוּדָּה בַת־מֶלֶךְ פְּנִימָה מִמִּשְׁבְּצוֹת זָהָב לְבוּשָׁהּ׃
45.e: All glorious is the king's daughter within the palace; Her raiment is of chequer work inwrought with gold.

45.s: לִרְקָמוֹת תּוּבַל לַמֶּלֶךְ בְּתוּלוֹת אַחֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶיהָ מוּבָאוֹת לָךְ׃
45.e: She shall be led unto the king on richly woven stuff; The virgins her companions in her train being brought unto thee.

45.s: תּוּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹת וָגִיל תְּבֹאֶינָה בְּהֵיכַל מֶלֶךְ׃
45.e: They shall be led with gladness and rejoicing; They shall enter into the king's palace.

45.s: תַּחַת אֲבֹתֶיךָ יִהְיוּ בָנֶיךָ תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ לְשָׂרִים בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ׃
45.e: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy sons, Whom thou shalt make princes in all the land.

45.s: אַזְכִּירָה שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־דֹּר וָדֹר עַל־כֵּן עַמִּים יְהוֹדֻךָ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד׃
45.e: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations; Therefore shall the peoples praise thee for ever and ever.

46.e: For the Leader; [a Psalm] of the sons of Korah; upon Alamoth. A Song.

46.s: אֱלֹהִים לָנוּ מַחֲסֶה וָעֹז עֶזְרָה בְצָרוֹת נִמְצָא מְאֹד׃
46.e: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.

46.s: עַל־כֵּן לֹא־נִירָא בְּהָמִיר אָרֶץ וּבְמוֹט הָרִים בְּלֵב יַמִּים׃
46.e: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be moved into the heart of the seas;

46.s: יֶהֱמוּ יֶחְמְרוּ מֵימָיו יִרְעֲשׁוּ־הָרִים בְּגַאֲוָתוֹ סֶלָה׃
46.e: Though the waters thereof roar and foam, Though the mountains shake at the swelling thereof. Selah

46.s: נָהָר פְּלָגָיו יְשַׂמְּחוּ עִיר־אֱלֹהִים קְדֹשׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵי עֶלְיוֹן׃
46.e: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holiest dwelling-place of the Most High.

46.s: אֱלֹהִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ בַּל־תִּמּוֹט יַעְזְרֶהָ אֱלֹהִים לִפְנוֹת בֹּקֶר׃
46.e: God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved; God shall help her, at the approach of morning.

46.s: הָמוּ גוֹיִם מָטוּ מַמְלָכוֹת נָתַן בְּקוֹלוֹ תָּמוּג אָרֶץ׃
46.e: Nations were in tumult, kingdoms were moved; He uttered His voice, the earth melted.

46.s: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב־לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
46.e: The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our high tower. Selah

46.s: לְכוּ־חֲזוּ מִפְעֲלוֹת יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם שַׁמּוֹת בָּאָרֶץ׃
46.e: Come, behold the works of the LORD, Who hath made desolations in the earth.

46.s: מַשְׁבִּית מִלְחָמוֹת עַד־קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ קֶשֶׁת יְשַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּץ חֲנִית עֲגָלוֹת יִשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ׃
46.e: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariots in the fire.

46.s: הַרְפּוּ וּדְעוּ כִּי־אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהִים אָרוּם בַּגּוֹיִם אָרוּם בָּאָרֶץ׃
46.e: 'Let be, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.'

46.s: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב־לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
46.e: The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our high tower. Selah

47.e: For the Leader; a Psalm for the sons of Korah.

47.s: כָּל־הָעַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־כָף הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים בְּקוֹל רִנָּה׃
47.e: O clap your hands, all ye peoples; shout unto God with the voice of triumph. .

47.s: כִּי־יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן נוֹרָא מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
47.e: For the LORD is most high, awful; a great King over all the earth.

47.s: יַדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּינוּ וּלְאֻמִּים תַּחַת רַגְלֵינוּ׃
47.e: He subdueth peoples under us, and nations under our feet.

47.s: יִבְחַר־לָנוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֶת גְּאוֹן יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר־אָהֵב סֶלָה׃
47.e: He chooseth our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob whom He loveth. Selah

47.s: עָלָה אֱלֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָה יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃
47.e: God is gone up amidst shouting, the LORD amidst the sound of the horn.

47.s: זַמְּרוּ אֱלֹהִים זַמֵּרוּ זַמְּרוּ לְמַלְכֵּנוּ זַמֵּרוּ׃
47.e: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

47.s: כִּי מֶלֶךְ כָּל־הָאָרֶץ אֱלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ מַשְׂכִּיל׃
47.e: For God is the King of all the earth; sing ye praises in a skilful song.

47.s: מָלַךְ אֱלֹהִים עַל־גּוֹיִם אֱלֹהִים יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא קָדְשׁוֹ׃
47.e: God reigneth over the nations; God sitteth upon His holy throne.

47.s: נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים נֶאֱסָפוּ עַם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם כִּי לֵאלֹהִים מָגִנֵּי־אֶרֶץ מְאֹד נַעֲלָה׃
47.e: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham; for unto God belong the shields of the earth; He is greatly exalted.

48.e: A Song; a Psalm of the sons of Korah.

48.s: גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַר־קָדְשׁוֹ׃
48.e: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised, In the city of our God, His holy mountain,

48.s: יְפֵה נוֹף מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל־הָאָרֶץ הַר־צִיּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן קִרְיַת מֶלֶךְ רָב׃
48.e: Fair in situation, the joy of the whole earth; Even mount Zion, the uttermost parts of the north, The city of the great King.
God in her palaces Hath made Himself known for a stronghold.
For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, They came onward together.

48.s: הֵמָּה רָאוּ כֵּן תָּמָהוּ נִבְהֲלוּ נֶחְפָּזוּ׃
48.e: They saw, straightway they were amazed; They were affrighted, they hasted away.
Trembling took hold of them there, Pangs, as of a woman in travail.
With the east wind Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish.

48.s: כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ כֵּן רָאִינוּ בְּעִיר־יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֱלֹהִים יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עַד־עוֹלָם סֶלָה׃
48.e: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God— God establish it for ever. Selah
We have thought on Thy lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of Thy temple.

48.s: כְּשִׁמְךָ אֱלֹהִים כֵּן תְּהִלָּתְךָ עַל־קַצְוֵי־אֶרֶץ צֶדֶק מָלְאָה יְמִינֶךָ׃
48.e: As is Thy name, O God, So is Thy praise unto the ends of the earth; Thy right hand is full of righteousness.

48.s: יִשְׂמַח הַר־צִיּוֹן תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ׃
48.e: Let mount Zion be glad, Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of Thy judgments.
Walk about Zion, and go round about her; Count the towers thereof.

48.s: שִׁיתוּ לִבְּכֶם לְחֵילָה פַּסְּגוּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ לְמַעַן תְּסַפְּרוּ לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן׃
48.e: Mark ye well her ramparts, Traverse her palaces; That ye may tell it to the generation following. .

48.s: כִּי זֶה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָם וָעֶד הוּא יְנַהֲגֵנוּ עַל־מוּת׃
48.e: For such is God, our God, for ever and ever; He will guide us eternally.

49.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃
49.e: For the Leader; a Psalm for the sons of Korah.

49.s: שִׁמְעוּ־זֹאת כָּל־הָעַמִּים הַאֲזִינוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי חָלֶד׃
49.e: Hear this, all ye peoples; Give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world,

49.s: גַּם־בְּנֵי אָדָם גַּם־בְּנֵי־אִישׁ יַחַד עָשִׁיר וְאֶבְיוֹן׃
49.e: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.

49.s: פִּי יְדַבֵּר חָכְמוֹת וְהָגוּת לִבִּי תְבוּנוֹת׃
49.e: My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart shall be understanding.

49.s: אַטֶּה לְמָשָׁל אָזְנִי אֶפְתַּח בְּכִנּוֹר חִידָתִי׃
49.e: I will incline mine ear to a parable; I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

49.s: לָמָּה אִירָא בִּימֵי רָע עֲוֺן עֲקֵבַי יְסוּבֵּנִי׃
49.e: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my supplanters compasseth me about,

49.s: הַבֹּטְחִים עַל־חֵילָם וּבְרֹב עָשְׁרָם יִתְהַלָּלוּ׃
49.e: Of them that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches?

49.s: אָח לֹא־פָדֹה יִפְדֶּה אִישׁ לֹא־יִתֵּן לֵאלֹהִים כָּפְרוֹ׃
49.e: No man can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him—

49.s: וְיֵקַר פִּדְיוֹן נַפְשָׁם וְחָדַל לְעוֹלָם׃
49.e: For too costly is the redemption of their soul, and must be let alone for ever—

49.s: וִיחִי־עוֹד לָנֶצַח לֹא יִרְאֶה הַשָּׁחַת׃
49.e: That he should still live always, that he should not see the pit.

49.s: כִּי יִרְאֶה חֲכָמִים יָמוּתוּ יַחַד כְּסִיל וָבַעַר יֹאבֵדוּ וְעָזְבוּ לַאֲחֵרִים חֵילָם׃
49.e: For he seeth that wise men die, The fool and the brutish together perish, And leave their wealth to others.

49.s: קִרְבָּם בָּתֵּימוֹ לְעוֹלָם מִשְׁכְּנֹתָם לְדֹר וָדֹר קָרְאוּ בִשְׁמוֹתָם עֲלֵי אֲדָמוֹת׃
49.e: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, And their dwelling-places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.

49.s: וְאָדָם בִּיקָר בַּל־יָלִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּהֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ׃
49.e: But man abideth not in honour; He is like the beasts that perish.

49.s: זֶה דַרְכָּם כֵּסֶל לָמוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם בְּפִיהֶם יִרְצוּ סֶלָה׃
49.e: This is the way of them that are foolish, and of those who after them approve their sayings. Selah

49.s: כַּצֹּאן לִשְׁאוֹל שַׁתּוּ מָוֶת יִרְעֵם וַיִּרְדּוּ בָם יְשָׁרִים לַבֹּקֶר וצירם [וְצוּרָם] לְבַלּוֹת שְׁאוֹל מִזְּבֻל לוֹ׃
49.e: Like sheep they are appointed for the nether-world; death shall be their shepherd; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; And their form shall be for the nether-world to wear away, That there be no habitation for it.

49.s: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִים יִפְדֶּה נַפְשִׁי מִיַּד־שְׁאוֹל כִּי יִקָּחֵנִי סֶלָה׃
49.e: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the nether-world; For He shall receive me. Selah

49.s: אַל־תִּירָא כִּי־יַעֲשִׁר אִישׁ כִּי־יִרְבֶּה כְּבוֹד בֵּיתוֹ׃
49.e: Be not thou afraid when one waxeth rich, When the wealth of his house is increased;

49.s: כִּי לֹא בְמוֹתוֹ יִקַּח הַכֹּל לֹא־יֵרֵד אַחֲרָיו כְּבוֹדוֹ׃
49.e: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away; His wealth shall not descend after him.

49.s: כִּי־נַפְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּיו יְבָרֵךְ וְיוֹדֻךָ כִּי־תֵיטִיב לָךְ׃
49.e: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: 'Men will praise thee, when thou shalt do well to thyself';

49.s: תָּבוֹא עַד־דּוֹר אֲבוֹתָיו עַד־נֵצַח לֹא יִרְאוּ־אוֹר׃
49.e: It shall go to the generation of his fathers; They shall never see the light. .

49.s: אָדָם בִּיקָר וְלֹא יָבִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּהֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ׃
49.e: Man that is in honour understandeth not; He is like the beasts that perish.

50.s: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֵל אֱ‍לֹהִים יְהוָה דִּבֶּר וַיִּקְרָא־אָרֶץ מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד־מְבֹאוֹ׃
50.e: A Psalm of Asaph. God, God, the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth From the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

50.s: מִצִּיּוֹן מִכְלַל־יֹפִי אֱלֹהִים הוֹפִיעַ׃
50.e: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined forth.

50.s: יָבֹא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאַל־יֶחֱרַשׁ אֵשׁ־לְפָנָיו תֹּאכֵל וּסְבִיבָיו נִשְׂעֲרָה מְאֹד׃
50.e: Our God cometh, and doth not keep silence; a fire devoureth before Him, And round about Him it stormeth mightily.

50.s: יִקְרָא אֶל־הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָל וְאֶל־הָאָרֶץ לָדִין עַמּוֹ׃
50.e: He calleth to the heavens above, and to the earth, that He may judge His people:

50.s: אִסְפוּ־לִי חֲסִידָי כֹּרְתֵי בְרִיתִי עֲלֵי־זָבַח׃
50.e: 'Gather My saints together unto Me; those that have made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.'

50.s: וַיַּגִּידוּ שָׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפֵט הוּא סֶלָה׃
50.e: And the heavens declare His righteousness; for God, He is judge. Selah

50.s: שִׁמְעָה עַמִּי וַאֲדַבֵּרָה יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִידָה בָּךְ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֶיךָ אָנֹכִי׃
50.e: 'Hear, O My people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: God, thy God, am I.

50.s: לֹא עַל־זְבָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶיךָ לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃
50.e: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices; and thy burnt-offerings are continually before Me.

50.s: לֹא־אֶקַּח מִבֵּיתְךָ פָר מִמִּכְלְאֹתֶיךָ עַתּוּדִים׃
50.e: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he-goats out of thy folds.

50.s: כִּי־לִי כָל־חַיְתוֹ־יָעַר בְּהֵמוֹת בְּהַרְרֵי־אָלֶף׃
50.e: For every beast of the forest is Mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

50.s: יָדַעְתִּי כָּל־עוֹף הָרִים וְזִיז שָׂדַי עִמָּדִי׃
50.e: I know all the fowls of the mountains; and the wild beasts of the field are Mine.

50.s: אִם־אֶרְעַב לֹא־אֹמַר לָךְ כִּי־לִי תֵבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ׃
50.e: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee; for the world is Mine, and the fulness thereof.

50.s: הַאוֹכַל בְּשַׂר אַבִּירִים וְדַם עַתּוּדִים אֶשְׁתֶּה׃
50.e: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

50.s: זְבַח לֵאלֹהִים תּוֹדָה וְשַׁלֵּם לְעֶלְיוֹן נְדָרֶיךָ׃
50.e: Offer unto God the sacrifice of thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the Most High;

50.s: וּקְרָאֵנִי בְּיוֹם צָרָה אֲחַלֶּצְךָ וּתְכַבְּדֵנִי׃
50.e: And call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver thee, and thou shalt honour Me.'

50.s: וְלָרָשָׁע אָמַר אֱלֹהִים מַה־לְּךָ לְסַפֵּר חֻקָּי וַתִּשָּׂא בְרִיתִי עֲלֵי־פִיךָ׃
50.e: But unto the wicked God saith: 'What hast thou to do to declare My statutes, And that thou hast taken My covenant in thy mouth?

50.s: וְאַתָּה שָׂנֵאתָ מוּסָר וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ דְּבָרַי אַחֲרֶיךָ׃
50.e: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest My words behind thee.

50.s: אִם־רָאִיתָ גַנָּב וַתִּרֶץ עִמּוֹ וְעִם מְנָאֲפִים חֶלְקֶךָ׃
50.e: When thou sawest a thief, thou hadst company with him, and with adulterers was thy portion.

50.s: פִּיךָ שָׁלַחְתָּ בְרָעָה וּלְשׁוֹנְךָ תַּצְמִיד מִרְמָה׃
50.e: Thou hast let loose thy mouth for evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit. .

50.s: תֵּשֵׁב בְּאָחִיךָ תְדַבֵּר בְּבֶן־אִמְּךָ תִּתֶּן־דֹּפִי׃
50.e: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; Thou slanderest thine own mother's son.

50.s: אֵלֶּה עָשִׂיתָ וְהֶחֱרַשְׁתִּי דִּמִּיתָ הֱיוֹת־אֶהְיֶה כָמוֹךָ אוֹכִיחֲךָ וְאֶעֶרְכָה לְעֵינֶיךָ׃
50.e: These things hast thou done, and should I have kept silence? Thou hadst thought that I was altogether such a one as thyself; but I will reprove thee, and set the cause before thine eyes.

50.s: בִּינוּ־נָא זֹאת שֹׁכְחֵי אֱלוֹהַּ פֶּן־אֶטְרֹף וְאֵין מַצִּיל׃
50.e: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

50.s: זֹבֵחַ תּוֹדָה יְכַבְּדָנְנִי וְשָׂם דֶּרֶךְ אַרְאֶנּוּ בְּיֵשַׁע אֱלֹהִים׃
50.e: Whoso offereth the sacrifice of thanksgiving honoureth Me; and to him that ordereth his way aright Will I show the salvation of God.'

51.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
51.e: For the Leader. A Psalm of David;

51.s: בְּבוֹא־אֵלָיו נָתָן הַנָּבִיא כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֶל־בַּת־שָׁבַע׃
51.e: when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba.

51.s: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים כְּחַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ מְחֵה פְשָׁעָי׃
51.e: Be gracious unto me, O God, according to Thy mercy; According to the multitude of Thy compassions blot out my transgressions.

51.s: הרבה [הֶרֶב] כַּבְּסֵנִי מֵעֲוֺנִי וּמֵחַטָּאתִי טַהֲרֵנִי׃
51.e: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.

51.s: כִּי־פְשָׁעַי אֲנִי אֵדָע וְחַטָּאתִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃
51.e: For I know my transgressions; And my sin is ever before me.

51.s: לְךָ לְבַדְּךָ חָטָאתִי וְהָרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי לְמַעַן תִּצְדַּק בְּדָבְרֶךָ תִּזְכֶּה בְשָׁפְטֶךָ׃
51.e: Against Thee, Thee only, have I sinned, And done that which is evil in Thy sight; That Thou mayest be justified when Thou speakest, And be in the right when Thou judgest.

51.s: הֵן־בְּעָווֹן חוֹלָלְתִּי וּבְחֵטְא יֶחֱמַתְנִי אִמִּי׃
51.e: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, and in sin did my mother conceive me.

51.s: הֵן־אֱמֶת חָפַצְתָּ בַטֻּחוֹת וּבְסָתֻם חָכְמָה תוֹדִיעֵנִי׃
51.e: Behold, Thou desirest truth in the inward parts; make me, therefore, to know wisdom in mine inmost heart.

51.s: תְּחַטְּאֵנִי בְאֵזוֹב וְאֶטְהָר תְּכַבְּסֵנִי וּמִשֶּׁלֶג אַלְבִּין׃
51.e: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

51.s: תַּשְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה תָּגֵלְנָה עֲצָמוֹת דִּכִּיתָ׃
51.e: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which Thou hast crushed may rejoice.

51.s: הַסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאָי וְכָל־עֲוֺנֹתַי מְחֵה׃
51.e: Hide Thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

51.s: לֵב טָהוֹר בְּרָא־לִי אֱלֹהִים וְרוּחַ נָכוֹן חַדֵּשׁ בְּקִרְבִּי׃
51.e: Create me a clean heart, O God; and renew a stedfast spirit within me.

51.s: אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְרוּחַ קָדְשְׁךָ אַל־תִּקַּח מִמֶּנִּי׃
51.e: Cast me not away from Thy presence; and take not Thy holy spirit from me.

51.s: הָשִׁיבָה לִּי שְׂשׂוֹן יִשְׁעֶךָ וְרוּחַ נְדִיבָה תִסְמְכֵנִי׃
51.e: Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation; and let a willing spirit uphold me.

51.s: אֲלַמְּדָה פֹשְׁעִים דְּרָכֶיךָ וְחַטָּאִים אֵלֶיךָ יָשׁוּבוּ׃
51.e: Then will I teach transgressors Thy ways; and sinners shall return unto Thee. .

51.s: הַצִּילֵנִי מִדָּמִים אֱ‍לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי תְּשׁוּעָתִי תְּרַנֵּן לְשׁוֹנִי צִדְקָתֶךָ׃
51.e: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, Thou God of my salvation; so shall my tongue sing aloud of Thy righteousness.

51.s: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃
51.e: O Lord, open Thou my lips; and my mouth shall declare Thy praise.

51.s: כִּי לֹא־תַחְפֹּץ זֶבַח וְאֶתֵּנָה עוֹלָה לֹא תִרְצֶה׃
51.e: For Thou delightest not in sacrifice, else would I give it; Thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.

51.s: זִבְחֵי אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ נִשְׁבָּרָה לֵב־נִשְׁבָּר וְנִדְכֶּה אֱלֹהִים לֹא תִבְזֶה׃
51.e: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.

51.s: הֵיטִיבָה בִרְצוֹנְךָ אֶת־צִיּוֹן תִּבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
51.e: Do good in Thy favour unto Zion; build Thou the walls of Jerusalem.

51.s: אָז תַּחְפֹּץ זִבְחֵי־צֶדֶק עוֹלָה וְכָלִיל אָז יַעֲלוּ עַל־מִזְבַּחֲךָ פָרִים׃
51.e: Then wilt Thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt-offering and whole offering; Then will they offer bullocks upon Thine altar.

52.e: For the Leader. Maschil of David;

52.s: בְּבוֹא דּוֹאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי וַיַּגֵּד לְשָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בָּא דָוִד אֶל־בֵּית אֲחִימֶלֶךְ׃
52.e: when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him: 'David is come to the house of Ahimelech.'

52.s: מַה־תִּתְהַלֵּל בְּרָעָה הַגִּבּוֹר חֶסֶד אֵל כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
52.e: Why boastest thou thyself of evil, O mighty man? The mercy of God endureth continually.

52.s: הַוּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁב לְשׁוֹנֶךָ כְּתַעַר מְלֻטָּשׁ עֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּה׃
52.e: Thy tongue deviseth destruction; Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

52.s: אָהַבְתָּ רָּע מִטּוֹב שֶׁקֶר מִדַּבֵּר צֶדֶק סֶלָה׃
52.e: Thou lovest evil more than good; Falsehood rather than speaking righteousness. Selah
Thou lovest all devouring words, The deceitful tongue.

52.s: גַּם־אֵל יִתָּצְךָ לָנֶצַח יַחְתְּךָ וְיִסָּחֲךָ מֵאֹהֶל וְשֵׁרֶשְׁךָ מֵאֶרֶץ חַיִּים סֶלָה׃
52.e: God will likewise break thee for ever, He will take thee up, and pluck thee out of thy tent, And root thee out of the land of the living. Selah
The righteous also shall see, and fear, And shall laugh at him:

52.s: הִנֵּה הַגֶּבֶר לֹא יָשִׂים אֱלֹהִים מָעוּזּוֹ וַיִּבְטַח בְּרֹב עָשְׁרוֹ יָעֹז בְּהַוָּתוֹ׃
52.e: 'Lo, this is the man that made not God his stronghold; But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness.'

52.s: וַאֲנִי כְּזַיִת רַעֲנָן בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי בְחֶסֶד־אֱלֹהִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
52.e: But as for me, I am like a leafy olive-tree in the house of God; I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

52.s: אוֹדְךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי עָשִׂיתָ וַאֲקַוֶּה שִׁמְךָ כִי־טוֹב נֶגֶד חֲסִידֶיךָ׃
52.e: I will give Thee thanks for ever, because Thou hast done it; And I will wait for Thy name, for it is good, in the presence of Thy saints.

53.e: For the Leader; upon Mahalath. Maschil of David.

53.s: אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ אֵין אֱלֹהִים הִשְׁחִיתוּ וְהִתְעִיבוּ עָוֶל אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב׃
53.e: The fool hath said in his heart: 'There is no God'; They have dealt corruptly, and have done abominable iniquity; There is none that doeth good.

53.s: אֱ‍לֹהִים מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁקִיף עַל־בְּנֵי אָדָם לִרְאוֹת הֲיֵשׁ מַשְׂכִּיל דֹּרֵשׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים׃
53.e: God looked forth from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any man of understanding, that did seek after God.

53.s: כֻּלּוֹ סָג יַחְדָּו נֶאֱלָחוּ אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב אֵין גַּם־אֶחָד׃
53.e: Every one of them is unclean, they are together become impure; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.

53.s: הֲלֹא יָדְעוּ פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן אֹכְלֵי עַמִּי אָכְלוּ לֶחֶם אֱלֹהִים לֹא קָרָאוּ׃
53.e: ’Shall not the workers of iniquity know it, Who eat up My people as they eat bread, And call not upon God?'

53.s: שָׁם פָּחֲדוּ־פַחַד לֹא־הָיָה פָחַד כִּי־אֱלֹהִים פִּזַּר עַצְמוֹת חֹנָךְ הֱבִשֹׁתָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מְאָסָם׃
53.e: There are they in great fear, where no fear was; For God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee; Thou hast put them to shame, because God hath rejected them.

53.s: מִי יִתֵּן מִצִּיּוֹן יְשֻׁעוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשׁוּב אֱלֹהִים שְׁבוּת עַמּוֹ יָגֵל יַעֲקֹב יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
53.e: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God turneth the captivity of His people, Let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.

54.e: For the Leader; with string-music. Maschil of David:

54.s: בְּבוֹא הַזִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְשָׁאוּל הֲלֹא דָוִד מִסְתַּתֵּר עִמָּנוּ׃
54.e: when the Ziphites came and said to Saul: 'Doth not David hide himself with us?'
O God, save me by Thy name, And right me by Thy might.
O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.

54.s: כִּי זָרִים קָמוּ עָלַי וְעָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי לֹא שָׂמוּ אֱלֹהִים לְנֶגְדָּם סֶלָה׃
54.e: For strangers are risen up against me, And violent men have sought after my soul; They have not set God before them. Selah

54.s: הִנֵּה אֱלֹהִים עֹזֵר לִי אֲדֹנָי בְּסֹמְכֵי נַפְשִׁי׃
54.e: Behold, God is my helper; The Lord is for me as the upholder of my soul.
He will requite the evil unto them that lie in wait for me; Destroy Thou them in Thy truth.

54.s: בִּנְדָבָה אֶזְבְּחָה־לָּךְ אוֹדֶה שִּׁמְךָ יְהוָה כִּי־טוֹב׃
54.e: With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto Thee; I will give thanks unto Thy name, O LORD, for it is good.

54.s: כִּי מִכָּל־צָרָה הִצִּילָנִי וּבְאֹיְבַי רָאֲתָה עֵינִי׃
54.e: For He hath delivered me out of all trouble; And mine eye hath gazed upon mine enemies.

55.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד׃
55.e: For the Leader; with string-music. Maschil of David.

55.s: הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹהִים תְּפִלָּתִי וְאַל־תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתִי׃
55.e: Give ear, O God, to my prayer; And hide not Thyself from my supplication.

55.s: הַקְשִׁיבָה לִּי וַעֲנֵנִי אָרִיד בְּשִׂיחִי וְאָהִימָה׃
55.e: Attend unto me, and hear me; I am distraught in my complaint, and will moan;

55.s: מִקּוֹל אוֹיֵב מִפְּנֵי עָקַת רָשָׁע כִּי־יָמִיטוּ עָלַי אָוֶן וּבְאַף יִשְׂטְמוּנִי׃
55.e: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked; For they cast mischief upon me, and in anger they persecute me.

55.s: לִבִּי יָחִיל בְּקִרְבִּי וְאֵימוֹת מָוֶת נָפְלוּ עָלָי׃
55.e: My heart doth writhe within me; and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

55.s: יִרְאָה וָרַעַד יָבֹא בִי וַתְּכַסֵּנִי פַּלָּצוּת׃
55.e: Fear and trembling come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

55.s: וָאֹמַר מִי־יִתֶּן־לִּי אֵבֶר כַּיּוֹנָה אָעוּפָה וְאֶשְׁכֹּנָה׃
55.e: And I said: 'Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then would I fly away, and be at rest.

55.s: הִנֵּה אַרְחִיק נְדֹד אָלִין בַּמִּדְבָּר סֶלָה׃
55.e: Lo, then would I wander far off, I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah

55.s: אָחִישָׁה מִפְלָט לִי מֵרוּחַ סֹעָה מִסָּעַר׃
55.e: I would haste me to a shelter from the stormy wind and tempest.'

55.s: בַּלַּע אֲדֹנָי פַּלַּג לְשׁוֹנָם כִּי־רָאִיתִי חָמָס וְרִיב בָּעִיר׃
55.e: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongue; For I have seen violence and strife in the city.

55.s: יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻהָ עַל־חוֹמֹתֶיהָ וְאָוֶן וְעָמָל בְּקִרְבָּהּ׃
55.e: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof; iniquity also and mischief are in the midst of it.

55.s: הַוּוֹת בְּקִרְבָּהּ וְלֹא־יָמִישׁ מֵרְחֹבָהּ תֹּךְ וּמִרְמָה׃
55.e: Wickedness is in the midst thereof; oppression and guile depart not from her broad place.

55.s: כִּי לֹא־אוֹיֵב יְחָרְפֵנִי וְאֶשָּׂא לֹא־מְשַׂנְאִי עָלַי הִגְדִּיל וְאֶסָּתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ׃
55.e: For it was not an enemy that taunted me, Then I could have borne it; Neither was it mine adversary that did magnify himself against me, Then I would have hid myself from him.

55.s: וְאַתָּה אֱנוֹשׁ כְּעֶרְכִּי אַלּוּפִי וּמְיֻדָּעִי׃
55.e: But it was thou, a man mine equal, My companion, and my familiar friend;

55.s: אֲשֶׁר יַחְדָּו נַמְתִּיק סוֹד בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים נְהַלֵּךְ בְּרָגֶשׁ׃
55.e: We took sweet counsel together, In the house of God we walked with the throng.

55.s: ישימות [יַשִּׁי] [מָוֶת ] עָלֵימוֹ יֵרְדוּ שְׁאוֹל חַיִּים כִּי־רָעוֹת בִּמְגוּרָם בְּקִרְבָּם׃
55.e: May He incite death against them, Let them go down alive into the nether-world; For evil is in their dwelling, and within them.

55.s: אֲנִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים אֶקְרָא וַיהוָה יוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
55.e: As for me, I will call upon God; And the LORD shall save me.

55.s: עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרַיִם אָשִׂיחָה וְאֶהֱמֶה וַיִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי׃
55.e: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I complain, and moan; And He hath heard my voice.

55.s: פָּדָה בְשָׁלוֹם נַפְשִׁי מִקֲּרָב־לִי כִּי־בְרַבִּים הָיוּ עִמָּדִי׃
55.e: He hath redeemed my soul in peace so that none came nigh me; For they were many that strove with me.

55.s: יִשְׁמַע אֵל וְיַעֲנֵם וְיֹשֵׁב קֶדֶם סֶלָה אֲשֶׁר אֵין חֲלִיפוֹת לָמוֹ וְלֹא יָרְאוּ אֱלֹהִים׃
55.e: God shall hear, and humble them, even He that is enthroned of old, Selah, such as have no changes, and fear not God.

55.s: שָׁלַח יָדָיו בִּשְׁלֹמָיו חִלֵּל בְּרִיתוֹ׃
55.e: He hath put forth his hands against them that were at peace with him; He hath profaned his covenant.

55.s: חָלְקוּ מַחְמָאֹת פִּיו וּקֲרָב־לִבּוֹ רַכּוּ דְבָרָיו מִשֶּׁמֶן וְהֵמָּה פְתִחוֹת׃
55.e: Smoother than cream were the speeches of his mouth, But his heart was war; His words were softer than oil, Yet were they keen-edged swords.

55.s: הַשְׁלֵךְ עַל־יְהוָה יְהָבְךָ וְהוּא יְכַלְכְּלֶךָ לֹא־יִתֵּן לְעוֹלָם מוֹט לַצַּדִּיק׃
55.e: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and He will sustain thee; He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.

55.s: וְאַתָּה אֱלֹהִים תּוֹרִדֵם לִבְאֵר שַׁחַת אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים וּמִרְמָה לֹא־יֶחֱצוּ יְמֵיהֶם וַאֲנִי אֶבְטַח־בָּךְ׃
55.e: But Thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the nethermost pit; Men of blood and deceit shall not live out half their days; But as for me, I will trust in Thee.

56.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־יוֹנַת אֵלֶם רְחֹקִים לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בֶּאֱחֹז אֹתוֹ פְלִשְׁתִּים בְּגַת׃
56.e: For the Leader; upon Jonath-elem-rehokim. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam; when the Philistines took him in Gath. .

56.s: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים כִּי־שְׁאָפַנִי אֱנוֹשׁ כָּל־הַיּוֹם לֹחֵם יִלְחָצֵנִי׃
56.e: Be gracious unto me, O God, for man would swallow me up; All the day he fighting oppresseth me.

56.s: שָׁאֲפוּ שׁוֹרְרַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם כִּי־רַבִּים לֹחֲמִים לִי מָרוֹם׃
56.e: They that lie in wait for me would swallow me up all the day; For they are many that fight against me, O Most High,
In the day that I am afraid, I will put my trust in Thee.

56.s: בֵּאלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּל דְּבָרוֹ בֵּאלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה בָשָׂר לִי׃
56.e: In God—I will praise His word— In God do I trust, I will not be afraid; What can flesh do unto me?

56.s: כָּל־הַיּוֹם דְּבָרַי יְעַצֵּבוּ עָלַי כָּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָם לָרָע׃
56.e: All the day they trouble mine affairs; All their thoughts are against me for evil.

56.s: יָגוּרוּ יצפינו [יִצְפּוֹנוּ] הֵמָּה עֲקֵבַי יִשְׁמֹרוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר קִוּוּ נַפְשִׁי׃
56.e: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, They mark my steps; According as they have waited for my soul.

56.s: עַל־אָוֶן פַּלֶּט־לָמוֹ בְּאַף עַמִּים הוֹרֵד אֱלֹהִים׃
56.e: Because of iniquity cast them out; In anger bring down the peoples, O God.

56.s: נֹדִי סָפַרְתָּה אָתָּה שִׂימָה דִמְעָתִי בְנֹאדֶךָ הֲלֹא בְּסִפְרָתֶךָ׃
56.e: Thou has counted my wanderings; Put Thou my tears into Thy bottle; Are they not in Thy book?

56.s: אָז יָשׁוּבוּ אוֹיְבַי אָחוֹר בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא זֶה־יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־אֱלֹהִים לִי׃
56.e: Then shall mine enemies turn back in the day that I call; This I know, that God is for me.

56.s: בֵּאלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּל דָּבָר בַּיהוָה אֲהַלֵּל דָּבָר׃
56.e: In God—I will praise His word— In the LORD—I will praise His word—

56.s: בֵּאלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה אָדָם לִי׃
56.e: In God do I trust, I will not be afraid; What can man do unto me?

56.s: עָלַי אֱלֹהִים נְדָרֶיךָ אֲשַׁלֵּם תּוֹדֹת לָךְ׃
56.e: Thy vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank-offerings unto Thee.

56.s: כִּי הִצַּלְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּוֶת הֲלֹא רַגְלַי מִדֶּחִי לְהִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים בְּאוֹר הַחַיִּים׃
56.e: For thou hast delivered my soul from death; Hast Thou not delivered my feet from stumbling? That I may walk before God in the light of the living?

57.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בְּבָרְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי־שָׁאוּל בַּמְּעָרָה׃
57.e: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam; when he fled from Saul, in the cave.

57.s: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים חָנֵּנִי כִּי בְךָ חָסָיָה נַפְשִׁי וּבְצֵל־כְּנָפֶיךָ אֶחְסֶה עַד יַעֲבֹר הַוּוֹת׃
57.e: Be gracious unto me, O God, be gracious unto me, for in Thee hath my soul taken refuge; yea, in the shadow of Thy wings will I take refuge, until calamities be overpast.

57.s: אֶקְרָא לֵאלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן לָאֵל גֹּמֵר עָלָי׃
57.e: I will cry unto God Most high; unto God that accomplisheth it for me.

57.s: יִשְׁלַח מִשָּׁמַיִם וְיוֹשִׁיעֵנִי חֵרֵף שֹׁאֲפִי סֶלָה יִשְׁלַח אֱלֹהִים חַסְדּוֹ וַאֲמִתּוֹ׃
57.e: He will send from heaven, and save me, when he that would swallow me up taunteth, Selah; God shall send forth His mercy and His truth.

57.s: נַפְשִׁי בְּתוֹךְ לְבָאִם אֶשְׁכְּבָה לֹהֲטִים בְּנֵי־אָדָם שִׁנֵּיהֶם חֲנִית וְחִצִּים וּלְשׁוֹנָם חֶרֶב חַדָּה׃
57.e: My soul is among lions, I do lie down among them that are aflame; Even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue a sharp sword.

57.s: רוּמָה עַל־הַשָּׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
57.e: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Thy glory be above all the earth.

57.s: רֶשֶׁת הֵכִינוּ לִפְעָמַי כָּפַף נַפְשִׁי כָּרוּ לְפָנַי שִׁיחָה נָפְלוּ בְתוֹכָהּ סֶלָה׃
57.e: They have prepared a net for my steps, My soul is bowed down; They have digged a pit before me, They are fallen into the midst thereof themselves. Selah

57.s: נָכוֹן לִבִּי אֱלֹהִים נָכוֹן לִבִּי אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמֵּרָה׃
57.e: My heart is stedfast, O God, my heart is stedfast; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises.

57.s: עוּרָה כְבוֹדִי עוּרָה הַנֵּבֶל וְכִנּוֹר אָעִירָה שָּׁחַר׃
57.e: Awake, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake the dawn.
I will give thanks unto Thee, O Lord, among the peoples; I will sing praises unto Thee among the nations.
For Thy mercy is great unto the heavens, And Thy truth unto the skies.

57.s: רוּמָה עַל־שָׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
57.e: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Thy glory be above all the earth.

58.e: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam.

58.s: הַאֻמְנָם אֵלֶם צֶדֶק תְּדַבֵּרוּן מֵישָׁרִים תִּשְׁפְּטוּ בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
58.e: Do ye indeed speak as a righteous company? Do ye judge with equity the sons of men?

58.s: אַף־בְּלֵב עוֹלֹת תִּפְעָלוּן בָּאָרֶץ חֲמַס יְדֵיכֶם תְּפַלֵּסוּן׃
58.e: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; Ye weigh out in the earth the violence of your hands.

58.s: זֹרוּ רְשָׁעִים מֵרָחֶם תָּעוּ מִבֶּטֶן דֹּבְרֵי כָזָב׃
58.e: The wicked are estranged from the womb; The speakers of lies go astray as soon as they are born.

58.s: חֲמַת־לָמוֹ כִּדְמוּת חֲמַת־נָחָשׁ כְּמוֹ־פֶתֶן חֵרֵשׁ יַאְטֵם אָזְנוֹ׃
58.e: Their venom is like the venom of a serpent; They are like the deaf asp that stoppeth her ear;

58.s: אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִשְׁמַע לְקוֹל מְלַחֲשִׁים חוֹבֵר חֲבָרִים מְחֻכָּם׃
58.e: Which hearkeneth not to the voice of charmers, Or of the most cunning binder of spells.

58.s: אֱ‍לֹהִים הֲרָס־שִׁנֵּימוֹ בְּפִימוֹ מַלְתְּעוֹת כְּפִירִים נְתֹץ יְהוָה׃
58.e: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth; Break out the cheek-teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

58.s: יִמָּאֲסוּ כְמוֹ־מַיִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ־לָמוֹ יִדְרֹךְ חצו [חִצָּיו] כְּמוֹ יִתְמֹלָלוּ׃
58.e: Let them melt away as water that runneth apace; When he aimeth his arrows, let them be as though they were cut off.

58.s: כְּמוֹ שַׁבְּלוּל תֶּמֶס יַהֲלֹךְ נֵפֶל אֵשֶׁת בַּל־חָזוּ שָׁמֶשׁ׃
58.e: Let them be as a snail which melteth and passeth away; Like the untimely births of a woman, that have not seen the sun.

58.s: בְּטֶרֶם יָבִינוּ סִּירֹתֵיכֶם אָטָד כְּמוֹ־חַי כְּמוֹ־חָרוֹן יִשְׂעָרֶנּוּ׃
58.e: Before your pots can feel the thorns, He will sweep it away with a whirlwind, the raw and the burning alike.

58.s: יִשְׂמַח צַדִּיק כִּי־חָזָה נָקָם פְּעָמָיו יִרְחַץ בְּדַם הָרָשָׁע׃
58.e: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance; He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

58.s: וְיֹאמַר אָדָם אַךְ־פְּרִי לַצַּדִּיק אַךְ יֵשׁ־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפְטִים בָּאָרֶץ׃
58.e: And men shall say: 'Verily there is a reward for the righteous; Verily there is a God that judgeth in the earth.'

59.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בִּשְׁלֹחַ שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁמְרוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃
59.e: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.
Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God; set me on high from them that rise up against me.

59.s: הַצִּילֵנִי מִפֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן וּמֵאַנְשֵׁי דָמִים הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
59.e: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from the men of blood.

59.s: כִּי הִנֵּה אָרְבוּ לְנַפְשִׁי יָגוּרוּ עָלַי עַזִים לֹא־פִשְׁעִי וְלֹא־חַטָּאתִי יְהוָה׃
59.e: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; the impudent gather themselves together against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.

59.s: בְּלִי־עָוֺן יְרוּצוּן וְיִכּוֹנָנוּ עוּרָה לִקְרָאתִי וּרְאֵה׃
59.e: Without my fault, they run and prepare themselves; awake Thou to help me, and behold.

59.s: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה־אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָקִיצָה לִפְקֹד כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם אַל־תָּחֹן כָּל־בֹּגְדֵי אָוֶן סֶלָה׃
59.e: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, arouse Thyself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to any iniquitous traitors. Selah

59.s: יָשׁוּבוּ לָעֶרֶב יֶהֱמוּ כַכָּלֶב וִיסוֹבְבוּ עִיר׃
59.e: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, and go round about the city.

59.s: הִנֵּה יַבִּיעוּן בְּפִיהֶם חֲרָבוֹת בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶם כִּי־מִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃
59.e: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; swords are in their lips: 'For who doth hear?'
But Thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; Thou shalt have all the nations in derision.
Because of his strength, I will wait for Thee; for God is my high tower.

59.s: אֱלֹהֵי חסדו [חַסְדִּי] יְקַדְּמֵנִי אֱלֹהִים יַרְאֵנִי בְשֹׁרְרָי׃
59.e: The God of my mercy will come to meet me; God will let me gaze upon mine adversaries.

59.s: אַל־תַּהַרְגֵם פֶּן־יִשְׁכְּחוּ עַמִּי הֲנִיעֵמוֹ בְחֵילְךָ וְהוֹרִידֵמוֹ מָגִנֵּנוּ אֲדֹנָי׃
59.e: Slay them not, lest my people forget, make them wander to and fro by Thy power, and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

59.s: חַטַּאת־פִּימוֹ דְּבַר־שְׂפָתֵימוֹ וְיִלָּכְדוּ בִגְאוֹנָם וּמֵאָלָה וּמִכַּחַשׁ יְסַפֵּרוּ׃
59.e: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them even be taken in their pride, and for cursing and lying which they speak.

59.s: כַּלֵּה בְחֵמָה כַּלֵּה וְאֵינֵמוֹ וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מֹשֵׁל בְּיַעֲקֹב לְאַפְסֵי הָאָרֶץ סֶלָה׃
59.e: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they be no more; and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob, unto the ends of the earth. Selah

59.s: וְיָשׁוּבוּ לָעֶרֶב יֶהֱמוּ כַכָּלֶב וִיסוֹבְבוּ עִיר׃
59.e: And they return at evening, they howl like a dog, and go round about the city;

59.s: הֵמָּה ינועון [יְנִיעוּן] לֶאֱכֹל אִם־לֹא יִשְׂבְּעוּ וַיָּלִינוּ׃
59.e: They wander up and down to devour, and tarry all night if they have not their fill.

59.s: וַאֲנִי אָשִׁיר עֻזֶּךָ וַאֲרַנֵּן לַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ כִּי־הָיִיתָ מִשְׂגָּב לִי וּמָנוֹס בְּיוֹם צַר־לִי׃
59.e: But as for me, I will sing of Thy strength; yea, I will sing aloud of Thy mercy in the morning; for Thou hast been my high tower, and a refuge in the day of my distress.

59.s: עֻזִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲזַמֵּרָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מִשְׂגַּבִּי אֱלֹהֵי חַסְדִּי׃
59.e: O my strength, unto Thee will I sing praises; for God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

60.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שׁוּשַׁן עֵדוּת מִכְתָּם לְדָוִד לְלַמֵּד׃
60.e: For the Leader; upon Shushan Eduth; Michtam of David, to teach;

60.s: בְּהַצּוֹתוֹ אֶת אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם וְאֶת־אֲרַם צוֹבָה וַיָּשָׁב יוֹאָב וַיַּךְ אֶת־אֱדוֹם בְּגֵיא־מֶלַח שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃
60.e: when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand.

60.s: אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ פְרַצְתָּנוּ אָנַפְתָּ תְּשׁוֹבֵב לָנוּ׃
60.e: O God, Thou hast cast us off, Thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; O restore us.

60.s: הִרְעַשְׁתָּה אֶרֶץ פְּצַמְתָּהּ רְפָה שְׁבָרֶיהָ כִי־מָטָה׃
60.e: Thou hast made the land to shake, Thou hast cleft it; Heal the breaches thereof; for it tottereth.

60.s: הִרְאִיתָה עַמְּךָ קָשָׁה הִשְׁקִיתָנוּ יַיִן תַּרְעֵלָה׃
60.e: Thou hast made Thy people to see hard things; Thou hast made us to drink the wine of staggering.

60.s: נָתַתָּה לִּירֵאֶיךָ נֵּס לְהִתְנוֹסֵס מִפְּנֵי קֹשֶׁט סֶלָה׃
60.e: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear Thee, That it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah

60.s: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ ועננו [וַעֲנֵנִי׃]
60.e: That Thy beloved may be delivered, Save with Thy right hand, and answer me.

60.s: אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ אֶעְלֹזָה אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּד׃
60.e: God spoke in His holiness, that I would exult; That I would divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

60.s: לִי גִלְעָד וְלִי מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם מָעוֹז רֹאשִׁי יְהוּדָה מְחֹקְקִי׃
60.e: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

60.s: מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי עַל־אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ נַעֲלִי עָלַי פְּלֶשֶׁת הִתְרֹעָעִי׃
60.e: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom do I cast my shoe; Philistia, cry aloud because of me!

60.s: מִי יֹבִלֵנִי עִיר מָצוֹר מִי נָחַנִי עַד־אֱדוֹם׃
60.e: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me unto Edom?

60.s: הֲלֹא־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ וְלֹא־תֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים בְּצִבְאוֹתֵינוּ׃
60.e: Hast not Thou, O God, cast us off? And Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

60.s: הָבָה־לָּנוּ עֶזְרָת מִצָּר וְשָׁוְא תְּשׁוּעַת אָדָם׃
60.e: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
Through God we shall do valiantly; For He it is that will tread down our adversaries.

61.e: For the Leader; with string-music. [A Psalm] of David.
Hear my cry, O God; Attend unto my prayer.

61.s: מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ אֵלֶיךָ אֶקְרָא בַּעֲטֹף לִבִּי בְּצוּר־יָרוּם מִמֶּנִּי תַנְחֵנִי׃
61.e: From the end of the earth will I call unto Thee, when my heart fainteth; Lead me to a rock that is too high for me.

61.s: כִּי־הָיִיתָ מַחְסֶה לִי מִגְדַּל־עֹז מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב׃
61.e: For Thou hast been a refuge for me, A tower of strength in the face of the enemy.
