61.s: אָגוּרָה בְאָהָלְךָ עוֹלָמִים אֶחֱסֶה בְסֵתֶר כְּנָפֶיךָ סֶּלָה׃
61.e: I will dwell in Thy Tent for ever; I will take refuge in the covert of Thy wings. Selah

61.s: כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים שָׁמַעְתָּ לִנְדָרָי נָתַתָּ יְרֻשַּׁת יִרְאֵי שְׁמֶךָ׃
61.e: For Thou, O God, hast heard my vows; Thou hast granted the heritage of those that fear Thy name. .

61.s: יָמִים עַל־יְמֵי־מֶלֶךְ תּוֹסִיף שְׁנוֹתָיו כְּמוֹ־דֹר וָדֹר׃
61.e: Mayest Thou add days unto the king's days! May his years be as many generations!

61.s: יֵשֵׁב עוֹלָם לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת מַן יִנְצְרֻהוּ׃
61.e: May he be enthroned before God for ever! Appoint mercy and truth, that they may preserve him.

61.s: כֵּן אֲזַמְּרָה שִׁמְךָ לָעַד לְשַׁלְּמִי נְדָרַי יוֹם יוֹם׃
61.e: So will I sing praise unto Thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows.

62.e: For the Leader; for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.

62.s: אַךְ אֶל־אֱלֹהִים דּוּמִיָּה נַפְשִׁי מִמֶּנּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִי׃
62.e: Only for God doth my soul wait in stillness; From Him cometh my salvation.

62.s: אַךְ־הוּא צוּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי לֹא־אֶמּוֹט רַבָּה׃
62.e: He only is my rock and my salvation, My high tower, I shall not be greatly moved.

62.s: עַד־אָנָה תְּהוֹתְתוּ עַל אִישׁ תְּרָצְּחוּ כֻלְּכֶם כְּקִיר נָטוּי גָּדֵר הַדְּחוּיָה׃
62.e: How long will ye set upon a man, That ye may slay him, all of you, As a leaning wall, a tottering fence?

62.s: אַךְ מִשְּׂאֵתוֹ יָעֲצוּ לְהַדִּיחַ יִרְצוּ כָזָב בְּפִיו יְבָרֵכוּ וּבְקִרְבָּם יְקַלְלוּ־סֶלָה׃
62.e: They only devise to thrust him down from his height, delighting in lies; They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah

62.s: אַךְ לֵאלֹהִים דּוֹמִּי נַפְשִׁי כִּי־מִמֶּנּוּ תִּקְוָתִי׃
62.e: Only for God wait thou in stillness, my soul; For from Him cometh my hope.

62.s: אַךְ־הוּא צוּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי לֹא אֶמּוֹט׃
62.e: He only is my rock and my salvation, My high tower, I shall not be moved.

62.s: עַל־אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁעִי וּכְבוֹדִי צוּר־עֻזִּי מַחְסִי בֵּאלֹהִים׃
62.e: Upon God resteth my salvation and my glory; The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

62.s: בִּטְחוּ בוֹ בְכָל־עֵת עָם שִׁפְכוּ־לְפָנָיו לְבַבְכֶם אֱלֹהִים מַחֲסֶה־לָּנוּ סֶלָה׃
62.e: Trust in Him at all times, ye people; Pour out your heart before Him; God is a refuge for us. Selah

62.s: אַךְ הֶבֶל בְּנֵי־אָדָם כָּזָב בְּנֵי אִישׁ בְּמֹאזְנַיִם לַעֲלוֹת הֵמָּה מֵהֶבֶל יָחַד׃
62.e: Men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie; If they be laid in the balances, they are together lighter than vanity.

62.s: אַל־תִּבְטְחוּ בְעֹשֶׁק וּבְגָזֵל אַל־תֶּהְבָּלוּ חַיִל כִּי־יָנוּב אַל־תָּשִׁיתוּ לֵב׃
62.e: Trust not in oppression, And put not vain hope in robbery; If riches increase, set not your heart thereon.

62.s: אַחַת דִּבֶּר אֱלֹהִים שְׁתַּיִם־זוּ שָׁמָעְתִּי כִּי עֹז לֵאלֹהִים׃
62.e: God hath spoken once, Twice have I heard this: That strength belongeth unto God;

62.s: וּלְךָ־אֲדֹנָי חָסֶד כִּי־אַתָּה תְשַׁלֵּם לְאִישׁ כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃
62.e: Also unto Thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy; For Thou renderest to every man according to his work.

63.e: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.

63.s: אֱלֹהִים אֵלִי אַתָּה אֲ‍שַׁחֲרֶךָּ צָמְאָה לְךָ נַפְשִׁי כָּמַהּ לְךָ בְשָׂרִי בְּאֶרֶץ־צִיָּה וְעָיֵף בְּלִי־מָיִם׃
63.e: O God, Thou art my God, earnestly will I seek Thee; My soul thirsteth for Thee, my flesh longeth for Thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.

63.s: כֵּן בַּקֹּדֶשׁ חֲזִיתִיךָ לִרְאוֹת עֻזְּךָ וּכְבוֹדֶךָ׃
63.e: So have I looked for Thee in the sanctuary, To see Thy power and Thy glory. .
For Thy lovingkindness is better than life; My lips shall praise Thee.

63.s: כֵּן אֲבָרֶכְךָ בְחַיָּי בְּשִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂא כַפָּי׃
63.e: So will I bless Thee as long as I live; In Thy name will I lift up my hands.

63.s: כְּמוֹ חֵלֶב וָדֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּע נַפְשִׁי וְשִׂפְתֵי רְנָנוֹת יְהַלֶּל־פִּי׃
63.e: My soul is satisfied as with marrow and fatness; And my mouth doth praise Thee with joyful lips;
When I remember Thee upon my couch, And meditate on Thee in the night-watches.

63.s: כִּי־הָיִיתָ עֶזְרָתָה לִּי וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן׃
63.e: For Thou hast been my help, And in the shadow of Thy wings do I rejoice.

63.s: דָּבְקָה נַפְשִׁי אַחֲרֶיךָ בִּי תָּמְכָה יְמִינֶךָ׃
63.e: My soul cleaveth unto Thee; Thy right hand holdeth me fast.

63.s: וְהֵמָּה לְשׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי יָבֹאוּ בְּתַחְתִּיּוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃
63.e: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, Shall go into the nethermost parts of the earth.
They shall be hurled to the power of the sword; They shall be a portion for foxes.

63.s: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ יִשְׂמַח בֵּאלֹהִים יִתְהַלֵּל כָּל־הַנִּשְׁבָּע בּוֹ כִּי יִסָּכֵר פִּי דוֹבְרֵי־שָׁקֶר׃
63.e: But the king shall rejoice in God; Every one that sweareth by Him shall glory; For the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

64.e: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.

64.s: שְׁמַע־אֱלֹהִים קוֹלִי בְשִׂיחִי מִפַּחַד אוֹיֵב תִּצֹּר חַיָּי׃
64.e: Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; preserve my life from the terror of the enemy.

64.s: תַּסְתִּירֵנִי מִסּוֹד מְרֵעִים מֵרִגְשַׁת פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
64.e: Hide me from the council of evil-doers; from the tumult of the workers of iniquity;

64.s: אֲשֶׁר שָׁנְנוּ כַחֶרֶב לְשׁוֹנָם דָּרְכוּ חִצָּם דָּבָר מָר׃
64.e: Who have whet their tongue like a sword, and have aimed their arrow, a poisoned word;

64.s: לִירוֹת בַּמִּסְתָּרִים תָּם פִּתְאֹם יֹרֻהוּ וְלֹא יִירָאוּ׃
64.e: That they may shoot in secret places at the blameless; suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

64.s: יְחַזְּקוּ־לָמוֹ דָּבָר רָע יְסַפְּרוּ לִטְמוֹן מוֹקְשִׁים אָמְרוּ מִי יִרְאֶה־לָּמוֹ׃
64.e: They encourage one another in an evil matter; they converse of laying snares secretly; they ask, who would see them.

64.s: יַחְפְּשׂוּ־עוֹלֹת תַּמְנוּ חֵפֶשׂ מְחֻפָּשׂ וְקֶרֶב אִישׁ וְלֵב עָמֹק׃
64.e: They search out iniquities, they have accomplished a diligent search; even in the inward thought of every one, and the deep heart.

64.s: וַיֹּרֵם אֱלֹהִים חֵץ פִּתְאוֹם הָיוּ מַכּוֹתָם׃
64.e: But God doth shoot at them with an arrow suddenly; thence are their wounds.

64.s: וַיַּכְשִׁילוּהוּ עָלֵימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָם יִתְנֹדֲדוּ כָּל־רֹאֵה בָם׃
64.e: So they make their own tongue a stumbling unto themselves; all that see them shake the head.

64.s: וַיִּירְאוּ כָּל־אָדָם וַיַּגִּידוּ פֹּעַל אֱלֹהִים וּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ הִשְׂכִּילוּ׃
64.e: And all men fear; and they declare the work of God, and understand His doing.

64.s: יִשְׂמַח צַדִּיק בַּיהוָה וְחָסָה בוֹ וְיִתְהַלְלוּ כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
64.e: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in Him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

65.e: For the Leader. A Psalm. A Song of David.

65.s: לְךָ דֻמִיָּה תְהִלָּה אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּוֹן וּלְךָ יְשֻׁלַּם־נֶדֶר׃
65.e: Praise waiteth for Thee, O God, in Zion; and unto Thee the vow is performed.
O Thou that hearest prayer, unto Thee doth all flesh come.

65.s: דִּבְרֵי עֲוֺנֹת גָּבְרוּ מֶנִּי פְּשָׁעֵינוּ אַתָּה תְכַפְּרֵם׃
65.e: The tale of iniquities is too heavy for me; as for our transgressions, Thou wilt pardon them.

65.s: אַשְׁרֵי תִּבְחַר וּתְקָרֵב יִשְׁכֹּן חֲצֵרֶיךָ נִשְׂבְּעָה בְּטוּב בֵּיתֶךָ קְדֹשׁ הֵיכָלֶךָ׃
65.e: Happy is the man whom Thou choosest, and bringest near, that he may dwell in Thy courts; may we be satisfied with the goodness of Thy house, the holy place of Thy temple!

65.s: נוֹרָאוֹת בְּצֶדֶק תַּעֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ מִבְטָח כָּל־קַצְוֵי־אֶרֶץ וְיָם רְחֹקִים׃
65.e: With wondrous works dost Thou answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation; Thou the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of the far distant seas;
Who by Thy strength settest fast the mountains, who art girded about with might;

65.s: מַשְׁבִּיחַ שְׁאוֹן יַמִּים שְׁאוֹן גַּלֵּיהֶם וַהֲמוֹן לְאֻמִּים׃
65.e: Who stillest the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples;

65.s: וַיִּירְאוּ יֹשְׁבֵי קְצָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶיךָ מוֹצָאֵי־בֹקֶר וָעֶרֶב תַּרְנִין׃
65.e: So that they that dwell in the uttermost parts stand in awe of Thy signs; Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

65.s: פָּקַדְתָּ הָאָרֶץ וַתְּשֹׁקְקֶהָ רַבַּת תַּעְשְׁרֶנָּה פֶּלֶג אֱלֹהִים מָלֵא מָיִם תָּכִין דְּגָנָם כִּי־כֵן תְּכִינֶהָ׃
65.e: Thou hast remembered the earth, and watered her, greatly enriching her, with the river of God that is full of water; Thou preparest them corn, for so preparest Thou her.

65.s: תְּלָמֶיהָ רַוֵּה נַחֵת גְּדוּדֶיהָ בִּרְבִיבִים תְּמֹגְגֶנָּה צִמְחָהּ תְּבָרֵךְ׃
65.e: Watering her ridges abundantly, settling down the furrows thereof, Thou makest her soft with showers; Thou blessest the growth thereof.

65.s: עִטַּרְתָּ שְׁנַת טוֹבָתֶךָ וּמַעְגָּלֶיךָ יִרְעֲפוּן דָּשֶׁן׃
65.e: Thou crownest the year with Thy goodness; and Thy paths drop fatness.

65.s: יִרְעֲפוּ נְאוֹת מִדְבָּר וְגִיל גְּבָעוֹת תַּחְגֹּרְנָה׃
65.e: The pastures of the wilderness do drop; and the hills are girded with joy.

65.s: לָבְשׁוּ כָרִים הַצֹּאן וַעֲמָקִים יַעַטְפוּ־בָר יִתְרוֹעֲעוּ אַף־יָשִׁירוּ׃
65.e: The meadows are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, yea, they sing.

66.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
66.e: For the Leader. A Song, a Psalm. Shout unto God, all the earth;

66.s: זַמְּרוּ כְבוֹד־שְׁמוֹ שִׂימוּ כָבוֹד תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
66.e: Sing praises unto the glory of His name; Make His praise glorious.

66.s: אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים מַה־נּוֹרָא מַעֲשֶׂיךָ בְּרֹב עֻזְּךָ יְכַחֲשׁוּ לְךָ אֹיְבֶיךָ׃
66.e: Say unto God: 'How tremendous is Thy work! Through the greatness of Thy power shall Thine enemies dwindle away before Thee.

66.s: כָּל־הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ וִיזַמְּרוּ־לָךְ יְזַמְּרוּ שִׁמְךָ סֶלָה׃
66.e: All the earth shall worship Thee, And shall sing praises unto Thee; They shall sing praises to Thy name.' Selah

66.s: לְכוּ וּרְאוּ מִפְעֲלוֹת אֱלֹהִים נוֹרָא עֲלִילָה עַל־בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
66.e: Come, and see the works of God; He is terrible in His doing toward the children of men.

66.s: הָפַךְ יָם לְיַבָּשָׁה בַּנָּהָר יַעַבְרוּ בְרָגֶל שָׁם נִשְׂמְחָה־בּוֹ׃
66.e: He turned the sea into dry land; They went through the river on foot; There let us rejoice in Him!

66.s: מֹשֵׁל בִּגְבוּרָתוֹ עוֹלָם עֵינָיו בַּגּוֹיִם תִּצְפֶּינָה הַסּוֹרְרִים אַל־ירימו [יָרוּמוּ] לָמוֹ סֶלָה׃
66.e: Who ruleth by His might for ever; His eyes keep watch upon the nations; Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah

66.s: בָּרְכוּ עַמִּים אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהַשְׁמִיעוּ קוֹל תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
66.e: Bless our God, ye peoples, And make the voice of His praise to be heard;

66.s: הַשָּׂם נַפְשֵׁנוּ בַּחַיִּים וְלֹא־נָתַן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֵנוּ׃
66.e: Who hath set our soul in life, And suffered not our foot to be moved,

66.s: כִּי־בְחַנְתָּנוּ אֱלֹהִים צְרַפְתָּנוּ כִּצְרָף־כָּסֶף׃
66.e: For Thou, O God, hast tried us; Thou hast refined us, as silver is refined.

66.s: הֲבֵאתָנוּ בַמְּצוּדָה שַׂמְתָּ מוּעָקָה בְמָתְנֵינוּ׃
66.e: Thou didst bring us into the hold; Thou didst lay constraint upon our loins.

66.s: הִרְכַּבְתָּ אֱנוֹשׁ לְרֹאשֵׁנוּ בָּאנוּ־בָאֵשׁ וּבַמַּיִם וַתּוֹצִיאֵנוּ לָרְוָיָה׃
66.e: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But Thou didst bring us out unto abundance.

66.s: אָבוֹא בֵיתְךָ בְעוֹלוֹת אֲשַׁלֵּם לְךָ נְדָרָי׃
66.e: I will come into Thy house with burnt-offerings, I will perform unto Thee my vows,

66.s: אֲשֶׁר־פָּצוּ שְׂפָתָי וְדִבֶּר־פִּי בַּצַּר־לִי׃
66.e: Which my lips have uttered, And my mouth hath spoken, when I was in distress.

66.s: עֹלוֹת מֵחִים אַעֲלֶה־לָּךְ עִם־קְטֹרֶת אֵילִים אֶעֱשֶׂה בָקָר עִם־עַתּוּדִים סֶלָה׃
66.e: I will offer unto Thee burnt-offerings of fatlings, With the sweet smoke of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah

66.s: לְכוּ־שִׁמְעוּ וַאֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־יִרְאֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְנַפְשִׁי׃
66.e: Come, and hearken, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what He hath done for my soul.

66.s: אֵלָיו פִּי־קָרָאתִי וְרוֹמַם תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנִי׃
66.e: I cried unto Him with my mouth, And He was extolled with my tongue.

66.s: אָוֶן אִם־רָאִיתִי בְלִבִּי לֹא יִשְׁמַע אֲדֹנָי׃
66.e: If I had regarded iniquity in my heart, The Lord would not hear;

66.s: אָכֵן שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים הִקְשִׁיב בְּקוֹל תְּפִלָּתִי׃
66.e: But verily God hath heard; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

66.s: בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֵסִיר תְּפִלָּתִי וְחַסְדּוֹ מֵאִתִּי׃
66.e: Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, nor His mercy from me.

67.e: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm, a Song.

67.s: אֱלֹהִים יְחָנֵּנוּ וִיבָרְכֵנוּ יָאֵר פָּנָיו אִתָּנוּ סֶלָה׃
67.e: God be gracious unto us, and bless us; May He cause His face to shine toward us; Selah
That Thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.

67.s: יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם׃
67.e: Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, O God; Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, all of them. .

67.s: יִשְׂמְחוּ וִירַנְּנוּ לְאֻמִּים כִּי־תִשְׁפֹּט עַמִּים מִישׁוֹר וּלְאֻמִּים בָּאָרֶץ תַּנְחֵם סֶלָה׃
67.e: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For Thou wilt judge the peoples with equity, And lead the nations upon earth. Selah

67.s: יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם׃
67.e: Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, O God; Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, all of them.

67.s: אֶרֶץ נָתְנָה יְבוּלָהּ יְבָרְכֵנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
67.e: The earth hath yielded her increase; May God, our own God, bless us.
May God bless us; And let all the ends of the earth fear Him.

68.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר׃
68.e: For the Leader. A Psalm of David, a Song.

68.s: יָקוּם אֱלֹהִים יָפוּצוּ אוֹיְבָיו וְיָנוּסוּ מְשַׂנְאָיו מִפָּנָיו׃
68.e: Let God arise, let His enemies be scattered; And let them that hate Him flee before Him.

68.s: כְּהִנְדֹּף עָשָׁן תִּנְדֹּף כְּהִמֵּס דּוֹנַג מִפְּנֵי־אֵשׁ יֹאבְדוּ רְשָׁעִים מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃
68.e: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away; As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

68.s: וְצַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמְחוּ יַעַלְצוּ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים וְיָשִׂישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָה׃
68.e: But let the righteous be glad, let them exult before God; Yea, let them rejoice with gladness.

68.s: שִׁירוּ לֵאלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ שְׁמוֹ סֹלּוּ לָרֹכֵב בָּעֲרָבוֹת בְּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ וְעִלְזוּ לְפָנָיו׃
68.e: Sing unto God, sing praises to His name; Extol Him that rideth upon the skies, whose name is the LORD; And exult ye before Him.

68.s: אֲבִי יְתוֹמִים וְדַיַּן אַלְמָנוֹת אֱלֹהִים בִּמְעוֹן קָדְשׁוֹ׃
68.e: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, Is God in His holy habitation.

68.s: אֱלֹהִים מוֹשִׁיב יְחִידִים בַּיְתָה מוֹצִיא אֲסִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁרוֹת אַךְ סוֹרֲרִים שָׁכְנוּ צְחִיחָה׃
68.e: God maketh the solitary to dwell in a house; He bringeth out the prisoners into prosperity; The rebellious dwell but in a parched land.

68.s: אֱ‍לֹהִים בְּצֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵי עַמֶּךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ בִישִׁימוֹן סֶלָה׃
68.e: O God, when Thou wentest forth before Thy people, When Thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah

68.s: אֶרֶץ רָעָשָׁה אַף־שָׁמַיִם נָטְפוּ מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים זֶה סִינַי מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
68.e: The earth trembled, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God; Even yon Sinai trembled at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

68.s: גֶּשֶׁם נְדָבוֹת תָּנִיף אֱלֹהִים נַחֲלָתְךָ וְנִלְאָה אַתָּה כוֹנַנְתָּהּ׃
68.e: A bounteous rain didst Thou pour down, O God; When Thine inheritance was weary, Thou didst confirm it.

68.s: חַיָּתְךָ יָשְׁבוּ־בָהּ תָּכִין בְּטוֹבָתְךָ לֶעָנִי אֱלֹהִים׃
68.e: Thy flock settled therein; Thou didst prepare in Thy goodness for the poor, O God.

68.s: אֲדֹנָי יִתֶּן־אֹמֶר הַמְבַשְּׂרוֹת צָבָא רָב׃
68.e: The Lord giveth the word; The women that proclaim the tidings are a great host.

68.s: מַלְכֵי צְבָאוֹת יִדֹּדוּן יִדֹּדוּן וּנְוַת בַּיִת תְּחַלֵּק שָׁלָל׃
68.e: Kings of armies flee, they flee; And she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil.

68.s: אִם־תִּשְׁכְּבוּן בֵּין שְׁפַתָּיִם כַּנְפֵי יוֹנָה נֶחְפָּה בַכֶּסֶף וְאֶבְרוֹתֶיהָ בִּירַקְרַק חָרוּץ׃
68.e: When ye lie among the sheepfolds, The wings of the dove are covered with silver, And her pinions with the shimmer of gold. .

68.s: בְּפָרֵשׂ שַׁדַּי מְלָכִים בָּהּ תַּשְׁלֵג בְּצַלְמוֹן׃
68.e: When the Almighty scattereth kings therein, It snoweth in Zalmon.

68.s: הַר־אֱלֹהִים הַר־בָּשָׁן הַר גַּבְנֻנִּים הַר־בָּשָׁן׃
68.e: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A mountain of peaks is the mountain of Bashan.

68.s: לָמָּה תְּרַצְּדוּן הָרִים גַּבְנֻנִּים הָהָר חָמַד אֱלֹהִים לְשִׁבְתּוֹ אַף־יְהוָה יִשְׁכֹּן לָנֶצַח׃
68.e: Why look ye askance, ye mountains of peaks, At the mountain which God hath desired for His abode? Yea, the LORD will dwell therein for ever.

68.s: רֶכֶב אֱלֹהִים רִבֹּתַיִם אַלְפֵי שִׁנְאָן אֲדֹנָי בָם סִינַי בַּקֹּדֶשׁ׃
68.e: The chariots of God are myriads, even thousands upon thousands; The Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in holiness.

68.s: עָלִיתָ לַמָּרוֹם שָׁבִיתָ שֶּׁבִי לָקַחְתָּ מַתָּנוֹת בָּאָדָם וְאַף סוֹרְרִים לִשְׁכֹּן יָהּ אֱלֹהִים׃
68.e: Thou hast ascended on high, Thou hast led captivity captive; Thou hast received gifts among men, Yea, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.

68.s: בָּרוּךְ אֲדֹנָי יוֹם יוֹם יַעֲמָס־לָנוּ הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ סֶלָה׃
68.e: Blessed be the Lord, day by day He beareth our burden, Even the God who is our salvation. Selah

68.s: הָאֵל לָנוּ אֵל לְמוֹשָׁעוֹת וְלֵיהוִה אֲדֹנָי לַמָּוֶת תּוֹצָאוֹת׃
68.e: God is unto us a God of deliverances; And unto GOD the Lord belong the issues of death.

68.s: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִים יִמְחַץ רֹאשׁ אֹיְבָיו קָדְקֹד שֵׂעָר מִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָיו׃
68.e: Surely God will smite through the head of His enemies, The hairy scalp of him that goeth about in his guiltiness.

68.s: אָמַר אֲדֹנָי מִבָּשָׁן אָשִׁיב אָשִׁיב מִמְּצֻלוֹת יָם׃
68.e: The Lord said: 'I will bring back from Bashan, I will bring them back from the depths of the sea;

68.s: לְמַעַן תִּמְחַץ רַגְלְךָ בְּדָם לְשׁוֹן כְּלָבֶיךָ מֵאֹיְבִים מִנֵּהוּ׃
68.e: That thy foot may wade through blood, That the tongue of thy dogs may have its portion from thine enemies.'

68.s: רָאוּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶיךָ אֱלֹהִים הֲלִיכוֹת אֵלִי מַלְכִּי בַקֹּדֶשׁ׃
68.e: They see Thy goings, O God, Even the goings of my God, my King, in holiness.

68.s: קִדְּמוּ שָׁרִים אַחַר נֹגְנִים בְּתוֹךְ עֲלָמוֹת תּוֹפֵפוֹת׃
68.e: The singers go before, the minstrels follow after, In the midst of damsels playing upon timbrels.

68.s: בְּמַקְהֵלוֹת בָּרְכוּ אֱלֹהִים יְהוָה מִמְּקוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
68.e: 'Bless ye God in full assemblies, Even the Lord, ye that are from the fountain of Israel.'

68.s: שָׁם בִּנְיָמִן צָעִיר רֹדֵם שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה רִגְמָתָם שָׂרֵי זְבֻלוּן שָׂרֵי נַפְתָּלִי׃
68.e: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, The princes of Judah their council, The princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.

68.s: צִוָּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עֻזֶּךָ עוּזָּה אֱלֹהִים זוּ פָּעַלְתָּ לָּנוּ׃
68.e: Thy God hath commanded thy strength; Be strong, O God, Thou that hast wrought for us

68.s: מֵהֵיכָלֶךָ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם לְךָ יוֹבִילוּ מְלָכִים שָׁי׃
68.e: Out of Thy temple at Jerusalem, Whither kings shall bring presents unto Thee.

68.s: גְּעַר חַיַּת קָנֶה עֲדַת אַבִּירִים בְּעֶגְלֵי עַמִּים מִתְרַפֵּס בְּרַצֵּי־כָסֶף בִּזַּר עַמִּים קְרָבוֹת יֶחְפָּצוּ׃
68.e: Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, The multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples, Every one submitting himself with pieces of silver; He hath scattered the peoples that delight in war!

68.s: יֶאֱתָיוּ חַשְׁמַנִּים מִנִּי מִצְרָיִם כּוּשׁ תָּרִיץ יָדָיו לֵאלֹהִים׃
68.e: Nobles shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall hasten to stretch out her hands unto God.

68.s: מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ שִׁירוּ לֵאלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ אֲדֹנָי סֶלָה׃
68.e: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah

68.s: לָרֹכֵב בִּשְׁמֵי שְׁמֵי־קֶדֶם הֵן יִתֵּן בְּקוֹלוֹ קוֹל עֹז׃
68.e: To Him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which are of old; Lo, He uttereth His voice, a mighty voice.

68.s: תְּנוּ עֹז לֵאלֹהִים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּאֲוָתוֹ וְעֻזּוֹ בַּשְּׁחָקִים׃
68.e: Ascribe ye strength unto God; His majesty is over Israel, And His strength is in the skies.

68.s: נוֹרָא אֱלֹהִים מִמִּקְדָּשֶׁיךָ אֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נֹתֵן עֹז וְתַעֲצֻמוֹת לָעָם בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהִים׃
68.e: Awful is God out of thy holy places; The God of Israel, He giveth strength and power unto the people; Blessed be God.

69.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שׁוֹשַׁנִּים לְדָוִד׃
69.e: For the Leader; upon Shoshannim. [A Psalm] of David.

69.s: הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי אֱלֹהִים כִּי בָאוּ מַיִם עַד־נָפֶשׁ׃
69.e: Save me, O God; For the waters are come in even unto the soul.

69.s: טָבַעְתִּי בִּיוֵן מְצוּלָה וְאֵין מָעֳמָד בָּאתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי־מַיִם וְשִׁבֹּלֶת שְׁטָפָתְנִי׃
69.e: I am sunk in deep mire, where there is no standing; I am come into deep waters, and the flood overwhelmeth me.

69.s: יָגַעְתִּי בְקָרְאִי נִחַר גְּרוֹנִי כָּלוּ עֵינַי מְיַחֵל לֵאלֹהָי׃
69.e: I am weary of my crying; my throat is dried; Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

69.s: רַבּוּ מִשַּׂעֲרוֹת רֹאשִׁי שֹׂנְאַי חִנָּם עָצְמוּ מַצְמִיתַי אֹיְבַי שֶׁקֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־גָזַלְתִּי אָז אָשִׁיב׃
69.e: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; They that would cut me off, being mine enemies wrongfully, are many; Should I restore that which I took not away?

69.s: אֱ‍לֹהִים אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּי וְאַשְׁמוֹתַי מִמְּךָ לֹא־נִכְחָדוּ׃
69.e: O God, Thou knowest my folly; And my trespasses are not hid from Thee.

69.s: אַל־יֵבֹשׁוּ בִי קֹוֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צְבָאוֹת אַל־יִכָּלְמוּ בִי מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
69.e: Let not them that wait for Thee be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of hosts; Let not those that seek Thee be brought to confusion through me, O God of Israel.

69.s: כִּי־עָלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי חֶרְפָּה כִּסְּתָה כְלִמָּה פָנָי׃
69.e: Because for Thy sake I have borne reproach; Confusion hath covered my face.

69.s: מוּזָר הָיִיתִי לְאֶחָי וְנָכְרִי לִבְנֵי אִמִּי׃
69.e: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, And an alien unto my mother's children.

69.s: כִּי־קִנְאַת בֵּיתְךָ אֲכָלָתְנִי וְחֶרְפּוֹת חוֹרְפֶיךָ נָפְלוּ עָלָי׃
69.e: Because zeal for Thy house hath eaten me up, And the reproaches of them that reproach Thee are fallen upon me.

69.s: וָאֶבְכֶּה בַצּוֹם נַפְשִׁי וַתְּהִי לַחֲרָפוֹת לִי׃
69.e: And I wept with my soul with fasting, And that became unto me a reproach.

69.s: וָאֶתְּנָה לְבוּשִׁי שָׂק וָאֱהִי לָהֶם לְמָשָׁל׃
69.e: I made sackcloth also my garment, And I became a byword unto them.

69.s: יָשִׂיחוּ בִי יֹשְׁבֵי שָׁעַר וּנְגִינוֹת שׁוֹתֵי שֵׁכָר׃
69.e: They that sit in the gate talk of me; And I am the song of the drunkards. .

69.s: וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי־לְךָ יְהוָה עֵת רָצוֹן אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּךָ עֲנֵנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶךָ׃
69.e: But as for me, let my prayer be unto Thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time; O God, in the abundance of Thy mercy, Answer me with the truth of Thy salvation.

69.s: הַצִּילֵנִי מִטִּיט וְאַל־אֶטְבָּעָה אִנָּצְלָה מִשֹּׂנְאַי וּמִמַּעֲמַקֵּי־מָיִם׃
69.e: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink; Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

69.s: אַל־תִּשְׁטְפֵנִי שִׁבֹּלֶת מַיִם וְאַל־תִּבְלָעֵנִי מְצוּלָה וְאַל־תֶּאְטַר־עָלַי בְּאֵר פִּיהָ׃
69.e: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, Neither let the deep swallow me up; And let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

69.s: עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי־טוֹב חַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ פְּנֵה אֵלָי׃
69.e: Answer me, O LORD, for Thy mercy is good; According to the multitude of Thy compassions turn Thou unto me.

69.s: וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מֵעַבְדֶּךָ כִּי־צַר־לִי מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי׃
69.e: And hide not Thy face from Thy servant; For I am in distress; answer me speedily.

69.s: קָרְבָה אֶל־נַפְשִׁי גְאָלָהּ לְמַעַן אֹיְבַי פְּדֵנִי׃
69.e: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it; Ransom me because of mine enemies.

69.s: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִי וּבָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִי נֶגְדְּךָ כָּל־צוֹרְרָי׃
69.e: Thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my confusion; Mine adversaries are all before Thee.

69.s: חֶרְפָּה שָׁבְרָה לִבִּי וָאָנוּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּה לָנוּד וָאַיִן וְלַמְנַחֲמִים וְלֹא מָצָאתִי׃
69.e: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am sore sick; And I looked for some to show compassion, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.

69.s: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְּבָרוּתִי רֹאשׁ וְלִצְמָאִי יַשְׁקוּנִי חֹמֶץ׃
69.e: Yea, they put poison into my food; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

69.s: יְהִי־שֻׁלְחָנָם לִפְנֵיהֶם לְפָח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִים לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃
69.e: Let their table before them become a snare; And when they are in peace, let it become a trap.

69.s: תֶּחְשַׁכְנָה עֵינֵיהֶם מֵרְאוֹת וּמָתְנֵיהֶם תָּמִיד הַמְעַד׃
69.e: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; And make their loins continually to totter.

69.s: שְׁפָךְ־עֲלֵיהֶם זַעְמֶךָ וַחֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ יַשִּׂיגֵם׃
69.e: Pour out Thine indignation upon them, And let the fierceness of Thine anger overtake them.

69.s: תְּהִי־טִירָתָם נְשַׁמָּה בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם אַל־יְהִי יֹשֵׁב׃
69.e: Let their encampment be desolate; Let none dwell in their tents.

69.s: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּיתָ רָדָפוּ וְאֶל־מַכְאוֹב חֲלָלֶיךָ יְסַפֵּרוּ׃
69.e: For they persecute him whom Thou hast smitten; And they tell of the pain of those whom Thou hast wounded.

69.s: תְּנָה־עָוֺן עַל־עֲוֺנָם וְאַל־יָבֹאוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶךָ׃
69.e: Add iniquity unto their iniquity; And let them not come into Thy righteousness.

69.s: יִמָּחוּ מִסֵּפֶר חַיִּים וְעִם צַדִּיקִים אַל־יִכָּתֵבוּ׃
69.e: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, And not be written with the righteous.

69.s: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְכוֹאֵב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים תְּשַׂגְּבֵנִי׃
69.e: But I am afflicted and in pain; Let Thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

69.s: אֲהַלְלָה שֵׁם־אֱלֹהִים בְּשִׁיר וַאֲגַדְּלֶנּוּ בְתוֹדָה׃
69.e: I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify Him with thanksgiving. .

69.s: וְתִיטַב לַיהוָה מִשּׁוֹר פָּר מַקְרִן מַפְרִיס׃
69.e: And it shall please the LORD better than a bullock That hath horns and hoofs.

69.s: רָאוּ עֲנָוִים יִשְׂמָחוּ דֹּרְשֵׁי אֱלֹהִים וִיחִי לְבַבְכֶם׃
69.e: The humble shall see it, and be glad; Ye that seek after God, let your heart revive.

69.s: כִּי־שֹׁמֵעַ אֶל־אֶבְיוֹנִים יְהוָה וְאֶת־אֲסִירָיו לֹא בָזָה׃
69.e: For the LORD hearkeneth unto the needy, And despiseth not His prisoners.

69.s: יְהַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ יַמִּים וְכָל־רֹמֵשׂ בָּם׃
69.e: Let heaven and earth praise Him, The seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

69.s: כִּי אֱלֹהִים יוֹשִׁיעַ צִיּוֹן וְיִבְנֶה עָרֵי יְהוּדָה וְיָשְׁבוּ שָׁם וִירֵשׁוּהָ׃
69.e: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah; And they shall abide there, and have it in possession.

69.s: וְזֶרַע עֲבָדָיו יִנְחָלוּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵי שְׁמוֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָהּ׃
69.e: The seed also of His servants shall inherit it; And they that love His name shall dwell therein.

70.e: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David; to make memorial.
O God, to deliver me, O LORD, to help me, make haste.

70.s: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיִכָּלְמוּ חֲפֵצֵי רָעָתִי׃
70.e: Let them be ashamed and abashed That seek after my soul; Let them be turned backward and brought to confusion That delight in my hurt.

70.s: יָשׁוּבוּ עַל־עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם הָאֹמְרִים הֶאָח הֶאָח׃
70.e: Let them be turned back by reason of their shame That say: 'Aha, aha.'

70.s: יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּל־מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים אֹהֲבֵי יְשׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
70.e: Let all those that seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee; And let such as love Thy salvation say continually: 'Let God be magnified.'

70.s: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אֱלֹהִים חוּשָׁה־לִּי עֶזְרִי וּמְפַלְטִי אַתָּה יְהוָה אַל־תְּאַחַר׃
70.e: But I am poor and needy; O God, make haste unto me; Thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, tarry not.

71.s: בְּךָ־יְהוָה חָסִיתִי אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָם׃
71.e: In Thee, O LORD, have I taken refuge; Let me never be ashamed.

71.s: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ תַּצִּילֵנִי וּתְפַלְּטֵנִי הַטֵּה־אֵלַי אָזְנְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
71.e: Deliver me in Thy righteousness, and rescue me; Incline Thine ear unto me, and save me.

71.s: הֱיֵה לִי לְצוּר מָעוֹן לָבוֹא תָּמִיד צִוִּיתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כִּי־סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אָתָּה׃
71.e: Be Thou to me a sheltering rock, whereunto I may continually resort, Which Thou hast appointed to save me; For Thou art my rock and my fortress.

71.s: אֱ‍לֹהַי פַּלְּטֵנִי מִיַּד רָשָׁע מִכַּף מְעַוֵּל וְחוֹמֵץ׃
71.e: O my God, rescue me out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the grasp of the unrighteous and ruthless man.

71.s: כִּי־אַתָּה תִקְוָתִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה מִבְטַחִי מִנְּעוּרָי׃
71.e: For Thou art my hope; O Lord GOD, my trust from my youth.

71.s: עָלֶיךָ נִסְמַכְתִּי מִבֶּטֶן מִמְּעֵי אִמִּי אַתָּה גוֹזִי בְּךָ תְהִלָּתִי תָמִיד׃
71.e: Upon Thee have I stayed myself from birth; Thou art he that took me out of my mother's womb; My praise is continually of Thee.

71.s: כְּמוֹפֵת הָיִיתִי לְרַבִּים וְאַתָּה מַחֲסִי־עֹז׃
71.e: I am as a wonder unto many; But Thou art my strong refuge.

71.s: יִמָּלֵא פִי תְּהִלָּתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּךָ׃
71.e: My mouth shall be filled with Thy praise, And with Thy glory all the day. .

71.s: אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי׃
71.e: Cast me not off in the time of old age; When my strength faileth, forsake me not.

71.s: כִּי־אָמְרוּ אוֹיְבַי לִי וְשֹׁמְרֵי נַפְשִׁי נוֹעֲצוּ יַחְדָּו׃
71.e: For mine enemies speak concerning me, And they that watch for my soul take counsel together,

71.s: לֵאמֹר אֱלֹהִים עֲזָבוֹ רִדְפוּ וְתִפְשׂוּהוּ כִּי־אֵין מַצִּיל׃
71.e: Saying: 'God hath forsaken him; Pursue and take him; for there is none to deliver.'

71.s: אֱלֹהִים אַל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי אֱלֹהַי לְעֶזְרָתִי חישה [חוּשָׁה׃]
71.e: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me.

71.s: יֵבֹשׁוּ יִכְלוּ שֹׂטְנֵי נַפְשִׁי יַעֲטוּ חֶרְפָּה וּכְלִמָּה מְבַקְשֵׁי רָעָתִי׃
71.e: Let them be ashamed and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and confusion that seek my hurt.

71.s: וַאֲנִי תָּמִיד אֲיַחֵל וְהוֹסַפְתִּי עַל־כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃
71.e: But as for me, I will hope continually, And will praise Thee yet more and more.

71.s: פִּי יְסַפֵּר צִדְקָתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶךָ כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי סְפֹרוֹת׃
71.e: My mouth shall tell of Thy righteousness, And of Thy salvation all the day; For I know not the numbers thereof.

71.s: אָבוֹא בִּגְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אַזְכִּיר צִדְקָתְךָ לְבַדֶּךָ׃
71.e: I will come with Thy mighty acts, O Lord GOD; I will make mention of Thy righteousness, even of Thine only.

71.s: אֱ‍לֹהִים לִמַּדְתַּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי וְעַד־הֵנָּה אַגִּיד נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃
71.e: O God, Thou hast taught me from my youth; And until now do I declare Thy wondrous works.

71.s: וְגַם עַד־זִקְנָה וְשֵׂיבָה אֱלֹהִים אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי עַד־אַגִּיד זְרוֹעֲךָ לְדוֹר לְכָל־יָבוֹא גְּבוּרָתֶךָ׃
71.e: And even unto old age and hoary hairs, O God, forsake me not; Until I have declared Thy strength unto the next generation, Thy might to every one that is to come.

71.s: וְצִדְקָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים עַד־מָרוֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתָ גְדֹלוֹת אֱלֹהִים מִי כָמוֹךָ׃
71.e: Thy righteousness also, O God, which reacheth unto high heaven; Thou who hast done great things, O God, who is like unto Thee?

71.s: אֲשֶׁר הראיתנו [הִרְאִיתַנִי ] צָרוֹת רַבּוֹת וְרָעוֹת תָּשׁוּב תחיינו [תְּחַיֵּינִי] וּמִתְּהֹמוֹת הָאָרֶץ תָּשׁוּב תַּעֲלֵנִי׃
71.e: Thou, who hast made me to see many and sore troubles, Wilt quicken me again, and bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

71.s: תֶּרֶב גְּדֻלָּתִי וְתִסֹּב תְּנַחֲמֵנִי׃
71.e: Thou wilt increase my greatness, And turn and comfort me.

71.s: גַּם־אֲנִי אוֹדְךָ בִכְלִי־נֶבֶל אֲמִתְּךָ אֱלֹהָי אֲזַמְּרָה לְךָ בְכִנּוֹר קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
71.e: I also will give thanks unto Thee with the psaltery, Even unto Thy truth, O my God; I will sing praises unto Thee with the harp, O Thou Holy One of Israel.

71.s: תְּרַנֵּנָּה שְׂפָתַי כִּי אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּךְ וְנַפְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ׃
71.e: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing praises unto Thee; And my soul, which Thou hast redeemed.

71.s: גַּם־לְשׁוֹנִי כָּל־הַיּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּה צִדְקָתֶךָ כִּי־בֹשׁוּ כִי־חָפְרוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי רָעָתִי׃
71.e: My tongue also shall tell of Thy righteousness all the day; For they are ashamed, for they are abashed, that seek my hurt.

72.s: לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֱ‍לֹהִים מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ תֵּן וְצִדְקָתְךָ לְבֶן־מֶלֶךְ׃
72.e: [A Psalm] of Solomon. Give the king Thy judgments, O God, and Thy righteousness unto the king's son;

72.s: יָדִין עַמְּךָ בְצֶדֶק וַעֲנִיֶּיךָ בְמִשְׁפָּט׃
72.e: That he may judge Thy people with righteousness, and Thy poor with justice.

72.s: יִשְׂאוּ הָרִים שָׁלוֹם לָעָם וּגְבָעוֹת בִּצְדָקָה׃
72.e: Let the mountains bear peace to the people, and the hills, through righteousness.

72.s: יִשְׁפֹּט עֲ‍נִיֵּי־עָם יוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵי אֶבְיוֹן וִידַכֵּא עוֹשֵׁק׃
72.e: May he judge the poor of the people, and save the children of the needy, And crush the oppressor.

72.s: יִירָאוּךָ עִם־שָׁמֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵי יָרֵחַ דּוֹר דּוֹרִים׃
72.e: They shall fear Thee while the sun endureth, and so long as the moon, throughout all generations.

72.s: יֵרֵד כְּמָטָר עַל־גֵּז כִּרְבִיבִים זַרְזִיף אָרֶץ׃
72.e: May he come down like rain upon the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

72.s: יִפְרַח־בְּיָמָיו צַדִּיק וְרֹב שָׁלוֹם עַד־בְּלִי יָרֵחַ׃
72.e: In his days let the righteous flourish, and abundance of peace, till the moon be no more.

72.s: וְיֵרְדְּ מִיָּם עַד־יָם וּמִנָּהָר עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ׃
72.e: May he have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the River unto the ends of the earth.

72.s: לְפָנָיו יִכְרְעוּ צִיִּים וְאֹיְבָיו עָפָר יְלַחֵכוּ׃
72.e: Let them that dwell in the wilderness bow before him; and his enemies lick the dust.

72.s: מַלְכֵי תַרְשִׁישׁ וְאִיִּים מִנְחָה יָשִׁיבוּ מַלְכֵי שְׁבָא וּסְבָא אֶשְׁכָּר יַקְרִיבוּ׃
72.e: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute; the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

72.s: וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ כָל־מְלָכִים כָּל־גּוֹיִם יַעַבְדוּהוּ׃
72.e: Yea, all kings shall prostrate themselves before him; All nations shall serve him.

72.s: כִּי־יַצִּיל אֶבְיוֹן מְשַׁוֵּעַ וְעָנִי וְאֵין־עֹזֵר לוֹ׃
72.e: For he will deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

72.s: יָחֹס עַל־דַּל וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנַפְשׁוֹת אֶבְיוֹנִים יוֹשִׁיעַ׃
72.e: He will have pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he will save.

72.s: מִתּוֹךְ וּמֵחָמָס יִגְאַל נַפְשָׁם וְיֵיקַר דָּמָם בְּעֵינָיו׃
72.e: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence, And precious will their blood be in his sight.

72.s: וִיחִי וְיִתֶּן־לוֹ מִזְּהַב שְׁבָא וְיִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעֲדוֹ תָמִיד כָּל־הַיּוֹם יְבָרֲכֶנְהוּ׃
72.e: That they may live, and that he may give them of the gold of Sheba, That they may pray for him continually, Yea, bless him all the day.

72.s: יְהִי פִסַּת־בַּר בָּאָרֶץ בְּרֹאשׁ הָרִים יִרְעַשׁ כַּלְּבָנוֹן פִּרְיוֹ וְיָצִיצוּ מֵעִיר כְּעֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ׃
72.e: May he be as a rich cornfield in the land upon the top of the mountains; May his fruit rustle like Lebanon; And may they blossom out of the city like grass of the earth.

72.s: יְהִי שְׁמוֹ לְעוֹלָם לִפְנֵי־שֶׁמֶשׁ ינין [יִנּוֹן] שְׁמוֹ וְיִתְבָּרְכוּ בוֹ כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְאַשְּׁרוּהוּ׃
72.e: May his name endure for ever; May his name be continued as long as the sun; May men also bless themselves by him; May all nations call him happy.

72.s: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת לְבַדּוֹ׃
72.e: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things;

72.s: וּבָרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדוֹ לְעוֹלָם וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹדוֹ אֶת־כֹּל הָאָרֶץ אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃
72.e: And blessed be His glorious name for ever; And let the whole earth be filled with His glory. Amen, and Amen.

72.s: כָּלּוּ תְפִלּוֹת דָּוִד בֶּן־יִשָׁי׃
72.e: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

73.s: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אַךְ טוֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֱלֹהִים לְבָרֵי לֵבָב׃
73.e: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, even to such as are pure in heart.

73.s: וַאֲנִי כִּמְעַט נטוי [נָטָיוּ] רַגְלָי כְּאַיִן שפכה [שֻׁפְּכוּ] אֲשֻׁרָי׃
73.e: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

73.s: כִּי־קִנֵּאתִי בַּהוֹלְלִים שְׁלוֹם רְשָׁעִים אֶרְאֶה׃
73.e: For I was envious at the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

73.s: כִּי אֵין חַרְצֻבּוֹת לְמוֹתָם וּבָרִיא אוּלָם׃
73.e: For there are no pangs at their death, and their body is sound.

73.s: בַּעֲמַל אֱנוֹשׁ אֵינֵמוֹ וְעִם־אָדָם לֹא יְנֻגָּעוּ׃
73.e: In the trouble of man they are not; neither are they plagued like men.

73.s: לָכֵן עֲנָקַתְמוֹ גַאֲוָה יַעֲטָף־שִׁית חָמָס לָמוֹ׃
73.e: Therefore pride is as a chain about their neck; violence covereth them as a garment.

73.s: יָצָא מֵחֵלֶב עֵינֵמוֹ עָבְרוּ מַשְׂכִּיּוֹת לֵבָב׃
73.e: Their eyes stand forth from fatness; they are gone beyond the imaginations of their heart.

73.s: יָמִיקוּ וִידַבְּרוּ בְרָע עֹשֶׁק מִמָּרוֹם יְדַבֵּרוּ׃
73.e: They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression; they speak as if there were none on high.

73.s: שַׁתּוּ בַשָּׁמַיִם פִּיהֶם וּלְשׁוֹנָם תִּהֲלַךְ בָּאָרֶץ׃
73.e: They have set their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth.

73.s: לָכֵן ישיב [יָשׁוּב] עַמּוֹ הֲלֹם וּמֵי מָלֵא יִמָּצוּ לָמוֹ׃
73.e: Therefore His people return hither; And waters of fullness are drained out by them.

73.s: וְאָמְרוּ אֵיכָה יָדַע־אֵל וְיֵשׁ דֵּעָה בְעֶלְיוֹן׃
73.e: And they say: 'How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?'

73.s: הִנֵּה־אֵלֶּה רְשָׁעִים וְשַׁלְוֵי עוֹלָם הִשְׂגּוּ־חָיִל׃
73.e: Behold, such are the wicked; And they that are always at ease increase riches.

73.s: אַךְ־רִיק זִכִּיתִי לְבָבִי וָאֶרְחַץ בְּנִקָּיוֹן כַּפָּי׃
73.e: Surely in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocency;

73.s: וָאֱהִי נָגוּעַ כָּל־הַיּוֹם וְתוֹכַחְתִּי לַבְּקָרִים׃
73.e: For all the day have I been plagued, And my chastisement came every morning.

73.s: אִם־אָמַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָה כְמוֹ הִנֵּה דוֹר בָּנֶיךָ בָגָדְתִּי׃
73.e: If I had said: 'I will speak thus', Behold, I had been faithless to the generation of Thy children.

73.s: וָאֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַעַת זֹאת עָמָל היא [הוּא] בְעֵינָי׃
73.e: And when I pondered how I might know this, It was wearisome in mine eyes;

73.s: עַד־אָבוֹא אֶל־מִקְדְּשֵׁי־אֵל אָבִינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָם׃
73.e: Until I entered into the sanctuary of God, And considered their end.

73.s: אַךְ בַּחֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁית לָמוֹ הִפַּלְתָּם לְמַשּׁוּאוֹת׃
73.e: Surely Thou settest them in slippery places; Thou hurlest them down to utter ruin.

73.s: אֵיךְ הָיוּ לְשַׁמָּה כְרָגַע סָפוּ תַמּוּ מִן־בַּלָּהוֹת׃
73.e: How are they become a desolation in a moment! They are wholly consumed by terrors.

73.s: כַּחֲלוֹם מֵהָקִיץ אֲדֹנָי בָּעִיר צַלְמָם תִּבְזֶה׃
73.e: As a dream when one awaketh, So, O Lord, when Thou arousest Thyself, Thou wilt despise their semblance.

73.s: כִּי יִתְחַמֵּץ לְבָבִי וְכִלְיוֹתַי אֶשְׁתּוֹנָן׃
73.e: For my heart was in a ferment, And I was pricked in my reins. .

73.s: וַאֲנִי־בַעַר וְלֹא אֵדָע בְּהֵמוֹת הָיִיתִי עִמָּךְ׃
73.e: But I was brutish, and ignorant; I was as a beast before Thee.

73.s: וַאֲנִי תָמִיד עִמָּךְ אָחַזְתָּ בְּיַד־יְמִינִי׃
73.e: Nevertheless I am continually with Thee; Thou holdest my right hand.

73.s: בַּעֲצָתְךָ תַנְחֵנִי וְאַחַר כָּבוֹד תִּקָּחֵנִי׃
73.e: Thou wilt guide me with Thy counsel, And afterward receive me with glory.

73.s: מִי־לִי בַשָּׁמָיִם וְעִמְּךָ לֹא־חָפַצְתִּי בָאָרֶץ׃
73.e: Whom have I in heaven but Thee? And beside Thee I desire none upon earth.

73.s: כָּלָה שְׁאֵרִי וּלְבָבִי צוּר־לְבָבִי וְחֶלְקִי אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָם׃
73.e: My flesh and my heart faileth; But God is the rock of my heart and my portion for ever.

73.s: כִּי־הִנֵּה רְחֵקֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ הִצְמַתָּה כָּל־זוֹנֶה מִמֶּךָּ׃
73.e: For, lo, they that go far from Thee shall perish; Thou dost destroy all them that go astray from Thee.

73.s: וַאֲנִי קִרֲבַת אֱלֹהִים לִי־טוֹב שַׁתִּי בַּאדֹנָי יְהֹוִה מַחְסִי לְסַפֵּר כָּל־מַלְאֲכוֹתֶיךָ׃
73.e: But as for me, the nearness of God is my good; I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, That I may tell of all Thy works.

74.s: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף לָמָה אֱלֹהִים זָנַחְתָּ לָנֶצַח יֶעְשַׁן אַפְּךָ בְּצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ׃
74.e: Maschil of Asaph. Why, O God, hast Thou cast us off for ever? Why doth Thine anger smoke against the flock of Thy pasture?

74.s: זְכֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִיתָ קֶּדֶם גָּאַלְתָּ שֵׁבֶט נַחֲלָתֶךָ הַר־צִיּוֹן זֶה שָׁכַנְתָּ בּוֹ׃
74.e: Remember Thy congregation, which Thou hast gotten of old, Which Thou hast redeemed to be the tribe of Thine inheritance; And mount Zion, wherein Thou hast dwelt.

74.s: הָרִימָה פְעָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁאוֹת נֶצַח כָּל־הֵרַע אוֹיֵב בַּקֹּדֶשׁ׃
74.e: Lift up Thy steps because of the perpetual ruins, Even all the evil that the enemy hath done in the sanctuary.

74.s: שָׁאֲגוּ צֹרְרֶיךָ בְּקֶרֶב מוֹעֲדֶךָ שָׂמוּ אוֹתֹתָם אֹתוֹת׃
74.e: Thine adversaries have roared in the midst of Thy meeting-place; They have set up their own signs for signs.

74.s: יִוָּדַע כְּמֵבִיא לְמָעְלָה בִּסֲבָךְ־עֵץ קַרְדֻּמּוֹת׃
74.e: It seemed as when men wield upwards Axes in a thicket of trees.

74.s: ועת [וְעַתָּה] פִּתּוּחֶיהָ יָּחַד בְּכַשִּׁיל וְכֵילַפֹּת יַהֲלֹמוּן׃
74.e: And now all the carved work thereof together They strike down with hatchet and hammers.

74.s: שִׁלְחוּ בָאֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁךָ לָאָרֶץ חִלְּלוּ מִשְׁכַּן־שְׁמֶךָ׃
74.e: They have set Thy sanctuary on fire; They have profaned the dwelling-place of Thy name even to the ground.

74.s: אָמְרוּ בְלִבָּם נִינָם יָחַד שָׂרְפוּ כָל־מוֹעֲדֵי־אֵל בָּאָרֶץ׃
74.e: They said in their heart: 'Let us make havoc of them altogether'; They have burned up all the meeting-places of God in the land.

74.s: אוֹתֹתֵינוּ לֹא רָאִינוּ אֵין־עוֹד נָבִיא וְלֹא־אִתָּנוּ יֹדֵעַ עַד־מָה׃
74.e: We see not our signs; There is no more any prophet; Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

74.s: עַד־מָתַי אֱלֹהִים יְחָרֶף צָר יְנָאֵץ אוֹיֵב שִׁמְךָ לָנֶצַח׃
74.e: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme Thy name for ever?

74.s: לָמָּה תָשִׁיב יָדְךָ וִימִינֶךָ מִקֶּרֶב חוקך [חֵיקְךָ] כַלֵּה׃
74.e: Why withdrawest Thou Thy hand, even Thy right hand? Draw it out of Thy bosom and consume them.

74.s: וֵאלֹהִים מַלְכִּי מִקֶּדֶם פֹּעֵל יְשׁוּעוֹת בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ׃
74.e: Yet God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.

74.s: אַתָּה פוֹרַרְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ יָם שִׁבַּרְתָּ רָאשֵׁי תַנִּינִים עַל־הַמָּיִם׃
74.e: Thou didst break the sea in pieces by Thy strength; Thou didst shatter the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters.

74.s: אַתָּה רִצַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁי לִוְיָתָן תִּתְּנֶנּוּ מַאֲכָל לְעָם לְצִיִּים׃
74.e: Thou didst crush the heads of leviathan, Thou gavest him to be food to the folk inhabiting the wilderness.

74.s: אַתָּה בָקַעְתָּ מַעְיָן וָנָחַל אַתָּה הוֹבַשְׁתָּ נַהֲרוֹת אֵיתָן׃
74.e: Thou didst cleave fountain and brook; Thou driedst up ever-flowing rivers.

74.s: לְךָ יוֹם אַף־לְךָ לָיְלָה אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ מָאוֹר וָשָׁמֶשׁ׃
74.e: Thine is the day, Thine also the night; Thou hast established luminary and sun.

74.s: אַתָּה הִצַּבְתָּ כָּל־גְּבוּלוֹת אָרֶץ קַיִץ וָחֹרֶף אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּם׃
74.e: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth; Thou hast made summer and winter.

74.s: זְכָר־זֹאת אוֹיֵב חֵרֵף יְהוָה וְעַם נָבָל נִאֲצוּ שְׁמֶךָ׃
74.e: Remember this, how the enemy hath reproached the LORD, And how a base people have blasphemed Thy name.

74.s: אַל־תִּתֵּן לְחַיַּת נֶפֶשׁ תּוֹרֶךָ חַיַּת עֲנִיֶּיךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח לָנֶצַח׃
74.e: O deliver not the soul of Thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast; Forget not the life of Thy poor for ever.

74.s: הַבֵּט לַבְּרִית כִּי מָלְאוּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי־אֶרֶץ נְאוֹת חָמָס׃
74.e: Look upon the covenant; For the dark places of the land are full of the habitations of violence.

74.s: אַל־יָשֹׁב דַּךְ נִכְלָם עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן יְהַלְלוּ שְׁמֶךָ׃
74.e: O let not the oppressed turn back in confusion; Let the poor and needy praise Thy name.

74.s: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים רִיבָה רִיבֶךָ זְכֹר חֶרְפָּתְךָ מִנִּי־נָבָל כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
74.e: Arise, O God, plead Thine own cause; Remember Thy reproach all the day at the hand of the base man.

74.s: אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח קוֹל צֹרְרֶיךָ שְׁאוֹן קָמֶיךָ עֹלֶה תָמִיד׃
74.e: Forget not the voice of Thine adversaries, The tumult of those that rise up against Thee which ascendeth continually.

75.e: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.

75.s: הוֹדִינוּ לְּךָ אֱ‍לֹהִים הוֹדִינוּ וְקָרוֹב שְׁמֶךָ סִפְּרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃
75.e: We give thanks unto Thee, O God, We give thanks, and Thy name is near; Men tell of Thy wondrous works.

75.s: כִּי אֶקַּח מוֹעֵד אֲנִי מֵישָׁרִים אֶשְׁפֹּט׃
75.e: 'When I take the appointed time, I Myself will judge with equity.

75.s: נְמֹגִים אֶרֶץ וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶיהָ אָנֹכִי תִכַּנְתִּי עַמּוּדֶיהָ סֶּלָה׃
75.e: When the earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved, I Myself establish the pillars of it.' Selah

75.s: אָמַרְתִּי לַהוֹלְלִים אַל־תָּהֹלּוּ וְלָרְשָׁעִים אַל־תָּרִימוּ קָרֶן׃
75.e: I say unto the arrogant 'Deal not arrogantly'; And to the wicked 'Lift not up the horn.'

75.s: אַל־תָּרִימוּ לַמָּרוֹם קַרְנְכֶם תְּדַבְּרוּ בְצַוָּאר עָתָק׃
75.e: Lift not up your horn on high; Speak not insolence with a haughty neck.

75.s: כִּי לֹא מִמּוֹצָא וּמִמַּעֲרָב וְלֹא מִמִּדְבַּר הָרִים׃
75.e: For neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor yet from the wilderness, cometh lifting up.

75.s: כִּי־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפֵט זֶה יַשְׁפִּיל וְזֶה יָרִים׃
75.e: For God is judge; He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.

75.s: כִּי כוֹס בְּיַד־יְהוָה וְיַיִן חָמַר מָלֵא מֶסֶךְ וַיַּגֵּר מִזֶּה אַךְ־שְׁמָרֶיהָ יִמְצוּ יִשְׁתּוּ כֹּל רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ׃
75.e: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, with foaming wine, full of mixture, And He poureth out of the same; Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.

75.s: וַאֲנִי אַגִּיד לְעֹלָם אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
75.e: But as for me, I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

75.s: וְכָל־קַרְנֵי רְשָׁעִים אֲגַדֵּעַ תְּרוֹמַמְנָה קַרְנוֹת צַדִּיק׃
75.e: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

76.e: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.

76.s: נוֹדָע בִּיהוּדָה אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל גָּדוֹל שְׁמוֹ׃
76.e: In Judah is God known; His name is great in Israel.
In Salem also is set His tabernacle, And His dwelling-place in Zion.

76.s: שָׁמָּה שִׁבַּר רִשְׁפֵי־קָשֶׁת מָגֵן וְחֶרֶב וּמִלְחָמָה סֶלָה׃
76.e: There He broke the fiery shafts of the bow; The shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah
Glorious art Thou and excellent, coming down from the mountains of prey.

76.s: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְלוּ אַבִּירֵי לֵב נָמוּ שְׁנָתָם וְלֹא־מָצְאוּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַיִל יְדֵיהֶם׃
76.e: The stout-hearted are bereft of sense, they sleep their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.

76.s: מִגַּעֲרָתְךָ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב נִרְדָּם וְרֶכֶב וָסוּס׃
76.e: At Thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, They are cast into a dead sleep, the riders also and the horses.

76.s: אַתָּה נוֹרָא אַתָּה וּמִי־יַעֲמֹד לְפָנֶיךָ מֵאָז אַפֶּךָ׃
76.e: Thou, even Thou, art terrible; And who may stand in Thy sight when once Thou art angry?

76.s: מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַעְתָּ דִּין אֶרֶץ יָרְאָה וְשָׁקָטָה׃
76.e: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,
When God arose to judgment, To save all the humble of the earth. Selah

76.s: כִּי־חֲמַת אָדָם תּוֹדֶךָּ שְׁאֵרִית חֵמֹת תַּחְגֹּר׃
76.e: Surely the wrath of man shall praise Thee; The residue of wrath shalt Thou gird upon Thee.

76.s: נִדֲרוּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ לַיהוָה אֱ‍לֹהֵיכֶם כָּל־סְבִיבָיו יוֹבִילוּ שַׁי לַמּוֹרָא׃
76.e: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God; Let all that are round about Him bring presents unto Him that is to be feared;
He minisheth the spirit of princes; He is terrible to the kings of the earth.

77.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־ידיתון [יְדוּתוּן] לְאָסָף מִזְמוֹר׃
77.e: For the Leader; for Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph.

77.s: קוֹלִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים וְאֶצְעָקָה קוֹלִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים וְהַאֲזִין אֵלָי׃
77.e: I will lift up my voice unto God, an cry; I will lift up my voice unto God, that He may give ear unto me.

77.s: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי אֲדֹנָי דָּרָשְׁתִּי יָדִי לַיְלָה נִגְּרָה וְלֹא תָפוּג מֵאֲנָה הִנָּחֵם נַפְשִׁי׃
77.e: In the day of my trouble I seek the Lord; With my hand uplifted, [mine eye] streameth in the night without ceasing; My soul refuseth to be comforted.

77.s: אֶזְכְּרָה אֱלֹהִים וְאֶהֱמָיָה אָשִׂיחָה וְתִתְעַטֵּף רוּחִי סֶלָה׃
77.e: When I think thereon, O God, I must moan; When I muse thereon, my spirit fainteth. Selah .

77.s: אָחַזְתָּ שְׁמֻרוֹת עֵינָי נִפְעַמְתִּי וְלֹא אֲדַבֵּר׃
77.e: Thou holdest fast the lids of mine eyes; I am troubled, and cannot speak.

77.s: חִשַּׁבְתִּי יָמִים מִקֶּדֶם שְׁנוֹת עוֹלָמִים׃
77.e: I have pondered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

77.s: אֶזְכְּרָה נְגִינָתִי בַּלָּיְלָה עִם־לְבָבִי אָשִׂיחָה וַיְחַפֵּשׂ רוּחִי׃
77.e: In the night I will call to remembrance my song; I will commune with mine own heart; And my spirit maketh diligent search

77.s: הַלְעוֹלָמִים יִזְנַח אֲדֹנָי וְלֹא־יֹסִיף לִרְצוֹת עוֹד׃
77.e: 'Will the Lord cast off for ever? And will He be favourable no more?

77.s: הֶאָפֵס לָנֶצַח חַסְדּוֹ גָּמַר אֹמֶר לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
77.e: Is His mercy clean gone for ever? Is His promise come to an end for evermore?

77.s: הֲשָׁכַח חַנּוֹת אֵל אִם־קָפַץ בְּאַף רַחֲמָיו סֶלָה׃
77.e: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? Hath He in anger shut up his compassions?' Selah

77.s: וָאֹמַר חַלּוֹתִי הִיא שְׁנוֹת יְמִין עֶלְיוֹן׃
77.e: And I say 'This is my weakness, That the right hand of the Most High could change.

77.s: אזכיר [אֶזְכּוֹר] מַעַלְלֵי־יָהּ כִּי־אֶזְכְּרָה מִקֶּדֶם פִּלְאֶךָ׃
77.e: I will make mention of the deeds of the LORD; Yea, I will remember Thy wonders of old.

77.s: וְהָגִיתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶךָ וּבַעֲלִילוֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה׃
77.e: I will meditate also upon all Thy work, And muse on Thy doings.'

77.s: אֱלֹהִים בַּקֹּדֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּךָ מִי־אֵל גָּדוֹל כֵּאלֹהִים׃
77.e: O God, Thy way is in holiness; Who is a great god like unto God?

77.s: אַתָּה הָאֵל עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא הוֹדַעְתָּ בָעַמִּים עֻזֶּךָ׃
77.e: Thou art the God that doest wonders; Thou hast made known Thy strength among the peoples.

77.s: גָּאַלְתָּ בִּזְרוֹעַ עַמֶּךָ בְּנֵי־יַעֲקֹב וְיוֹסֵף סֶלָה׃
77.e: Thou hast with Thine arm redeemed Thy people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah

77.s: רָאוּךָ מַּיִם אֱ‍לֹהִים רָאוּךָ מַּיִם יָחִילוּ אַף יִרְגְּזוּ תְהֹמוֹת׃
77.e: The waters saw Thee, O God; The waters saw Thee, they were in pain; The depths also trembled.

77.s: זֹרְמוּ מַיִם עָבוֹת קוֹל נָתְנוּ שְׁחָקִים אַף־חֲצָצֶיךָ יִתְהַלָּכוּ׃
77.e: The clouds flooded forth waters; The skies sent out a sound; Thine arrows also went abroad.

77.s: קוֹל רַעַמְךָ בַּגַּלְגַּל הֵאִירוּ בְרָקִים תֵּבֵל רָגְזָה וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ׃
77.e: The voice of Thy thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lighted up the world; The earth trembled and shook.

77.s: בַּיָּם דַּרְכֶּךָ ושביליך [וּשְׁבִילְךָ] בְּמַיִם רַבִּים וְעִקְּבוֹתֶיךָ לֹא נֹדָעוּ׃
77.e: Thy way was in the sea, And Thy path in the great waters, And Thy footsteps were not known.

77.s: נָחִיתָ כַצֹּאן עַמֶּךָ בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃
77.e: Thou didst lead Thy people like a flock, By the hand of Moses and Aaron.

78.s: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף הַאֲזִינָה עַמִּי תּוֹרָתִי הַטּוּ אָזְנְכֶם לְאִמְרֵי־פִי׃
78.e: Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

78.s: אֶפְתְּחָה בְמָשָׁל פִּי אַבִּיעָה חִידוֹת מִנִּי־קֶדֶם׃
78.e: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter dark sayings concerning days of old;

78.s: אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵם וַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ׃
78.e: That which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us,

78.s: לֹא נְכַחֵד מִבְּנֵיהֶם לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן מְסַפְּרִים תְּהִלּוֹת יְהוָה וֶעֱזוּזוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃
78.e: We will not hide from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, And His strength, and His wondrous works that He hath done. .

78.s: וַיָּקֶם עֵדוּת בְּיַעֲקֹב וְתוֹרָה שָׂם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְהוֹדִיעָם לִבְנֵיהֶם׃
78.e: For He established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which He commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;

78.s: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דּוֹר אַחֲרוֹן בָּנִים יִוָּלֵדוּ יָקֻמוּ וִיסַפְּרוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם׃
78.e: That the generation to come might know them, even the children that should be born; Who should arise and tell them to their children,

78.s: וְיָשִׂימוּ בֵאלֹהִים כִּסְלָם וְלֹא יִשְׁכְּחוּ מַעַלְלֵי־אֵל וּמִצְוֺתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ׃
78.e: That they might put their confidence in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep His commandments;

78.s: וְלֹא יִהְיוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם דּוֹר סוֹרֵר וּמֹרֶה דּוֹר לֹא־הֵכִין לִבּוֹ וְלֹא־נֶאֶמְנָה אֶת־אֵל רוּחוֹ׃
78.e: And might not be as their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation; A generation that set not their heart aright, And whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

78.s: בְּנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם נוֹשְׁקֵי רוֹמֵי־קָשֶׁת הָפְכוּ בְּיוֹם קְרָב׃
78.e: The children of Ephraim were as archers handling the bow, That turned back in the day of battle.

78.s: לֹא שָׁמְרוּ בְּרִית אֱלֹהִים וּבְתוֹרָתוֹ מֵאֲנוּ לָלֶכֶת׃
78.e: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in His law;

78.s: וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ עֲלִילוֹתָיו וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָם׃
78.e: And they forgot His doings, And His wondrous works that He had shown them.

78.s: נֶגֶד אֲבוֹתָם עָשָׂה פֶלֶא בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׂדֵה־צֹעַן׃
78.e: Marvellous things did He in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

78.s: בָּקַע יָם וַיַּעֲבִירֵם וַיַּצֶּב־מַיִם כְּמוֹ־נֵד׃
78.e: He cleaved the sea, and caused them to pass through; And He made the waters to stand as a heap.

78.s: וַיַּנְחֵם בֶּעָנָן יוֹמָם וְכָל־הַלַּיְלָה בְּאוֹר אֵשׁ׃
78.e: By day also He led them with a cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.

78.s: יְבַקַּע צֻרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיַּשְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמוֹת רַבָּה׃
78.e: He cleaved rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink abundantly as out of the great deep.

78.s: וַיּוֹצִא נוֹזְלִים מִסָּלַע וַיּוֹרֶד כַּנְּהָרוֹת מָיִם׃
78.e: He brought streams also out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.

78.s: וַיּוֹסִיפוּ עוֹד לַחֲטֹא־לוֹ לַמְרוֹת עֶלְיוֹן בַּצִּיָּה׃
78.e: Yet went they on still to sin against Him, To rebel against the Most High in the desert.

78.s: וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵל בִּלְבָבָם לִשְׁאָל־אֹכֶל לְנַפְשָׁם׃
78.e: And they tried God in their heart By asking food for their craving.

78.s: וַיְדַבְּרוּ בֵּאלֹהִים אָמְרוּ הֲיוּכַל אֵל לַעֲרֹךְ שֻׁלְחָן בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
78.e: Yea, they spoke against God; They said 'Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

78.s: הֵן הִכָּה־צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מַיִם וּנְחָלִים יִשְׁטֹפוּ הֲגַם־לֶחֶם יוּכַל תֵּת אִם־יָכִין שְׁאֵר לְעַמּוֹ׃
78.e: Behold, He smote the rock, that waters gushed out, And streams overflowed; Can He give bread also? Or will He provide flesh for His people?'

78.s: לָכֵן שָׁמַע יְהוָה וַיִּתְעַבָּר וְאֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָה בְיַעֲקֹב וְגַם־אַף עָלָה בְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
78.e: Therefore the LORD heard, and was wroth; And a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also went up against Israel;

78.s: כִּי לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִים וְלֹא בָטְחוּ בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ׃
78.e: Because they believed not in God, And trusted not in His salvation.

78.s: וַיְצַו שְׁחָקִים מִמָּעַל וְדַלְתֵי שָׁמַיִם פָּתָח׃
78.e: And He commanded the skies above, And opened the doors of heaven;

78.s: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם מָן לֶאֱכֹל וּדְגַן־שָׁמַיִם נָתַן לָמוֹ׃
78.e: And He caused manna to rain upon them for food, And gave them of the corn of heaven.

78.s: לֶחֶם אַבִּירִים אָכַל אִישׁ צֵידָה שָׁלַח לָהֶם לָשֹׂבַע׃
78.e: Man did eat the bread of the mighty; He sent them provisions to the full.

78.s: יַסַּע קָדִים בַּשָּׁמָיִם וַיְנַהֵג בְּעֻזּוֹ תֵימָן׃
78.e: He caused the east wind to set forth in heaven; And by His power He brought on the south wind.

78.s: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם כֶּעָפָר שְׁאֵר וּכְחוֹל יַמִּים עוֹף כָּנָף׃
78.e: He caused flesh also to rain upon them as the dust, And winged fowl as the sand of the seas;

78.s: וַיַּפֵּל בְּקֶרֶב מַחֲנֵהוּ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָיו׃
78.e: And He let it fall in the midst of their camp, Round about their dwellings.

78.s: וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׂבְּעוּ מְאֹד וְתַאֲוָתָם יָבִא לָהֶם׃
78.e: So they did eat, and were well filled; And He gave them that which they craved.

78.s: לֹא־זָרוּ מִתַּאֲוָתָם עוֹד אָכְלָם בְּפִיהֶם׃
78.e: They were not estranged from their craving, Their food was yet in their mouths,

78.s: וְאַף אֱלֹהִים עָלָה בָהֶם וַיַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶם וּבַחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִכְרִיעַ׃
78.e: When the anger of God went up against them, And slew of the lustieth among them, And smote down the young men of Israel.

78.s: בְּכָל־זֹאת חָטְאוּ־עוֹד וְלֹא־הֶאֱמִינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָיו׃
78.e: For all this they sinned still, And believed not in His wondrous works.

78.s: וַיְכַל־בַּהֶבֶל יְמֵיהֶם וּשְׁנוֹתָם בַּבֶּהָלָה׃
78.e: Therefore He ended their days as a breath, And their years in terror.

78.s: אִם־הֲרָגָם וּדְרָשׁוּהוּ וְשָׁבוּ וְשִׁחֲרוּ־אֵל׃
78.e: When He slew them, then they would inquire after Him, And turn back and seek God earnestly.

78.s: וַיִּזְכְּרוּ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים צוּרָם וְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָם׃
78.e: And they remembered that God was their Rock, And the Most High God their redeemer.

78.s: וַיְפַתּוּהוּ בְּפִיהֶם וּבִלְשׁוֹנָם יְכַזְּבוּ־לוֹ׃
78.e: But they beguiled Him with their mouth, And lied unto Him with their tongue.

78.s: וְלִבָּם לֹא־נָכוֹן עִמּוֹ וְלֹא נֶאֶמְנוּ בִּבְרִיתוֹ׃
78.e: For their heart was not stedfast with Him, Neither were they faithful in His covenant.

78.s: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֺן וְלֹא־יַשְׁחִית וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֹא־יָעִיר כָּל־חֲמָתוֹ׃
78.e: But He, being full of compassion, forgiveth iniquity, and destroyeth not; Yea, many a time doth He turn His anger away, And doth not stir up all His wrath.

78.s: וַיִּזְכֹּר כִּי־בָשָׂר הֵמָּה רוּחַ הוֹלֵךְ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב׃
78.e: So He remembered that they were but flesh, A wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

78.s: כַּמָּה יַמְרוּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּר יַעֲצִיבוּהוּ בִּישִׁימוֹן׃
78.e: How oft did they rebel against Him in the wilderness, And grieve Him in the desert!

78.s: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ וַיְנַסּוּ אֵל וּקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְווּ׃
78.e: And still again they tried God, And set bounds to the Holy One of Israel.

78.s: לֹא־זָכְרוּ אֶת־יָדוֹ יוֹם אֲ‍שֶׁר־פָּדָם מִנִּי־צָר׃
78.e: They remembered not His hand, Nor the day when He redeemed them from the adversary.

78.s: אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם בְּמִצְרַיִם אֹתוֹתָיו וּמוֹפְתָיו בִּשְׂדֵה־צֹעַן׃
78.e: How He set His signs in Egypt, And His wonders in the field of Zoan; .

78.s: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ לְדָם יְאֹרֵיהֶם וְנֹזְלֵיהֶם בַּל־יִשְׁתָּיוּן׃
78.e: And turned their rivers into blood, So that they could not drink their streams.

78.s: יְשַׁלַּח בָּהֶם עָרֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵם וּצְפַרְדֵּעַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵם׃
78.e: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; And frogs, which destroyed them.

78.s: וַיִּתֵּן לֶחָסִיל יְבוּלָם וִיגִיעָם לָאַרְבֶּה׃
78.e: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, And their labour unto the locust.

78.s: יַהֲרֹג בַּבָּרָד גַּפְנָם וְשִׁקְמוֹתָם בַּחֲנָמַל׃
78.e: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycamore-trees with frost.

78.s: וַיַּסְגֵּר לַבָּרָד בְּעִירָם וּמִקְנֵיהֶם לָרְשָׁפִים׃
78.e: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to fiery bolts.

78.s: יְשַׁלַּח־בָּם חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ עֶבְרָה וָזַעַם וְצָרָה מִשְׁלַחַת מַלְאֲכֵי רָעִים׃
78.e: He sent forth upon them the fierceness of His anger, Wrath, and indignation, and trouble, A sending of messengers of evil.

78.s: יְפַלֵּס נָתִיב לְאַפּוֹ לֹא־חָשַׂךְ מִמָּוֶת נַפְשָׁם וְחַיָּתָם לַדֶּבֶר הִסְגִּיר׃
78.e: He levelled a path for His anger; He spared not their soul from death, But gave their life over to the pestilence;

78.s: וַיַּךְ כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּמִצְרָיִם רֵאשִׁית אוֹנִים בְּאָהֳלֵי־חָם׃
78.e: And smote all the first-born in Egypt, The first-fruits of their strength in the tents of Ham;

78.s: וַיַּסַּע כַּצֹּאן עַמּוֹ וַיְנַהֲגֵם כַּעֵדֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
78.e: But He made His own people to go forth like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

78.s: וַיַּנְחֵם לָבֶטַח וְלֹא פָחָדוּ וְאֶת־אוֹיְבֵיהֶם כִּסָּה הַיָּם׃
78.e: And He led them safely, and they feared not; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

78.s: וַיְבִיאֵם אֶל־גְּבוּל קָדְשׁוֹ הַר־זֶה קָנְתָה יְמִינוֹ׃
78.e: And He brought them to His holy border, To the mountain, which His right hand had gotten.

78.s: וַיְגָרֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם גּוֹיִם וַיַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶבֶל נַחֲלָה וַיַּשְׁכֵּן בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
78.e: He drove out the nations also before them, And allotted them for an inheritance by line, And made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

78.s: וַיְנַסּוּ וַיַּמְרוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן וְעֵדוֹתָיו לֹא שָׁמָרוּ׃
78.e: Yet they tried and provoked God, the Most High, And kept not His testimonies;

78.s: וַיִּסֹּגוּ וַיִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם נֶהְפְּכוּ כְּקֶשֶׁת רְמִיָּה׃
78.e: But turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers; They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

78.s: וַיַּכְעִיסוּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָם וּבִפְסִילֵיהֶם יַקְנִיאוּהוּ׃
78.e: For they provoked Him with their high places, And moved Him to jealousy with their graven images.

78.s: שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים וַיִּתְעַבָּר וַיִּמְאַס מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
78.e: God heard, and was wroth, And He greatly abhorred Israel;

78.s: וַיִּטֹּשׁ מִשְׁכַּן שִׁלוֹ אֹהֶל שִׁכֵּן בָּאָדָם׃
78.e: And He forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent which He had made to dwell among men;

78.s: וַיִּתֵּן לַשְּׁבִי עֻזּוֹ וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ בְיַד־צָר׃
78.e: And delivered His strength into captivity, And His glory into the adversary's hand.

78.s: וַיַּסְגֵּר לַחֶרֶב עַמּוֹ וּבְנַחֲלָתוֹ הִתְעַבָּר׃
78.e: He gave His people over also unto the sword; And was wroth with His inheritance.

78.s: בַּחוּרָיו אָכְלָה־אֵשׁ וּבְתוּלֹתָיו לֹא הוּלָּלוּ׃
78.e: Fire devoured their young men; And their virgins had no marriage-song.

78.s: כֹּהֲנָיו בַּחֶרֶב נָפָלוּ וְאַלְמְנֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּינָה׃
78.e: Their priests fell by the sword; And their widows made no lamentation. .

78.s: וַיִּקַץ כְּיָשֵׁן אֲדֹנָי כְּגִבּוֹר מִתְרוֹנֵן מִיָּיִן׃
78.e: Then the Lord awaked as one asleep, Like a mighty man recovering from wine.

78.s: וַיַּךְ־צָרָיו אָחוֹר חֶרְפַּת עוֹלָם נָתַן לָמוֹ׃
78.e: And He smote His adversaries backward; He put upon them a perpetual reproach.

78.s: וַיִּמְאַס בְּאֹהֶל יוֹסֵף וּבְשֵׁבֶט אֶפְרַיִם לֹא בָחָר׃
78.e: Moreover He abhorred the tent of Joseph, And chose not the tribe of Ephraim;

78.s: וַיִּבְחַר אֶת־שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה אֶת־הַר צִיּוֹן אֲשֶׁר אָהֵב׃
78.e: But chose the tribe of Judah, The mount Zion which He loved.

78.s: וַיִּבֶן כְּמוֹ־רָמִים מִקְדָּשׁוֹ כְּאֶרֶץ יְסָדָהּ לְעוֹלָם׃
78.e: And He built His sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which He hath founded for ever.

78.s: וַיִּבְחַר בְּדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִמִּכְלְאֹת צֹאן׃
78.e: He chose David also His servant, And took him from the sheepfolds;

78.s: מֵאַחַר עָלוֹת הֱבִיאוֹ לִרְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹב עַמּוֹ וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָתוֹ׃
78.e: From following the ewes that give suck He brought him, To be shepherd over Jacob His people, and Israel His inheritance.

78.s: וַיִּרְעֵם כְּתֹם לְבָבוֹ וּבִתְבוּנוֹת כַּפָּיו יַנְחֵם׃
78.e: So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart; And lead them by the skilfulness of his hands.

79.s: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱ‍לֹהִים בָּאוּ גוֹיִם בְּנַחֲלָתֶךָ טִמְּאוּ אֶת־הֵיכַל קָדְשֶׁךָ שָׂמוּ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם לְעִיִּים׃
79.e: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the heathen are come into Thine inheritance; They have defiled Thy holy temple; They have made Jerusalem into heaps.

79.s: נָתְנוּ אֶת־נִבְלַת עֲבָדֶיךָ מַאֲכָל לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם בְּשַׂר חֲסִידֶיךָ לְחַיְתוֹ־אָרֶץ׃
79.e: They have given the dead bodies of Thy servants to be food unto the fowls of the heaven, The flesh of Thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

79.s: שָׁפְכוּ דָמָם כַּמַּיִם סְבִיבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְאֵין קוֹבֵר׃
79.e: They have shed their blood like water Round about Jerusalem, with none to bury them.

79.s: הָיִינוּ חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ לַעַג וָקֶלֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵינוּ׃
79.e: We are become a taunt to our neighbours, A scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

79.s: עַד־מָה יְהוָה תֶּאֱנַף לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ קִנְאָתֶךָ׃
79.e: How long, O LORD, wilt Thou be angry for ever? How long will Thy jealousy burn like fire?

79.s: שְׁפֹךְ חֲמָתְךָ אֶל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יְדָעוּךָ וְעַל מַמְלָכוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּשִׁמְךָ לֹא קָרָאוּ׃
79.e: Pour out Thy wrath upon the nations that know Thee not, And upon the kingdoms that call not upon Thy name.
For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his habitation.

79.s: אַל־תִּזְכָּר־לָנוּ עֲוֺנֹת רִאשֹׁנִים מַהֵר יְקַדְּמוּנוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ כִּי דַלּוֹנוּ מְאֹד׃
79.e: Remember not against us the iniquities of our forefathers; Let Thy compassions speedily come to meet us; For we are brought very low.

79.s: עָזְרֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ עַל־דְּבַר כְּבוֹד־שְׁמֶךָ וְהַצִּילֵנוּ וְכַפֵּר עַל־חַטֹּאתֵינוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ׃
79.e: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the sake of the glory of Thy name; And deliver us, and forgive our sins, for Thy name's sake.

79.s: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה אֱ‍לֹהֵיהֶם יִוָּדַע בגיים [בַּגּוֹיִם] לְעֵינֵינוּ נִקְמַת דַּם־עֲבָדֶיךָ הַשָּׁפוּךְ׃
79.e: Wherefore should the nations say: 'Where is their God?' Let the avenging of Thy servants' blood that is shed Be made known among the nations in our sight. .

79.s: תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶיךָ אֶנְקַת אָסִיר כְּגֹדֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ הוֹתֵר בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה׃
79.e: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before Thee; According to the greatness of Thy power set free those that are appointed to death;

79.s: וְהָשֵׁב לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ שִׁבְעָתַיִם אֶל־חֵיקָם חֶרְפָּתָם אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּךָ אֲדֹנָי׃
79.e: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached Thee, O Lord.

79.s: וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַמְּךָ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ נוֹדֶה לְּךָ לְעוֹלָם לְדֹר וָדֹר נְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃
79.e: So we that are Thy people and the flock of Thy pasture Will give Thee thanks for ever; We will tell of Thy praise to all generations.

80.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אֶל־שֹׁשַׁנִּים עֵדוּת לְאָסָף מִזְמוֹר׃
80.e: For the Leader; upon Shoshannim. A testimony. A Psalm of Asaph.

80.s: רֹעֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל הַאֲזִינָה נֹהֵג כַּצֹּאן יוֹסֵף יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרוּבִים הוֹפִיעָה׃
80.e: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that art enthroned upon the cherubim, shine forth.

80.s: לִפְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם וּבִנְיָמִן וּמְנַשֶּׁה עוֹרְרָה אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֶךָ וּלְכָה לִישֻׁעָתָה לָּנוּ׃
80.e: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up Thy might, And come to save us.

80.s: אֱלֹהִים הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ וְהָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃
80.e: O God, restore us; And cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

80.s: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת עַד־מָתַי עָשַׁנְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּת עַמֶּךָ׃
80.e: O LORD God of hosts, How long wilt Thou be angry against the prayer of Thy people?

80.s: הֶאֱכַלְתָּם לֶחֶם דִּמְעָה וַתַּשְׁקֵמוֹ בִּדְמָעוֹת שָׁלִישׁ׃
80.e: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in large measure.

80.s: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ מָדוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ וְאֹיְבֵינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ־לָמוֹ׃
80.e: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours; And our enemies mock as they please.

80.s: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ וְהָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃
80.e: O God of hosts, restore us; And cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

80.s: גֶּפֶן מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּסִּיעַ תְּגָרֵשׁ גּוֹיִם וַתִּטָּעֶהָ׃
80.e: Thou didst pluck up a vine out of Egypt; Thou didst drive out the nations, and didst plant it.

80.s: פִּנִּיתָ לְפָנֶיהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵשׁ שָׁרָשֶׁיהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא־אָרֶץ׃
80.e: Thou didst clear a place before it, And it took deep root, and filled the land.

80.s: כָּסּוּ הָרִים צִלָּהּ וַעֲנָפֶיהָ אַרְזֵי־אֵל׃
80.e: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, And the mighty cedars with the boughs thereof.

80.s: תְּשַׁלַּח קְצִירֶהָ עַד־יָם וְאֶל־נָהָר יוֹנְקוֹתֶיהָ׃
80.e: She sent out her branches unto the sea, And her shoots unto the River.

80.s: לָמָּה פָּרַצְתָּ גְדֵרֶיהָ וְאָרוּהָ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ׃
80.e: Why hast Thou broken down her fences, So that all they that pass by the way do pluck her?

80.s: יְכַרְסְמֶנָּה חֲזִיר מִיָּעַר וְזִיז שָׂדַי יִרְעֶנָּה׃
80.e: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, That which moveth in the field feedeth on it.

80.s: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שׁוּב־נָא הַבֵּט מִשָּׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וּפְקֹד גֶּפֶן זֹאת׃
80.e: O God of hosts, return, we beseech Thee; Look from heaven, and behold, and be mindful of this vine,

80.s: וְכַנָּה אֲשֶׁר־נָטְעָה יְמִינֶךָ וְעַל־בֵּן אִמַּצְתָּה לָּךְ׃
80.e: And of the stock which Thy right hand hath planted, And the branch that Thou madest strong for Thyself. .

80.s: שְׂרֻפָה בָאֵשׁ כְּסוּחָה מִגַּעֲרַת פָּנֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ׃
80.e: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; They perish at the rebuke of Thy countenance.

80.s: תְּהִי־יָדְךָ עַל־אִישׁ יְמִינֶךָ עַל־בֶּן־אָדָם אִמַּצְתָּ לָּךְ׃
80.e: Let Thy hand be upon the man of Thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom Thou madest strong for Thyself.

80.s: וְלֹא־נָסוֹג מִמֶּךָּ תְּחַיֵּנוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא׃
80.e: So shall we not turn back from Thee; Quicken Thou us, and we will call upon Thy name.

80.s: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ הָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃
80.e: O LORD God of hosts, restore us; Cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

81.e: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. [A Psalm] of Asaph.

81.s: הַרְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִים עוּזֵּנוּ הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
81.e: Sing aloud unto God our strength; shout unto the God of Jacob.
Take up the melody, and sound the timbrel, the sweet harp with the psaltery.

81.s: תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר בַּכֵּסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּנוּ׃
81.e: Blow the horn at the new moon, at the full moon for our feast-day.

81.s: כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
81.e: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

81.s: עֵדוּת בִּיהוֹסֵף שָׂמוֹ בְּצֵאתוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם שְׂפַת לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי אֶשְׁמָע׃
81.e: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when He went forth against the land of Egypt. The speech of one that I knew not did I hear:

81.s: הֲסִירוֹתִי מִסֵּבֶל שִׁכְמוֹ כַּפָּיו מִדּוּד תַּעֲבֹרְנָה׃
81.e: 'I removed his shoulder from the burden; His hands were freed from the basket.

81.s: בַּצָּרָה קָרָאתָ וָאֲחַלְּצֶךָּ אֶעֶנְךָ בְּסֵתֶר רַעַם אֶבְחָנְךָ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה סֶלָה׃
81.e: Thou didst call in trouble, and I rescued thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah

81.s: שְׁמַע עַמִּי וְאָעִידָה בָּךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אִם־תִּשְׁמַע־לִי׃
81.e: Hear, O My people, and I will admonish thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto Me!

81.s: לֹא־יִהְיֶה בְךָ אֵל זָר וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְאֵל נֵכָר׃
81.e: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.

81.s: אָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַמַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם הַרְחֶב־פִּיךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵהוּ׃
81.e: I am the LORD thy God, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt; open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

81.s: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע עַמִּי לְקוֹלִי וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־אָבָה לִי׃
81.e: But My people hearkened not to My voice; And Israel would none of Me.
So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, That they might walk in their own counsels.

81.s: לוּ עַמִּי שֹׁמֵעַ לִי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּדְרָכַי יְהַלֵּכוּ׃
81.e: Oh that My people would hearken unto Me, That Israel would walk in My ways!

81.s: כִּמְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶם אַכְנִיעַ וְעַל צָרֵיהֶם אָשִׁיב יָדִי׃
81.e: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn My hand against their adversaries.

81.s: מְשַׂנְאֵי יְהוָה יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לוֹ וִיהִי עִתָּם לְעוֹלָם׃
81.e: The haters of the LORD should dwindle away before Him; And their punishment should endure for ever.

81.s: וַיַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵלֶב חִטָּה וּמִצּוּר דְּבַשׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶךָ׃
81.e: They should also be fed with the fat of wheat; and with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee.'

82.s: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱ‍לֹהִים נִצָּב בַּעֲדַת־אֵל בְּקֶרֶב אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁפֹּט׃
82.e: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of God; in the midst of the judges He judgeth:
'How long will ye judge unjustly, and respect the persons of the wicked? Selah
Judge the poor and fatherless; do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
Rescue the poor and needy; deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

82.s: לֹא יָדְעוּ וְלֹא יָבִינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָה יִתְהַלָּכוּ יִמּוֹטוּ כָּל־מוֹסְדֵי אָרֶץ׃
82.e: They know not, neither do they understand; they go about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are moved.

82.s: אֲ‍נִי־אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִים אַתֶּם וּבְנֵי עֶלְיוֹן כֻּלְּכֶם׃
82.e: I said: Ye are godlike beings, and all of you sons of the Most High.

82.s: אָכֵן כְּאָדָם תְּמוּתוּן וּכְאַחַד הַשָּׂרִים תִּפֹּלוּ׃
82.e: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.'

82.s: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים שָׁפְטָה הָאָרֶץ כִּי־אַתָּה תִנְחַל בְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִם׃
82.e: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for Thou shalt possess all the nations.

83.e: A Song, a Psalm of Asaph.
O God, keep not Thou silence; Hold not Thy peace, and be not still, O God.

83.s: כִּי־הִנֵּה אוֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָיוּן וּמְשַׂנְאֶיךָ נָשְׂאוּ רֹאשׁ׃
83.e: For, lo, Thine enemies are in an uproar; And they that hate Thee have lifted up the head.
They hold crafty converse against Thy people, And take counsel against Thy treasured ones.

83.s: אָמְרוּ לְכוּ וְנַכְחִידֵם מִגּוֹי וְלֹא־יִזָּכֵר שֵׁם־יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד׃
83.e: They have said: 'Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.'

83.s: כִּי נוֹעֲצוּ לֵב יַחְדָּו עָלֶיךָ בְּרִית יִכְרֹתוּ׃
83.e: For they have consulted together with one consent; Against Thee do they make a covenant;
The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

83.s: גְּבָל וְעַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק פְּלֶשֶׁת עִם־יֹשְׁבֵי צוֹר׃
83.e: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

83.s: גַּם־אַשּׁוּר נִלְוָה עִמָּם הָיוּ זְרוֹעַ לִבְנֵי־לוֹט סֶלָה׃
83.e: Assyria also is joined with them; They have been an arm to the children of Lot. Selah

83.s: עֲשֵׂה־לָהֶם כְּמִדְיָן כְּסִיסְרָא כְיָבִין בְּנַחַל קִישׁוֹן׃
83.e: Do Thou unto them as unto Midian; As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook Kishon;
Who were destroyed at En-dor; They became as dung for the earth.

83.s: שִׁיתֵמוֹ נְדִיבֵמוֹ כְּעֹרֵב וְכִזְאֵב וּכְזֶבַח וּכְצַלְמֻנָּע כָּל־נְסִיכֵמוֹ׃
83.e: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, And like Zebah and Zalmunna all their princes;

83.s: אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ נִירֲשָׁה לָּנוּ אֵת נְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים׃
83.e: Who said: 'Let us take to ourselves in possession The habitations of God.'
O my God, make them like the whirling dust; As stubble before the wind.
As the fire that burneth the forest, And as the flame that setteth the mountains ablaze;
So pursue them with Thy tempest, And affright them with Thy storm.

83.s: מַלֵּא פְנֵיהֶם קָלוֹן וִיבַקְשׁוּ שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה׃
83.e: Fill their faces with shame; That they may seek Thy name, O LORD.
Let them be ashamed and affrighted for ever; Yea, let them be abashed and perish;

83.s: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־אַתָּה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה לְבַדֶּךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
83.e: That they may know that it is Thou alone whose name is the LORD, The Most High over all the earth.

84.e: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
How lovely are Thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

84.s: נִכְסְפָה וְגַם־כָּלְתָה נַפְשִׁי לְחַצְרוֹת יְהוָה לִבִּי וּבְשָׂרִי יְרַנְּנוּ אֶל אֵל־חָי׃
84.e: My soul yearneth, yea, even pineth for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh sing for joy unto the living God.

84.s: גַּם־צִפּוֹר מָצְאָה בַיִת וּדְרוֹר קֵן לָהּ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁתָה אֶפְרֹחֶיהָ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָי׃
84.e: Yea, the sparrow hath found a house, and the swallow a nest for herself, Where she may lay her young; Thine altars, O LORD of hosts, My King, and my God—

84.s: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה׃
84.e: Happy are they that dwell in Thy house, they are ever praising Thee. Selah

84.s: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם עוֹז־לוֹ בָךְ מְסִלּוֹת בִּלְבָבָם׃
84.e: Happy is the man whose strength is in Thee; in whose heart are the highways.

84.s: עֹבְרֵי בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא מַעְיָן יְשִׁיתוּהוּ גַּם־בְּרָכוֹת יַעְטֶה מוֹרֶה׃
84.e: Passing through the valley of Baca they make it a place of springs; yea, the early rain clotheth it with blessings.

84.s: יֵלְכוּ מֵחַיִל אֶל־חָיִל יֵרָאֶה אֶל־אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּוֹן׃
84.e: They go from strength to strength, every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.

84.s: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
84.e: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah

84.s: מָגִנֵּנוּ רְאֵה אֱלֹהִים וְהַבֵּט פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
84.e: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of Thine anointed.

84.s: כִּי טוֹב־יוֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶיךָ מֵאָלֶף בָּחַרְתִּי הִסְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵית אֱלֹהַי מִדּוּר בְּאָהֳלֵי־רֶשַׁע׃
84.e: For a day in Thy courts is better than a thousand; I had rather stand at the threshold of the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

84.s: כִּי שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים חֵן וְכָבוֹד יִתֵּן יְהוָה לֹא יִמְנַע־טוֹב לַהֹלְכִים בְּתָמִים׃
84.e: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD giveth grace and glory; No good thing will He withhold from them that walk uprightly.

84.s: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵחַ בָּךְ׃
84.e: O LORD of hosts, happy is the man that trusteth in Thee.

85.e: For the Leader. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.

85.s: רָצִיתָ יְהוָה אַרְצֶךָ שַׁבְתָּ שבות [שְׁבִית] יַעֲקֹב׃
85.e: LORD, Thou hast been favourable unto Thy land, Thou hast turned the captivity of Jacob.

85.s: נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן עַמֶּךָ כִּסִּיתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָם סֶלָה׃
85.e: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of Thy people, Thou hast pardoned all their sin. Selah .
Thou hast withdrawn all Thy wrath; Thou hast turned from the fierceness of Thine anger.

85.s: שׁוּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ וְהָפֵר כַּעַסְךָ עִמָּנוּ׃
85.e: Restore us, O God of our salvation, And cause Thine indignation toward us to cease.

85.s: הַלְעוֹלָם תֶּאֱנַף־בָּנוּ תִּמְשֹׁךְ אַפְּךָ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
85.e: Wilt Thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt Thou draw out Thine anger to all generations?
Wilt Thou not quicken us again, That Thy people may rejoice in Thee?
Show us Thy mercy, O LORD, And grant us Thy salvation.

85.s: אֶשְׁמְעָה מַה־יְדַבֵּר הָאֵל יְהוָה כִּי יְדַבֵּר שָׁלוֹם אֶל־עַמּוֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָיו וְאַל־יָשׁוּבוּ לְכִסְלָה׃
85.e: I will hear what God the LORD will speak; For He will speak peace unto His people, and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly.

85.s: אַךְ קָרוֹב לִירֵאָיו יִשְׁעוֹ לִשְׁכֹּן כָּבוֹד בְּאַרְצֵנוּ׃
85.e: Surely His salvation is nigh them that fear Him; That glory may dwell in our land.
Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

85.s: אֱמֶת מֵאֶרֶץ תִּצְמָח וְצֶדֶק מִשָּׁמַיִם נִשְׁקָף׃
85.e: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.

85.s: גַּם־יְהוָה יִתֵּן הַטּוֹב וְאַרְצֵנוּ תִּתֵּן יְבוּלָהּ׃
85.e: Yea, the LORD will give that which is good; And our land shall yield her produce.

85.s: צֶדֶק לְפָנָיו יְהַלֵּךְ וְיָשֵׂם לְדֶרֶךְ פְּעָמָיו׃
85.e: Righteousness shall go before Him, And shall make His footsteps a way.

86.s: תְּפִלָּה לְדָוִד הַטֵּה־יְהוָה אָזְנְךָ עֲנֵנִי כִּי־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנִי׃
86.e: A Prayer of David. Incline Thine ear, O LORD, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.
