86.s: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי־חָסִיד אָנִי הוֹשַׁע עַבְדְּךָ אַתָּה אֱלֹהַי הַבּוֹטֵחַ אֵלֶיךָ׃
86.e: Keep my soul, for I am godly; O Thou my God, save Thy servant that trusteth in Thee.

86.s: חָנֵּנִי אֲדֹנָי כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶקְרָא כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
86.e: Be gracious unto me, O Lord; For unto Thee do I cry all the day.

86.s: שַׂמֵּחַ נֶפֶשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא׃
86.e: Rejoice the soul of Thy servant; For unto Thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

86.s: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב־חֶסֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶיךָ׃
86.e: For Thou, Lord, art good, and ready to pardon, And plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon Thee.

86.s: הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה תְּפִלָּתִי וְהַקְשִׁיבָה בְּקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָי׃
86.e: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; And attend unto the voice of my supplications.
In the day of my trouble I call upon Thee; For Thou wilt answer me.
There is none like unto Thee among the gods, O Lord, And there are no works like Thine.

86.s: כָּל־גּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ יָבוֹאוּ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי וִיכַבְּדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ׃
86.e: All nations whom Thou hast made shall come and prostrate themselves before Thee, O Lord; And they shall glorify Thy name.

86.s: כִּי־גָדוֹל אַתָּה וְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ׃
86.e: For Thou art great, and doest wondrous things; Thou art God alone.

86.s: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ אֲהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ יַחֵד לְבָבִי לְיִרְאָה שְׁמֶךָ׃
86.e: Teach me, O LORD, Thy way, that I may walk in Thy truth; Make one my heart to fear Thy name. .

86.s: אוֹדְךָ אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהַי בְּכָל־לְבָבִי וַאֲכַבְּדָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם׃
86.e: I will thank Thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; And I will glorify Thy name for evermore.

86.s: כִּי־חַסְדְּךָ גָּדוֹל עָלָי וְהִצַּלְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּיָּה׃
86.e: For great is Thy mercy toward me; And Thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest nether-world.

86.s: אֱלֹהִים זֵדִים קָמוּ־עָלַי וַעֲדַת עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא שָׂמוּךָ לְנֶגְדָּם׃
86.e: O God, the proud are risen up against me, And the company of violent men have sought after my soul, And have not set Thee before them.

86.s: וְאַתָּה אֲדֹנָי אֵל־רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃
86.e: But Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion and gracious, Slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

86.s: פְּנֵה אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי תְּנָה־עֻזְּךָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעָה לְבֶן־אֲמָתֶךָ׃
86.e: O turn unto me, and be gracious unto me; Give Thy strength unto Thy servant, And save the son of Thy handmaid.

86.s: עֲשֵׂה־עִמִּי אוֹת לְטוֹבָה וְיִרְאוּ שֹׂנְאַי וְיֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה עֲזַרְתַּנִי וְנִחַמְתָּנִי׃
86.e: Work in my behalf a sign for good; That they that hate me may see it, and be put to shame, Because Thou, LORD, hast helped me, and comforted me.

87.e: A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

87.s: אֹהֵב יְהוָה שַׁעֲרֵי צִיּוֹן מִכֹּל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת יַעֲקֹב׃
87.e: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

87.s: נִכְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּר בָּךְ עִיר הָאֱלֹהִים סֶלָה׃
87.e: Glorious things are spoken of Thee, O city of God. Selah

87.s: אַזְכִּיר רַהַב וּבָבֶל לְיֹדְעָי הִנֵּה פְלֶשֶׁת וְצוֹר עִם־כּוּשׁ זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם׃
87.e: 'I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know Me; behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this one was born there.'

87.s: וּלֲצִיּוֹן יֵאָמַר אִישׁ וְאִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּהּ וְהוּא יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
87.e: But of Zion it shall be said: 'This man and that was born in her; And the Most High Himself doth establish her.'

87.s: יְהוָה יִסְפֹּר בִּכְתוֹב עַמִּים זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם סֶלָה׃
87.e: The LORD shall count in the register of the peoples: 'This one was born there.' Selah
And whether they sing or dance, all my thoughts are in Thee.

88.s: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לִבְנֵי קֹרַח לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מָחֲלַת לְעַנּוֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵימָן הָאֶזְרָחִי׃
88.e: A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Leader; upon Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.

88.s: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יְשׁוּעָתִי יוֹם־צָעַקְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה נֶגְדֶּךָ׃
88.e: O LORD, God of my salvation, What time I cry in the night before Thee,
Let my prayer come before Thee, Incline Thine ear unto my cry.

88.s: כִּי־שָׂבְעָה בְרָעוֹת נַפְשִׁי וְחַיַּי לִשְׁאוֹל הִגִּיעוּ׃
88.e: For my soul is sated with troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

88.s: נֶחְשַׁבְתִּי עִם־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר הָיִיתִי כְּגֶבֶר אֵין־אֱיָל׃
88.e: I am counted with them that go down into the pit; I am become as a man that hath no help;

88.s: בַּמֵּתִים חָפְשִׁי כְּמוֹ חֲלָלִים שֹׁכְבֵי קֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא זְכַרְתָּם עוֹד וְהֵמָּה מִיָּדְךָ נִגְזָרוּ׃
88.e: Set apart among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom Thou rememberest no more; And they are cut off from Thy hand. .
Thou hast laid me in the nether-most pit, In dark places, in the deeps.

88.s: עָלַי סָמְכָה חֲמָתֶךָ וְכָל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ עִנִּיתָ סֶּלָה׃
88.e: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And all Thy waves Thou pressest down. Selah

88.s: הִרְחַקְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַי מִמֶּנִּי שַׁתַּנִי תוֹעֵבוֹת לָמוֹ כָּלֻא וְלֹא אֵצֵא׃
88.e: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them; I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

88.s: עֵינִי דָאֲבָה מִנִּי עֹנִי קְרָאתִיךָ יְהוָה בְּכָל־יוֹם שִׁטַּחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ כַפָּי׃
88.e: Mine eye languisheth by reason of affliction; I have called upon Thee, O LORD, every day, I have spread forth my hands unto Thee.

88.s: הֲלַמֵּתִים תַּעֲשֶׂה־פֶּלֶא אִם־רְפָאִים יָקוּמוּ יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה׃
88.e: Wilt Thou work wonders for the dead? Or shall the shades arise and give Thee thanks? Selah
Shall Thy mercy be declared in the grave? Or Thy faithfulness in destruction?

88.s: הֲיִוָּדַע בַּחֹשֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ בְּאֶרֶץ נְשִׁיָּה׃
88.e: Shall Thy wonders be known in the dark? And Thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

88.s: וַאֲנִי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה שִׁוַּעְתִּי וּבַבֹּקֶר תְּפִלָּתִי תְקַדְּמֶךָּ׃
88.e: But as for me, unto Thee, O LORD, do I cry, And in the morning doth my prayer come to meet Thee.

88.s: לָמָה יְהוָה תִּזְנַח נַפְשִׁי תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי׃
88.e: LORD, why castest Thou off my soul? Why hidest Thou Thy face from me?

88.s: עָנִי אֲנִי וְגֹוֵעַ מִנֹּעַר נָשָׂאתִי אֵמֶיךָ אָפוּנָה׃
88.e: I am afflicted and at the point of death from my youth up; I have borne Thy terrors, I am distracted.
Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.

88.s: סַבּוּנִי כַמַּיִם כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִקִּיפוּ עָלַי יָחַד׃
88.e: They came round about me like water all the day; They compassed me about together.

88.s: הִרְחַקְתָּ מִמֶּנִּי אֹהֵב וָרֵעַ מְיֻדָּעַי מַחְשָׁךְ׃
88.e: Friend and companion hast Thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness.

89.s: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי׃
89.e: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.

89.s: חַסְדֵי יְהוָה עוֹלָם אָשִׁירָה לְדֹר וָדֹר אוֹדִיעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בְּפִי׃
89.e: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever; To all generations will I make known Thy faithfulness with my mouth.

89.s: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה שָׁמַיִם תָּכִן אֱמוּנָתְךָ בָהֶם׃
89.e: For I have said: 'For ever is mercy built; In the very heavens Thou dost establish Thy faithfulness.

89.s: כָּרַתִּי בְרִית לִבְחִירִי נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְדָוִד עַבְדִּי׃
89.e: I have made a covenant with My chosen, I have sworn unto David My servant:

89.s: עַד־עוֹלָם אָכִין זַרְעֶךָ וּבָנִיתִי לְדֹר־וָדוֹר כִּסְאֲךָ סֶלָה׃
89.e: For ever will I establish thy seed, And build up thy throne to all generations.' Selah

89.s: וְיוֹדוּ שָׁמַיִם פִּלְאֲךָ יְהוָה אַף־אֱמוּנָתְךָ בִּקְהַל קְדֹשִׁים׃
89.e: So shall the heavens praise Thy wonders, O LORD, Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

89.s: כִּי מִי בַשַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹךְ לַיהוָה יִדְמֶה לַיהוָה בִּבְנֵי אֵלִים׃
89.e: For who in the skies can be compared unto the LORD, Who among the sons of might can be likened unto the LORD,

89.s: אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־קְדֹשִׁים רַבָּה וְנוֹרָא עַל־כָּל־סְבִיבָיו׃
89.e: A God dreaded in the great council of the holy ones, And feared of all them that are about Him?

89.s: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת מִי־כָמוֹךָ חֲסִין יָהּ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ סְבִיבוֹתֶיךָ׃
89.e: O LORD God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto Thee, O LORD? And Thy faithfulness is round about Thee.

89.s: אַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בְּגֵאוּת הַיָּם בְּשׂוֹא גַלָּיו אַתָּה תְשַׁבְּחֵם׃
89.e: Thou rulest the proud swelling of the sea; When the waves thereof arise, Thou stillest them.

89.s: אַתָּה דִכִּאתָ כֶחָלָל רָהַב בִּזְרוֹעַ עֻזְּךָ פִּזַּרְתָּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ׃
89.e: Thou didst crush Rahab, as one that is slain; Thou didst scattered Thine enemies with the arm of Thy strength.

89.s: לְךָ שָׁמַיִם אַף־לְךָ אָרֶץ תֵּבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ אַתָּה יְסַדְתָּם׃
89.e: Thine are the heavens, Thine also the earth; The world and the fulness thereof, Thou hast founded them.

89.s: צָפוֹן וְיָמִין אַתָּה בְרָאתָם תָּבוֹר וְחֶרְמוֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
89.e: The north and the south, Thou hast created them; Tabor and Hermon rejoice in Thy name.

89.s: לְךָ זְרוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָה תָּעֹז יָדְךָ תָּרוּם יְמִינֶךָ׃
89.e: Thine is an arm with might; Strong is Thy hand, and exalted is Thy right hand.

89.s: צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאֶךָ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְקַדְּמוּ פָנֶיךָ׃
89.e: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Thy throne; Mercy and truth go before Thee.

89.s: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם יוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה יְהוָה בְּאוֹר־פָּנֶיךָ יְהַלֵּכוּן׃
89.e: Happy is the people that know the joyful shout; They walk, O LORD, in the light of Thy countenance.

89.s: בְּשִׁמְךָ יְגִילוּן כָּל־הַיּוֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ יָרוּמוּ׃
89.e: In Thy name do they rejoice all the day; And through Thy righteousness are they exalted.

89.s: כִּי־תִפְאֶרֶת עֻזָּמוֹ אָתָּה וּבִרְצֹנְךָ תרים [תָּרוּם] קַרְנֵנוּ׃
89.e: For Thou art the glory of their strength; And in Thy favour our horn is exalted.

89.s: כִּי לַיהוָה מָגִנֵּנוּ וְלִקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְכֵּנוּ׃
89.e: For of the LORD is our shield; And the Holy One of Israel is our king.

89.s: אָז דִּבַּרְתָּ־בְחָזוֹן לַחֲסִידֶיךָ וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁוִּיתִי עֵזֶר עַל־גִּבּוֹר הֲרִימוֹתִי בָחוּר מֵעָם׃
89.e: Then Thou spokest in vision to Thy godly ones, And saidst: 'I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

89.s: מָצָאתִי דָּוִד עַבְדִּי בְּשֶׁמֶן קָדְשִׁי מְשַׁחְתִּיו׃
89.e: I have found David My servant; With My holy oil have I anointed him;

89.s: אֲשֶׁר יָדִי תִּכּוֹן עִמּוֹ אַף־זְרוֹעִי תְאַמְּצֶנּוּ׃
89.e: With whom My hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.

89.s: לֹא־יַשִּׁא אוֹיֵב בּוֹ וּבֶן־עַוְלָה לֹא יְעַנֶּנּוּ׃
89.e: The enemy shall not exact from him; Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

89.s: וְכַתּוֹתִי מִפָּנָיו צָרָיו וּמְשַׂנְאָיו אֶגּוֹף׃
89.e: And I will beat to pieces his adversaries before him, And smite them that hate him.

89.s: וֶאֶמוּנָתִי וְחַסְדִּי עִמּוֹ וּבִשְׁמִי תָּרוּם קַרְנוֹ׃
89.e: But My faithfulness and My mercy shall be with him; And through My name shall his horn be exalted.

89.s: וְשַׂמְתִּי בַיָּם יָדוֹ וּבַנְּהָרוֹת יְמִינוֹ׃
89.e: I will set his hand also on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.

89.s: הוּא יִקְרָאֵנִי אָבִי אָתָּה אֵלִי וְצוּר יְשׁוּעָתִי׃
89.e: He shall call unto Me: Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation. .

89.s: אַף־אָנִי בְּכוֹר אֶתְּנֵהוּ עֶלְיוֹן לְמַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ׃
89.e: I also will appoint him first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.

89.s: לְעוֹלָם אשמור־[אֶשְׁמָר־] לוֹ חַסְדִּי וּבְרִיתִי נֶאֱמֶנֶת לוֹ׃
89.e: For ever will I keep for him My mercy, And My covenant shall stand fast with him.

89.s: וְשַׂמְתִּי לָעַד זַרְעוֹ וְכִסְאוֹ כִּימֵי שָׁמָיִם׃
89.e: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.

89.s: אִם־יַעַזְבוּ בָנָיו תּוֹרָתִי וּבְמִשְׁפָּטַי לֹא יֵלֵכוּן׃
89.e: If his children forsake My law, And walk not in Mine ordinances; :

89.s: אִם־חֻקֹּתַי יְחַלֵּלוּ וּמִצְוֺתַי לֹא יִשְׁמֹרוּ׃
89.e: If they profane My statutes, And keep not My commandments;

89.s: וּפָקַדְתִּי בְשֵׁבֶט פִּשְׁעָם וּבִנְגָעִים עֲוֺנָם׃
89.e: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with strokes.

89.s: וְחַסְדִּי לֹא־אָפִיר מֵעִמּוֹ וְלֹא־אֲשַׁקֵּר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִי׃
89.e: But My mercy will I not break off from him, Nor will I be false to My faithfulness.

89.s: לֹא־אֲחַלֵּל בְּרִיתִי וּמוֹצָא שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֲשַׁנֶּה׃
89.e: My covenant will I not profane, Nor alter that which is gone out of My lips.

89.s: אַחַת נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁי אִם־לְדָוִד אֲכַזֵּב׃
89.e: Once have I sworn by My holiness: Surely I will not be false unto David;

89.s: זַרְעוֹ לְעוֹלָם יִהְיֶה וְכִסְאוֹ כַשֶּׁמֶשׁ נֶגְדִּי׃
89.e: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before Me.

89.s: כְּיָרֵחַ יִכּוֹן עוֹלָם וְעֵד בַּשַּׁחַק נֶאֱמָן סֶלָה׃
89.e: It shall be established for ever as the moon; And be stedfast as the witness in sky.' Selah

89.s: וְאַתָּה זָנַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָס הִתְעַבַּרְתָּ עִם־מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
89.e: But Thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with Thine anointed.

89.s: נֵאַרְתָּה בְּרִית עַבְדֶּךָ חִלַּלְתָּ לָאָרֶץ נִזְרוֹ׃
89.e: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of Thy servant; Thou hast profaned his crown even to the ground.

89.s: פָּרַצְתָּ כָל־גְּדֵרֹתָיו שַׂמְתָּ מִבְצָרָיו מְחִתָּה׃
89.e: Thou hast broken down all his fences; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.

89.s: שַׁסֻּהוּ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ הָיָה חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנָיו׃
89.e: All that pass by the way spoil him; He is become a taunt to his neighbours.

89.s: הֲרִימוֹתָ יְמִין צָרָיו הִשְׂמַחְתָּ כָּל־אוֹיְבָיו׃
89.e: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

89.s: אַף־תָּשִׁיב צוּר חַרְבּוֹ וְלֹא הֲקֵימֹתוֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃
89.e: Yea, Thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.

89.s: הִשְׁבַּתָּ מִטְּהָרוֹ וְכִסְאוֹ לָאָרֶץ מִגַּרְתָּה׃
89.e: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.

89.s: הִקְצַרְתָּ יְמֵי עֲלוּמָיו הֶעֱטִיתָ עָלָיו בּוּשָׁה סֶלָה׃
89.e: The days of his youth hast Thou shortened; Thou hast covered him with shame. Selah

89.s: עַד־מָה יְהוָה תִּסָּתֵר לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ חֲמָתֶךָ׃
89.e: How long, O LORD, wilt Thou hide Thyself for ever? How long shall Thy wrath burn like fire?

89.s: זְכָר־אֲנִי מֶה־חָלֶד עַל־מַה־שָּׁוְא בָּרָאתָ כָל־בְּנֵי־אָדָם׃
89.e: O remember how short my time is; For what vanity hast Thou created all the children of men!

89.s: מִי גֶבֶר יִחְיֶה וְלֹא יִרְאֶה־מָּוֶת יְמַלֵּט נַפְשׁוֹ מִיַּד־שְׁאוֹל סֶלָה׃
89.e: What man is he that liveth and shall not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the power of the grave? Selah

89.s: אַיֵּה חֲסָדֶיךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲדֹנָי נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לְדָוִד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶךָ׃
89.e: Where are Thy former mercies, O Lord, Which Thou didst swear unto David in Thy faithfulness?

89.s: זְכֹר אֲדֹנָי חֶרְפַּת עֲבָדֶיךָ שְׂאֵתִי בְחֵיקִי כָּל־רַבִּים עַמִּים׃
89.e: Remember, Lord, the taunt of Thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom [the taunt of] so many peoples;

89.s: אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ עִקְּבוֹת מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
89.e: Wherewith Thine enemies have taunted, O LORD, Wherewith they have taunted the footsteps of Thine anointed.

89.s: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃
89.e: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

90.s: תְּפִלָּה לְמֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲ‍דֹנָי מָעוֹן אַתָּה הָיִיתָ לָּנוּ בְּדֹר וָדֹר׃
90.e: A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, Thou hast been our dwelling-place in all generations.

90.s: בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים יֻלָּדוּ וַתְּחוֹלֵל אֶרֶץ וְתֵבֵל וּמֵעוֹלָם עַד־עוֹלָם אַתָּה אֵל׃
90.e: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever Thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, Thou art God.

90.s: תָּשֵׁב אֱנוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּא וַתֹּאמֶר שׁוּבוּ בְנֵי־אָדָם׃
90.e: Thou turnest man to contrition; And sayest: 'Return, ye children of men.'

90.s: כִּי אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ כְּיוֹם אֶתְמוֹל כִּי יַעֲבֹר וְאַשְׁמוּרָה בַלָּיְלָה׃
90.e: For a thousand years in Thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.

90.s: זְרַמְתָּם שֵׁנָה יִהְיוּ בַּבֹּקֶר כֶּחָצִיר יַחֲלֹף׃
90.e: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep; In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

90.s: בַּבֹּקֶר יָצִיץ וְחָלָף לָעֶרֶב יְמוֹלֵל וְיָבֵשׁ׃
90.e: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
For we are consumed in Thine anger, And by Thy wrath are we hurried away.

90.s: שת [שַׁתָּה] עֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּךָ עֲלֻמֵנוּ לִמְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ׃
90.e: Thou hast set our iniquities before Thee, Our secret sins in the light of Thy countenance.

90.s: כִּי כָל־יָמֵינוּ פָּנוּ בְעֶבְרָתֶךָ כִּלִּינוּ שָׁנֵינוּ כְמוֹ־הֶגֶה׃
90.e: For all our days are passed away in Thy wrath; We bring our years to an end as a tale that is told.

90.s: יְמֵי־שְׁנוֹתֵינוּ בָהֶם שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְאִם בִּגְבוּרֹת שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וְרָהְבָּם עָמָל וָאָוֶן כִּי־גָז חִישׁ וַנָּעֻפָה׃
90.e: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but travail and vanity; For it is speedily gone, and we fly away.
Who knoweth the power of Thine anger, And Thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto Thee?

90.s: לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן הוֹדַע וְנָבִא לְבַב חָכְמָה׃
90.e: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.
Return, O LORD; how long? And let it repent Thee concerning Thy servants.

90.s: שַׂבְּעֵנוּ בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וּנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל־יָמֵינוּ׃
90.e: O satisfy us in the morning with Thy mercy; That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

90.s: שַׂמְּחֵנוּ כִּימוֹת עִנִּיתָנוּ שְׁנוֹת רָאִינוּ רָעָה׃
90.e: Make us glad according to the days wherein Thou hast afflicted us, According to the years wherein we have seen evil.
Let Thy work appear unto Thy servants, And Thy glory upon their children.

90.s: וִיהִי נֹעַם אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָה עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנֵהוּ׃
90.e: And let the graciousness of the Lord our God be upon us; Establish Thou also upon us the work of our hands; Yea, the work of our hands establish Thou it.

91.s: יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן׃
91.e: O thou that dwellest in the covert of the Most High, And abidest in the shadow of the Almighty;

91.s: אֹמַר לַיהוָה מַחְסִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אֱלֹהַי אֶבְטַח־בּוֹ׃
91.e: I will say of the LORD, who is my refuge and my fortress, My God, in whom I trust,

91.s: כִּי הוּא יַצִּילְךָ מִפַּח יָקוּשׁ מִדֶּבֶר הַוּוֹת׃
91.e: That He will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the noisome pestilence.

91.s: בְּאֶבְרָתוֹ יָסֶךְ לָךְ וְתַחַת־כְּנָפָיו תֶּחְסֶה צִנָּה וְסֹחֵרָה אֲמִתּוֹ׃
91.e: He will cover thee with His pinions, And under His wings shalt thou take refuge; His truth is a shield and a buckler.

91.s: לֹא־תִירָא מִפַּחַד לָיְלָה מֵחֵץ יָעוּף יוֹמָם׃
91.e: Thou shalt not be afraid of the terror by night, Nor of the arrow that flieth by day;

91.s: מִדֶּבֶר בָּאֹפֶל יַהֲלֹךְ מִקֶּטֶב יָשׁוּד צָהֳרָיִם׃
91.e: Of the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor of the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

91.s: יִפֹּל מִצִּדְּךָ אֶלֶף וּרְבָבָה מִימִינֶךָ אֵלֶיךָ לֹא יִגָּשׁ׃
91.e: A thousand may fall at Thy side, And ten thousand at Thy right hand; It shall not come nigh thee.

91.s: רַק בְּעֵינֶיךָ תַבִּיט וְשִׁלֻּמַת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה׃
91.e: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the recompense of the wicked.

91.s: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה מַחְסִי עֶלְיוֹן שַׂמְתָּ מְעוֹנֶךָ׃
91.e: For thou hast made the LORD who is my refuge, Even the Most High, thy habitation.

91.s: לֹא־תְאֻנֶּה אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וְנֶגַע לֹא־יִקְרַב בְּאָהֳלֶךָ׃
91.e: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.
For He will give His angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
They shall bear thee upon their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

91.s: עַל־שַׁחַל וָפֶתֶן תִּדְרֹךְ תִּרְמֹס כְּפִיר וְתַנִּין׃
91.e: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and asp; The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under feet.

91.s: כִּי בִי חָשַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵהוּ אֲשַׂגְּבֵהוּ כִּי־יָדַע שְׁמִי׃
91.e: 'Because he hath set his love upon Me, therefore will I deliver him; I will set him on high, because he hath known My name.

91.s: יִקְרָאֵנִי וְאֶעֱנֵהוּ עִמּוֹ־אָנֹכִי בְצָרָה אֲחַלְּצֵהוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵהוּ׃
91.e: He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will rescue him, and bring him to honour.
With long life will I satisfy him, And make Him to behold My salvation.'

92.e: A Psalm, a Song. For the sabbath day.

92.s: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיהוָה וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
92.e: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, And to sing praises unto Thy name, O Most High;
To declare Thy lovingkindness in the morning, And Thy faithfulness in the night seasons,
With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.

92.s: כִּי שִׂמַּחְתַּנִי יְהוָה בְּפָעֳלֶךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן׃
92.e: For Thou, LORD, hast made me glad through Thy work; I will exult in the works of Thy hands.

92.s: מַה־גָּדְלוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ׃
92.e: How great are Thy works, O LORD! Thy thoughts are very deep.

92.s: אִישׁ־בַּעַר לֹא יֵדָע וּכְסִיל לֹא־יָבִין אֶת־זֹאת׃
92.e: A brutish man knoweth not, Neither doth a fool understand this.

92.s: בִּפְרֹחַ רְשָׁעִים כְּמוֹ עֵשֶׂב וַיָּצִיצוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן לְהִשָּׁמְדָם עֲדֵי־עַד׃
92.e: When the wicked spring up as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they may be destroyed for ever.
But Thou, O LORD, art on high for evermore.

92.s: כִּי הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּי־הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ יִתְפָּרְדוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
92.e: For, lo, Thine enemies, O LORD, For, lo, Thine enemies shall perish: All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

92.s: וַתָּרֶם כִּרְאֵים קַרְנִי בַּלֹּתִי בְּשֶׁמֶן רַעֲנָן׃
92.e: But my horn hast Thou exalted like the horn of the wild-ox; I am anointed with rich oil.

92.s: וַתַּבֵּט עֵינִי בְּשׁוּרָי בַּקָּמִים עָלַי מְרֵעִים תִּשְׁמַעְנָה אָזְנָי׃
92.e: Mine eye also hath gazed on them that lie in wait for me, Mine ears have heard my desire of the evil-doers that rise up against me.

92.s: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה׃
92.e: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree; He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

92.s: שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת אֱלֹהֵינוּ יַפְרִיחוּ׃
92.e: Planted in the house of the LORD, They shall flourish in the courts of our God.

92.s: עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ׃
92.e: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and richness;

92.s: לְהַגִּיד כִּי־יָשָׁר יְהוָה צוּרִי וְלֹא־עלתה [עַוְלָתָה] בּוֹ׃
92.e: To declare that the LORD is upright, My Rock, in whom there is no unrighteousness.

93.s: יְהוָה מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְהוָה עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט׃
93.e: The LORD reigneth; He is clothed in majesty; The LORD is clothed, He hath girded Himself with strength; Yea, the world is established, that it cannot be moved.
Thy throne is established of old; Thou art from everlasting.

93.s: נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת יְהוָה נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת קוֹלָם יִשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת דָּכְיָם׃
93.e: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their roaring.

93.s: מִקֹּלוֹת מַיִם רַבִּים אַדִּירִים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָם אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם יְהוָה׃
93.e: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, The LORD on high is mighty.

93.s: עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶאֶמְנוּ מְאֹד לְבֵיתְךָ נַאֲוָה־קֹדֶשׁ יְהוָה לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים׃
93.e: Thy testimonies are very sure, Holiness becometh Thy house, O LORD, for evermore.
